title: Customer Success (m/w/d) EV-Ladeinfrastruktur
descriptionHtml:
Über ELMI

ELMI ist ein Technologieunternehmen für batteriegestützte
Ultra-Schnellladestationen. Unsere Mission ist es, weit mehr als
klassische Ladesäulen zu entwickeln: Wir schaffen intelligente
Energielösungen, die flexibel mit den Anforderungen von morgen
mitwachsen, Ressourcen schonen und Netze entlasten – und so die
Energiewende Schritt für Schritt in die Praxis bringen.

Aufgaben

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine Customer-Success-Persönlichkeit,
die unsere Kunden nach dem Projektstart eng begleitet, ihre Anliegen
versteht und dafür sorgt, dass sie mit unseren Lösungen erfolgreich
arbeiten.

Du bist eine wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und ELMI.
Du begleitest Kunden in laufenden Projekten, koordinierst Anliegen mit
unseren internen Teams und externen Partnern und sorgst dafür, dass Fragen und
Herausforderungen schnell und lösungsorientiert bearbeitet werden.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kunden begleiten: Du bist zentrale:r Ansprechpartner:in für unsere Kunden und sorgst für eine vertrauensvolle und langfristige Zusammenarbeit.
  • Anfragen koordinieren: Du nimmst Kundenanliegen
    auf, strukturierst sie und koordinierst die Bearbeitung mit Service,
    Entwicklung und weiteren internen oder externen Teams.
  • Probleme lösen: Du behältst auch bei technischen
    oder organisatorischen Herausforderungen den Überblick und sorgst dafür,
    dass Kunden schnell eine passende Lösung erhalten.
  • Kundenfeedback aufnehmen: Du verstehst die
    Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und bringst deren Feedback aktiv in die
    Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte und Services ein.
  • Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde & Team: Du
    übersetzt Kundenanforderungen in konkrete interne Aufgaben
  • Customer Success Prozesse mitgestalten: Du hilfst dabei, Strukturen, Abläufe und Standards für die Kundenbetreuung aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln.

Qualifikation

  • Kunden- & lösungsorientiert: Du hast Spaß daran, Kund:innen zu begleiten, ihre Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und praxisnahe Lösungen zu entwickeln. Dabei bist du serviceorientiert, empathisch und verbindlich.
  • Kommunikativ & wissensvermittelnd: Du erklärst komplexe Inhalte verständlich, praxisnah und motivierend
  • Interesse an Ladeinfrastruktur & Batterietechnick: Du interessierst dich für erneuerbare Energien, Batterietechnick und Ladeinfrastruktur Anwendungen und hast Lust, dich in Themen wie Batteriespeicher und Energiemanagement einzuarbeiten.
  • Eigeninitiative & Verantwortung: Du Arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und lösungsorientiert
  • Macher:in mit Kreativität: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, probierst neue Ansätze aus und möchtest unseren Service aktiv mitgestalten.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Reisebereitschaft: Du bist bereit für gelegentliche Kundentermine vor Ort zu sein
  • Fachlicher Hintergrund: Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium

Benefits

  • Entspannte Arbeitsatmosphäre: Bei uns geht es professionell, aber unkompliziert zu – wir pflegen einen offenen und lockeren Umgang miteinander.
  • Kurze Wege & flache Hierarchien: Egal ob Kolleg:in oder Geschäftsführung – bei uns zählt die Idee, nicht die Position.
  • Eigenverantwortung & Vertrauen: Du bekommst den Freiraum, deine Themen selbstständig voranzutreiben und eigene Ideen einzubringen.
  • Gemeinsam statt nebeneinander: Wir arbeiten eng zusammen, unterstützen uns gegenseitig und lösen Herausforderungen als Team.
  • Direkter Austausch: Fragen, Feedback und neue Ideen werden offen angesprochen – ohne unnötige Abstimmungswege.
  • Start-up-Mentalität: Wir geben Raum für neue Ideen, mutige Entscheidungen und eigene Lösungen. Nicht alles muss auf Anhieb perfekt sein – wir lernen aus unseren Erfahrungen und entwickeln uns gemeinsam weiter.
  • Technologie mit Sinn: Du arbeitest an innovativen, batteriegestützten Ladelösungen und gestaltest aktiv die Zukunft der Elektromobilität mit.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das die Zukunft der Elektromobilität gestaltet.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und vielleicht schon bald als Teil unseres Teams begrüßen zu dürfen!

Bewirb dich jetzt – und bring deine Energie dorthin, wo sie wirklich etwas bewegt!

title: Customer Success Manager Grands Comptes - Cabinets comptables H/F (en télétravail depuis Nantes)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Le rôle

En tant que Customer Success Manager Key Accounts (CSM KA), tu accompagnes un portefeuille de cabinets partenaires grands comptes (7 à 10 comptes, Top 150) qui déploient Pennylane auprès de leurs équipes et de leurs clients. Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux.

Tes responsabilités

  • Piloter la relation au quotidien avec les décisionnaires et équipes projet du cabinet.

  • Construire et animer la gouvernance : COPIL, comités d’adoption, instances de suivi, communauté de relais locaux.

  • Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée.

  • Coordonner l’exécution avec les expert·e·s internes Pennylane (Produit, Support, Ops, Sales, etc.).

  • Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation.

  • Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux.

Ce que tu vas faire concrètement

1) Stratégie d’embarquement clients (TPE/PME)

  • Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients.

  • Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement.

  • Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives.

2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs

  • Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration.

  • Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution.

3) Satisfaction & rétention

  • Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur.

  • Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires.

Indicateurs de réussite

  • CSAT sur ton portefeuille.

  • Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL.

  • Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux.

  • Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention.

  

Profil recherché

 

  • Expérience de 5 ans minimum :

    • en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet

    • ou en finance / audit avec gestion de relation clients (dimension commerciale)

  • Excellente relation client : capacité à rassurer, structurer, et prendre de la hauteur.

  • Assertivité : recommandations claires, diplomatie et capacité à convaincre.

  • Pilotage de portefeuille (santé client), plans d’action ad hoc.

  • Analyse de données : tirer des insights et prioriser.

  • Gestion de projet : coordination multi-interlocuteurs, rigueur et autonomie.

  

Process de recrutement

 

  • Premier entretien avec Florent Mirigay - Senior Business Recruiter (45 min)

  • Deuxième entretien avec Alexandra Ser, Team lead de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (45min)

  • Etude de cas (préparée en amont) avec Alexandra et une personne de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (1H)

  • Dernier entretien avec Arnaud Bernard (Head of Grands Comptes)

 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

  • Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. title: Customer Success / Operations Architect (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Birdsview

Birdsview ist die Agentic Sales Platform für den E-Commerce: KI-Agenten, die autonom verkaufen - per E-Mail und direkt im Shop. Vor allem dort, wo Kataloge komplex sind und gute Beratung den Unterschied macht.

Das Fundament ist die Birdsview Intelligence: eine Wissensschicht, die Sprachmodellen echte Retail-Verkaufsexpertise gibt. Sie versteht Kundenlebenszyklen (Lifecycle IQ), Produkte und wie sie zusammenpassen (Product IQ), Produktbilder (Vision IQ) und die Tonalität jeder Marke (Emotional IQ) — modellagnostisch und direkt auf den Daten des Shops.

Darauf arbeiten unsere Sales Agents:

  • Avys verkauft per E-Mail: Sie schreibt jedem Kunden eine individuelle Mail, wählt Produkte und Zeitpunkt, trifft den Ton der Marke und versendet selbst — ohne Flows, Segmente oder Agentur.

  • Robyn verkauft im Shop: Sie bringt dieselben Empfehlungen direkt auf die Produktseiten — über dasselbe Plugin, ohne neue Integration.

Unsere Kunden - Online-Händler und Marken auf Shopware und Shopify, von LUSH über TeeGschwendner bis Egle - wechseln zu uns, weil unsere Agents sofort live sind, im Schnitt ein Vielfaches ihrer Kosten einspielen und 1:1-Personalisierung at scale liefern, während Incumbents wie Klaviyo manuelle Tools bleiben, die meist eine Agentur zum Betrieb brauchen.

Deine Mission

Die Rolle in einem Satz: Du bist das Gesicht von Birdsview für unsere Kunden, von Go-Live bis Renewal, und baust gleichzeitig die AI-Systeme, mit denen das ohne Ticket-Flut skaliert.

Wir suchen keinen klassischen Customer Success Manager, der Tickets abarbeitet. Unser zweiköpfiges Customer-Team betreut unsere Kunden bereits jeden Tag — was fehlt, ist das System dahinter: klare Prozesse, Automatisierung, ein durchgängiger Weg vom Vertragsabschluss bis zum Renewal. Mit den beiden arbeitest du jeden Tag eng zusammen, und genauso eng mit den Foundern: Ihr sitzt zusammen im Office, stimmt Prioritäten direkt ab, und du bekommst ungefilterten Einblick in Produkt, Vertrieb und Strategie.

Du übernimmst die End-to-End-Verantwortung für Ergebnisse und Systeme in diesem Bereich: Du bringst Kunden live auf Avys und Robyn, machst sie messbar erfolgreich, verantwortest Renewals & Expansion — und baust den Bereich so um, wie ein AI-Unternehmen ihn heute bauen sollte: automatisiert, skalierbar, AI-first. Am Ende beantwortet kein Mensch mehr First-Level-Anfragen — nicht, weil wir am Team sparen, sondern damit Menschen bei uns nur das tun, was Maschinen nicht können: Beziehungen, Eskalationen, Wachstum.

Das erwartet dich

  • Go-Live: Du onboardest neue Kunden auf unsere Agents — vom Kickoff über die Shop-Anbindung (Shopware/Shopify) bis zur ersten Mail von Avys und den ersten Empfehlungen von Robyn im Shop.

  • Success: Du bleibst nah an unseren Kunden, machst den ROI unserer Agents sichtbar und sorgst dafür, dass aus Go-Lives begeisterte Referenzen werden.

  • Growth: Du verantwortest Vertragsverlängerungen und Upsells auf neue Features und Produktlinien.

  • Systeme statt Tickets: Du baust den Customer-Bereich AI-first um — automatisiertes Onboarding, Health Scores, Self-Service, AI-gestützter Support (n8n, Claude, APIs). Ziel: Repetitive Anfragen erledigt die Maschine, dein Team hat den Rücken frei für alles, was echten Impact hat.

  • Voice of the Customer: Du ownst Eskalationen und übersetzt Kundenfeedback in Produktentscheidungen — mit direktem Draht zu Engineering und Foundern.

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Drive, Lernwille, Smartness: Das zählt für uns mehr als Jahre im Lebenslauf. Customer-Success-Erfahrung brauchst du nicht unbedingt — du kannst auch direkt nach dem Studium einsteigen. Die Founder arbeiten eng mit dir und bringen dich schnell auf Tempo.

  • People Person: Du hast echtes Interesse an Customer Success und an den Menschen hinter unseren Kunden. Du suchst den direkten Kontakt, am Telefon, im Call oder vor Ort, baust Vertrauen auf und machst Kunden zu Partnern.

  • Systems Thinking: Du automatisierst dich selbst aus repetitiver Arbeit heraus, bevor jemand danach fragt.

  • AI-native: LLMs sind dein Tagesgeschäft, du baust Workflows mit n8n, Make & Co., nutzt Tools wie Claude Cowork aktiv und hast keine Berührungsängste mit APIs und Webhooks.

  • Commercial Edge: Du willst Umsatzverantwortung übernehmen und scheust keine Renewal- oder Pricing-Gespräche.

Work Ethic

  • Velocity > Komfort: Du liebst es, wenn Dinge schnell passieren.

  • Ownership: Du übernimmst Verantwortung und lieferst Ergebnisse.

  • Figure-it-out-Mentality: Viele Prozesse existieren noch nicht — du baust sie.

  • Hard Work / High Reward: Du verstehst, dass ein Early-Stage-Startup kein 9-to-5 ist.

Deine ersten 90 Tage

  • Monat 1: Du kennst jeden Kunden, das Team und jeden bestehenden Prozess — und dessen Lücken.

  • Monat 2: Die drei größten manuellen Prozesse laufen automatisiert.

  • Monat 3: Dein Renewal- und Expansion-Playbook steht, und du präsentierst das Operating System für Customer @ Birdsview.

Was du bekommst

  • Attraktives Gehalt + VSOP

  • Direkter Impact auf Umsatz und Produkt

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Foundern: kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen, steile Lernkurve

  • Hardware deiner Wahl, flexible Arbeitszeiten, 30 Tage Urlaub

Bedingungen

  • Standort: Düsseldorf/Köln — Hybrid möglich, aber mehrere Tage unter der Woche im Office in DUS (bei den Foundern)

  • Start: ASAP

title: Customer Support Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

We run camera-based parking for landowners and operators, from hotels and colleges to shopping centres, across England, Scotland and Wales. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Customer Support Manager to lead our support team: six people across two desks, handling around 1,500 tickets a week. One desk helps the landowners and asset managers we work with; the other helps the drivers who park at their sites. This isn’t answering from an FAQ. Many tickets mean investigating across our systems, escalating to TechOps and following up until the problem is fixed.

It’s a role for someone who enjoys making a team better. You’ll have the freedom to bring your own ideas, the backing of our COO, and Client Success, TechOps and Product teams to work with on them. You’ll make the case for what the team needs and be hands-on with our helpdesk tools to get there. You’ll lead from the front too, getting stuck into tickets with the team when it’s busy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of six, with regular one-to-ones and clear standards for quality and output.

  • Run the day-to-day across both desks, keeping response times, resolution and the backlog on track.

  • Get stuck in on tickets when the queue is busy, and handle the trickier escalations yourself.

  • Spot what drivers and clients keep contacting us about, and work with other teams to fix the cause.

  • Get the most out of Zendesk, from macros and tagging to reporting.

  • Plan the rota, including Saturday cover, around leave and busy periods.

Who we’re looking for

You’ll need:

  • Experience leading a customer support or service team, ideally on an email or ticket-based desk with targets.

  • A track record of improving how a team performs.

  • Experience setting clear targets, holding people to them and coaching them to get there.

  • Comfortable with Zendesk or a similar tool, and with using data to see what’s going on.

  • Happy getting into the detail of a problem, across systems and teams, to find out what actually went wrong.

  • Curiosity about how automation and AI could make the team’s work easier.

  • Clear, calm writing, even when a customer isn’t, and confidence on the phone with an unhappy client.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in parking, mobility, utilities or another high-volume consumer service.

  • Experience setting up weekend cover.

What We Offer

  • £35,000, negotiable

  • Hybrid working: 3 days in the office, 2 days from home.

  • Room to grow with the business, with training and development support.

  • 20 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays.

  • Company pension scheme.

  • A fully refurbished, modern office right next to East Croydon Station, with a fully stocked kitchen offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks (and two office dogs!).

  • Laptop and tech provided.

  • Employee Assistance Programme, BrightHR Exchange discounts and regular company events.

The details

Location: Croydon, next to East Croydon Station. Hybrid: 3 days in the office, 2 from home.

Reports to: Daivik Patel, Chief Operating Officer.

Team: 6 support agents across two desks (Client Service and Driver Support).

title: Data Analist (NL)
descriptionHtml:
Bouw mee aan onze nieuwe propositie en maak commerciële impact!

Bij YoungOnes staat data aan de wieg van elk besluit. Ons Data & RevOps team zit aan elke tafel en heeft een leidende rol in de koers van het bedrijf. Twee jaar geleden hebben we onze data omgeving in Databricks volledig opnieuw opgebouwd, en die is helemaal klaar voor de toekomst. Er zijn weinig mooiere omgevingen om in te werken.

We zoeken een Data Analist met een duidelijke focus op product, die daarnaast onze marketing en commerciële teams ondersteunt met diepere analyses. Iemand met ervaring die klaar is om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, en die niet stopt bij een rapport maar actief stuurt op resultaat.

Wat ga je doen?

Je hoofdfocus ligt op product. Daarnaast ondersteun je marketing en de commerciële teams. Dat zorgt voor veel afwisseling in je werk.

Product

Binnen de markt van flexibel werk had je altijd de keuze tussen uitzenden of freelancers. Sinds afgelopen jaar zetten wij een propositie in de markt die daar tussenin zit: non-service uitzenden. De juridische zekerheid van uitzenden, met de flexibiliteit en eigen controle van freelancing via ons platform. Dit is een belangrijke stap in onze strategie naar one app for work.

  • In de lead zijn bij het tracken van de voortgang van deze nieuwe propositie;

  • De KPI's en funnel definiëren die laten zien of de propositie werkt;

  • De volledige journey van workers en opdrachtgevers analyseren, van onboarding tot herhaalde shifts;

  • Problemen vroeg signaleren en actief bijsturen waar jij ze ziet;

  • Inzichten samen met product en development vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen;

  • Werken in een select team dat functioneert als startup binnen het bedrijf.

Commerciële & marketing ondersteuning

Naast product ben jij de analytische sparringpartner voor onze commerciële teams en marketing. Je gaat verder dan de standaard reports en duikt de diepte in wanneer vragen complex worden.

  • Diepere analyses leveren voor de commerciële teams, bijvoorbeeld op klant-potentie, retentie en groeikansen;

  • Marketing ondersteunen met inzicht in campagneresultaten en ROAS.

De functie is divers en afwisselend, maar bovenal krijg je veel vrijheid om te ondernemen.

Jouw team

Je wordt onderdeel van een effectief Data & RevOps team met 3 analisten, 2 engineers, een performance manager en 2 process analisten. Je rapporteert aan de Head of Data.

De data zelf is ook interessant: we ondersteunen een two-sided marketplace met workers aan de ene kant en opdrachtgevers aan de andere kant. AI zit in het ontwerp van hoe we werken en maakt de technische kant van je werk eenvoudiger. We werken met Genie binnen Databricks, dat onze data omgeving volledig snapt en kent, met Claude om meerdere systemen aan elkaar te koppelen en met Gemini voor snelle ondersteuning bij kleine taken.

Wat zoeken we?

We zoeken iemand die:

  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring heeft als Data Analist, Product Analist of Commercial Analist;

  • Ervaring heeft met het tracken en sturen van product performance, en/of met commerciële of marketing analytics;

  • Sterk is in SQL en bekend is met Python/PySpark en een visualisatietool zoals Power BI of Amplitude;

  • Ervaring heeft met Databricks, of daar graag mee aan de slag wil;

  • AI tooling vanzelfsprekend inzet om sneller en slimmer te werken;

  • Eigenaarschap pakt, keuzes durft te maken en stakeholders weet te beïnvloeden;

  • Helder communiceert met zowel technische als niet technische collega's;

  • Al in Nederland woont en hier mag werken.

We zoeken geen profiel dat alleen reports oplevert. We zoeken iemand die de lead pakt, problemen eerder ziet dan anderen en zorgt dat er iets mee gebeurt.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een bruto salaris tussen €4.300 en €6.100 op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;

  • Een bedrijf dat echt datagedreven is, waar jouw inzichten besluiten vormen;

YoungOnes is een plek waar je snel leert, snel bouwt en snel resultaat ziet. Klaar om de lead te pakken? Dan horen we graag van je.

title: Data Analyst
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We're the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.

THE ROLE: Data Analyst

NexGen Cloud is moving to a data-driven way of running the business. Right now, revenue, occupancy, billing and pipeline data live across data warehouses, business systems and APIs, and the numbers don't always agree. We're building out our Strategic Finance team so that leadership, sales and operations can rely on one set of figures and act on them daily.

This role suits someone who enjoys the technical craft of data and wants to learn the commercial side of the AI compute market. We'll teach you that context. When a number looks wrong, you'll dig until you find why, and you'll come back with a fix as well as the problem.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Rather than a checklist, here's what success in this role actually looks like:

  • Build and maintain the pipelines that bring data from across the business into Databricks and Power BI, and automate the manual steps along the way
  • Own the daily revenue and occupancy reporting that leadership uses to track how the GPU fleet is performing
  • Check that what we bill matches what customers actually used, covering power draw, utilisation, asset registers and credits
  • Support commission calculations and give sales leadership a clear view of pipeline health, conversion and churn
  • Model pricing options and deal economics so investment decisions are grounded in real numbers
  • Validate every figure before it reaches leadership or anyone outside the company
  • Help the wider team work confidently with BI tools and data

ABOUT YOU

We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You'll likely bring a combination of the following:

Essential:

  • Hands-on experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar role, including data extraction, integration or automation projects
  • Strong SQL and Excel skills
  • Solid Power BI experience, including reconciling figures when different sources disagree
  • Hands-on use of a CRM (HubSpot or similar), and of AI tools to speed up analysis and build work
  • A root-cause mindset: you find the underlying cause rather than reporting the symptom, and you bring a proposed solution with it

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Databricks
  • Exposure to billing, revenue assurance or commission processes, ideally in a cloud, SaaS or usage-based business
  • Some experience with financial modelling or FP&A work
  • Time spent in a high-growth company where data processes were still being built

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme
  • Employee wellbeing benefits
  • 25 days holiday, plus public holidays
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Enhanced Pension Scheme
  • Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)
  • Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment
  • Visible, meaningful impact as we scale
  • Clear career progression in a high-growth company
  • A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership
  • The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud's team, culture, and future

WHY APPLY

We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we'd like to hear from you.

MORE INFORMATION

Visit our careers page to learn more about us or follow us on LinkedIn and X to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.

title: DFT Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

As DFT Engineer, you will define and own the Design-for-Test strategy of our next-generation SoC from the ground up. This is not a role where you inherit an existing flow, scripts, or team — you build it. You will work closely with RTL design, physical implementation, and our test partners to make our chips manufacturable, testable, and ready for volume production.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 10+ years in DFT, with at least one full SoC tape-out owned end-to-end — not just one slice of a large team effort.

  • Strong hands-on experience with one major DFT suite: Siemens Tessent, Synopsys TestMAX / DFTMAX / TetraMAX, or Cadence Modus.

  • Scan insertion and test compression (EDT / DFTMAX / Modus-type).

  • MBIST and memory repair integration.

  • JTAG / IEEE 1149.1, IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), IEEE 1500 wrappers.

  • ATPG pattern generation (stuck-at, transition, path delay), coverage analysis and improvement.

  • DFT verification: gate-level simulation of patterns, timing-aware checks.

  • Test-mode SDC / STA understanding.

  • Scripting: Tcl, Python.

  • Experience in silicon bring-up and ATE debug.

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

Responsibilities

  • Define DFT architecture and test strategy — coverage targets, test time, pin budget — in collaboration with Siemens experts and our design team.

  • Implement hands-on: scan insertion, compression, MBIST, JTAG/IJTAG/IEEE 1500 wrappers, ATPG, sign-off.

  • Drive DFT verification: gate-level simulation of test patterns and timing-aware checks.

  • Support physical design and STA for test modes — constraints, scan timing closure.

  • Be the bridge between RTL design, physical implementation, and the ATE / test house for silicon bring-up.

  • Deliver patterns to ATE and debug failing patterns with the test house.

  • Contribute to DFT tool evaluation and set up a reusable, scalable flow.

Preferred Qualification

  • Experience at advanced nodes (7nm and below).

  • Experience with large AI/HPC or multi-core SoCs, NoC-based designs.

  • Hierarchical DFT on large designs.

  • Has participated in a DFT tool selection or flow setup from scratch.

  • Logic BIST, in-system test, or functional safety (ISO 26262) exposure.

  • Yield analysis and diagnosis (e.g. Tessent Diagnosis, YieldInsight).

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago.

title: Director Go-to-Market and Revenue Strategy
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a commercial leader who has built the go-to-market of a platform from a blank page and knows what it takes to turn a product that people already use into a business that pays for itself. You have priced and packaged products for marketplaces, brands or merchants, and you have seen the difference between a model that looks good in a spreadsheet and one that a small business owner actually adopts.

You are comfortable in a B2B2C world: the customer is reached through someone else's channel, the data belongs to the ecosystem, and the money comes from several ends of a transaction at once. You influence without authority, because the teams that execute will rarely report to you. You are rigorous with numbers and plain with people, and you are at ease saying what the evidence shows even when the room expects something else.

You want to build something that reaches millions of small businesses, you are prepared to work for it.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Toqan for Partners is the AI assistant for the merchants across the companies of the Prosus ecosystem: restaurants, pharmacies, hotels, sellers, real estate agencies and car dealers, five million businesses in total. It launched to restaurants on iFood in Brazil in September 2026 and reached 65,000 restaurants in four weeks with no media spend.

The next twelve months decide how it will become a business: which applications partners pay for and at what price, how value is shared with everyone the partner transacts with, how the uplift is measured and published so the next company embeds, and how the product travels from iFood to the rest of the ecosystem and to India and Europe. You will lead that work, as the owner of the go-to-market and the revenue strategy of Toqan for Partners, alongside the product and technology leads who own what gets built.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the commercial model

Define pricing and packaging for the applications partners pay for, media management, supply, finance and operations, at a fraction of what they spend today and justified by the return they see. Design how Toqan takes part in the value it creates for the other end: take rate on agent-negotiated supply, credit origination, brand and industry media, and cross-sell of the ecosystem companies' own products. Set the rules that keep it honest, starting with the separation between paid placement and recommendation.

Drive the rollout across the ecosystem

With the Head of Operations, secure the commitment of each business in the ecosystem: sponsor, distribution, conditional yes and first market. Run the rollout inside each one, working through the teams that own the merchant relationship, and bring the product to its next verticals and markets.

Build the measurement

Own the scoreboard: active partners under a strict definition, uplift per business in retention and GMV, cost and value per active partner. Make the uplift the argument that brings the next company in and the evidence behind every pricing decision.

Structure the partnerships that carry the revenue

Lead the commercial agreements with distributors, industry, fintechs and the ecosystem companies' commercial platforms, from first conversation to signed terms, and the co-investment models that align their incentives with the partner's.

Build and lead the team

Hire and develop a small go-to-market and revenue team, growth on the merchant side, monetisation and analytics, and set its standard for rigour, ownership and candour.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Ten or more years in go-to-market, revenue or commercial strategy, with at least one commercial function built from scratch and grown to scale.

  • Hands-on experience with pricing and packaging, ideally for marketplaces, retail media, payments or SaaS sold to small businesses.

  • Experience on more than one side of a marketplace: merchants or sellers, brands or suppliers, the platform itself.

  • A track record of adoption at scale with a long tail of small customers, not only of large enterprise deals.

  • Proven ability to move a result through teams that do not report to you, and to work inside another company's channel.

  • Fluency with data: you build the business case, run the analysis and read the uplift yourself, and use AI tooling as a normal part of how you work.

  • Candour, humility and patience: you say what the numbers say, you arrive to learn before you teach.

  • English required; Portuguese or Spanish strongly preferred.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Global impact: a product that reaches five million small businesses across Latin America, Europe and India.

  • Ownership: the commercial model of a new business, with the numbers to be judged on and the autonomy to build it.

  • Growth: exposure to the leadership of the group and of its companies, and a clear path into operating roles in the ecosystem.

  • Competitive compensation and the Prosus benefits package for the location of the role.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

title: Director of Data Analytics
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

The role

Fractile designs chips and systems that are manufactured, tested and assembled by a global network of subcontractors. The Director of Data Analytics owns how that data reaches Fractile and how it is handled, stored and processed so the business can turn it into actionable intel.

You will set up the data pipes to our subcontractors, build full chip-to-system genealogy to provide full system traceability and integrate cleansed supplier data into the Fractile ERP system. The result is the data framework behind real-time product WIP reports, raw material inventory levels and product cost variance reporting.

What the role entails

Manufacturing and test data

• Set up and run secure and resilient data pipes to global subcontractors to gather and organise all real-time manufacturing data and complex production test data.

• Define data standards, formats, delivery schedules and quality checks with each subcontractor, and hold them to those standards.

• Build tools and maintain data stores and backups that hold this data in a consistent and cleansed form to enable fast and accurate analysis.

Traceability and genealogy

• Build full chip-to-system genealogy flows: every chip, package, board, chassis and rack system connected and traceable through each assembly and test step.

• Provide exact and live traceability through serialisation so that any unit can be traced back to its components, lots, processes and test results.

• Build databases so traceability can be queried by engineering, operations, quality and customer support.

ERP data integration and cleansing

• Integrate and cleanse chip-to-system data into the Fractile ERP system from supplier B2B reports to enable real-time lot and yield tracking.

• Maintain bill of materials (BOM) and build standard management to ensure consistency between Fractile and supplier ERP and PLM tools.

• Own the data flow for purchase orders and invoice matching, so that orders, receipts and invoices reconcile.

• Build tools and capabilities to calculate and track product cost variances and alert the team of trends and deviations.

• Set the data quality rules, validation and exception handling that keep ERP data accurate.

Reporting and analytics

• Generate automated reports for real-time product WIP reports and raw material inventory levels, including calculations of working capital and inventory financial exposure levels and risk to business.

• Provide the data framework for product cost variance reporting to provide guidance for standard cost adjustments on a monthly and quarterly basis.

• Work with manufacturing operations, finance, supply chain and engineering to define the business metrics needed to monitor company health and deliver them in the form of automated reports and dashboards.

Team and ways of working

• Build and lead a small team of data engineers and analysts in a timely manner to support the growth of the business and the increases in data management needs.

• Work multi-functionally to set the architecture, tooling, documentation and security practice for Fractile's operational and financial data.

Who we are looking for

Essential

• Proven experience leading data engineering or analytics for hardware, semiconductor and electronics manufacturing within a complex global supply chain.

• Experience building secure data pipelines and integrations with external partners, including overseas contract manufacturers and test houses.

• Strong understanding of manufacturing and test data, and of production flow traceability and genealogy.

• Hands-on experience integrating data into an ERP system, and working knowledge of BOMs, WIP, inventory, procure-to-pay and book-to-bill processes.

• Strong SQL and Python, and experience with modern data platforms, data modelling and data quality tooling.

• Experience building reports and dashboards to enable knowledge-based decisions.

• Ability to work with suppliers across time zones and to set standards that they follow.

Desirable

• Experience in a fabless semiconductor or AI hardware company.

• Familiarity with OSAT, wafer test, final test, CM and system assembly and test flows.

• Experience with standard cost and cost variance analysis.

• Experience building a company-wide data function from the ground up in an early-stage company.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

title: Electrical Technician, Magnet Systems
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

TEAM AND ROLE

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

We are looking for an Electrical Technician to support our R&D activities across our sites in Villigen and Böttstein, Aargau. You will be responsible for developing electrical infrastructure and executing electrical installation, maintenance and troubleshooting tasks for our R&D facilities & experiments. Your work will directly enable our teams to build, test, and iterate faster.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Experimental Support

You will help connect our experiments to their measurement and control systems.

  • Instrumentation Wiring: Assemble control panels, junction boxes and cabinets. Wire sensors, heaters, instrumentation, and related electrical interfaces.

  • System Integration: Support integration of power supplies, control panels, acquisition systems, and test equipment from an electrical perspective.

  • Commissioning Support: Assist with electrical checks, verification, and commissioning of experimental setups.

  • Troubleshooting: Diagnose and repair electrical faults, component failures, and other problems affecting experiments.

2. Electrical Infrastructure

You will support the definition and upgrade of electrical infrastructure for our R&D program

  • Electrical Connection: Power and connect our experimental setups, prototype rigs, and manufacturing equipment.

  • Installation Oversight: Oversee electrical interventions by external contractors

3. Safety and Quality

Reliable operation depends on fast diagnosis and safe maintenance of electrical systems.

  • Safety & Compliance: Ensure installations and modifications are safe and compliant with relevant norms, regulations and internal procedures.

  • Maintenance: Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on electrical infrastructure, test hardware, and support systems.

  • Quality of Execution: Ensure that installations are neat, maintainable, and consistent with industrial norms. Maintain a safe, functional, and organized electrical environment

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for an Electrical Technician who is safety-conscious, deeply practical, and enjoys making technical systems work reliably.

  • Background: Training and practical experience as an Electrician, Electrical Technician, or similar.

  • Qualification: Automatiker, Elektroinstallateur (EFZ Swiss vocational diploma) or equivalent qualification

  • Safety Mindset: Good knowledge of safe electrical working practices and regulations.

  • Technical Capability: Comfortable with producing and reading electrical diagrams, sizing cables and protection devices, performing modifications, and troubleshooting real systems.

  • Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic R&D environment where setups evolve quickly and where engineers, scientists, and technicians collaborate closely.

Nice to have

  • Driving license valid in Switzerland

  • Experience in R&D environments

  • Experience drawing and updating Single-Line Diagrams (SLDs) and developing power distribution networks

  • Familiarity with ECAD software

  • Experience with power supplies, low-voltage industrial systems, or control cabinets

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. title: Electronics Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

The Role

We are looking for an Electronics Engineering Manager to lead the electronics function within our Systems team at IonQ. You will lead a team of three electronics engineers and grow it as our programmes scale. The team designs, builds and tests the electronics subsystems behind our mission to build the most performant quantum computers.

This is a player-coach role, with roughly 60% of your time spent leading the team and 40% on hands-on design work. You will set the technical direction for our electronics deliverables and build a team that can deliver them reliably, from experimental prototypes to rack-ready production systems.

Responsibilities 

You will own the electronics roadmap for current and next-generation quantum systems. That covers schematic capture and PCB layout through to board and system-level test, and the drive architecture for QPU designs.

You will balance hands-on technical leadership with people management, planning and coordination across teams. As the main electronics contact for the physics, firmware, mechanical and systems teams, you will turn complex physical requirements into clear, achievable engineering plans, and you will keep improving the tooling, workflow and capability of the team.Key responsibilities include: 

  • Team leadership: Lead and develop a team of three electronics engineers and play a key role in growing it through hiring. Set clear goals, run regular 1:1s and performance reviews, and build a culture of technical excellence and accountability.
  • Technical direction: Own the architecture of the electronics subsystems, including mixed-signal design, high-speed digital and signal integrity. Approve key design decisions and lead design reviews.
  • Delivery and planning: Plan, prioritise and track electronics workstreams against programme milestones, managing resourcing, schedules, risks and dependencies, and report progress to stakeholders.
  • Quality and process: Set and improve design standards, review processes, verification and test strategy (simulation, bench test, system integration) and documentation practices.
  • Productisation: Lead the move from experimental prototypes to robust, manufacturable, rack-ready production systems, working with suppliers and contract manufacturers as needed.

Requirements 

To succeed, you will need around ten years of experience in electronics design, with a strong background in high-speed and mixed-signal electronics, proven experience leading engineers and a track record of taking hardware from concept through prototype to production on schedule. You should be able to give credible technical guidance while growing the team around you, and bring a high level of attention to detail to your own work and to the designs you review.

You will be comfortable in a fast-moving, highly technical environment and know when to use waterfall or agile delivery in a hardware setting. Experience with Jira and Smartsheet, exposure to cryogenic environments, RF/microwave engineering (up to 500 MHz) or Python-based test automation, and familiarity with the Sinara/ARTIQ ecosystem in a quantum or physics research setting would all be an advantage.


You’d be a great fit with:

  • Engineering leadership experience: A track record of managing or technically leading electronics engineers, including hiring, mentoring and performance management.
  • Strong hardware design background: Hands-on experience with mixed-signal and high-speed digital design, SPICE modelling and lab verification (oscilloscopes, spectrum analysers).
  • Altium expertise: Experience with complex schematics, rigid-flex designs and advanced signal-integrity constraints, and the ability to review and guide others' designs.
  • FPGA and high-performance hardware: Familiarity with Xilinx/Intel toolchains (Vivado/Quartus) and carriers such as the BittWare XUP series or Sinara/ARTIQ hardware.
  • High-speed interfaces: Knowledge of SFP+/QSFP-DD interfaces, 10/100G Ethernet and high-speed differential pair routing.

descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a skilled and passionate Engineering Manager to join our Alwin Agents Runtime Team in the Amsterdam office. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll have the unique opportunity to lead a team building the intelligence layer that automates the assurance lifecycle and brings AI directly into the workflows of auditors worldwide.


Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

title: Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
We have real traction and proven scale, and we're now setting up how engineering works for our next wave of European growth. You would lead one of the teams doing it, and shape the practices the others follow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You would lead one of our product engineering teams: what it ships, how it runs, and how the people in it grow. Product and engineering together are ~25 people, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.

It's a hands-on role. One week you're in a design review, the next - in a few Claude-enabled contributions, the next - in performance conversations, and most weeks - all of that combined. You should love zooming in and out, from feedback on an API spec to a quarter's priorities. Your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it.

Beyond your team, you would shape how engineering works at Insify together with the other Engineering Managers, a Staff Engineer and the VP Engineering: architecture, product discovery, how engineers grow.


What you'll be doing
  • Leading a team of product engineers end to end: what you ship, how it performs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there
  • Bringing architecture and product thinking into the team's daily work, so that new product demands turn into platform capabilities that scale across countries and insurance products, rather than one-off builds
  • Running product discovery with your team: working with the Insurance, Operations and Growth teams on what to build, and saying no when the answer is no
  • Shaping company-wide engineering practices alongside the other Engineering Managers: ways of working, architecture & technology practices, the growth framework
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

    • What you'll need
  • You've managed a team of engineers before, including hiring, feedback and growing people. It doesn't have to be for long, but it has to be real and you have to want more of it
  • Years of hands-on experience designing and running distributed systems, including time spent maintaining what you designed. You can still carry an architecture discussion and review a design, and your team would trust your judgement on it
  • A track record of shaping what gets built, not only how: you've run or driven product discovery, cut scope, and can show the decisions that followed
  • Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your team's boundaries to get to results
  • You set the bar for AI adoption on your team. You use it to real effect in your own work, you're honest about where it helped and where it fell short, and you're the first to try new tools, bringing the ones that stick to your engineers.

    • Nice to have
  • You are eager to scale your experience beyond your team - to create wider organisational impact
  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
  • Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
  • Experience with TypeScript and AWS

    • Our stack
  • TypeScript across the board, running on AWS with infrastructure as code, in a single monorepo.

    • None of this is a hard requirement, and you don't need to know all of our stack. We care more about how you reason about systems and teams than which tools you have used. Strong on most of it? Apply.


    We offer
  • Competitive compensation. We offer a salary in the range of 85k-110k EUR plus performance-based equity grants
  • Hybrid. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year from abroad, 25 holiday days
  • Pension. 6% employer contribution
  • Wellbeing budget. €50 net a month via Epassi, from the gym to takeaway, rolls over
  • Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs and coaching
  • Central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, Friday drinks, high-spec MacBook Pro

    • HOW WE HIRE

    Five conversations, each with a clear purpose, and you hear where you stand after every one:

    • Leadership. We look at your experience with performance management, personal development and building teams.
    • Code Review. You review a feature with two of our engineers.
    • System Design. An architecture problem close to what we deal with.
    • Values Interview. We look at your approach to work, and how it adds to our Values.
    • Meet the Founder.

    You get the outcome within three days of your last round, with specific feedback either way.

    ABOUT INSIFY

    Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

    We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

    Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.

title: Engineering Manager, Fleet Delivery
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

A datacenter is not a cloud until software makes it one. You will lead the team that turns arriving hardware into accepted clusters.

Cabling validation, burn-in, firmware, deployment validation, software stack install — all of it automated, none of it click-ops. Your KPI is time to acceptance: the hours between a rack being physically installed and it serving customer workloads. Across the industry that number is measured in weeks. You will drive it toward days, then hours, as we scale toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe.

This is a founding leadership role at the intersection of hardware and software. Early on it is deliberately hands-on: most of your time in the code and the architecture, some of it on datacenter floors, because the automation has to survive contact with the machines it runs on.

But the job is building and leading a team from day one — hiring your first engineers, coaching them, setting their growth paths, and running the rituals that keep quality high. As the team grows, the balance shifts toward people leadership, and you decide how fast. You shape this new team's charter and set the standard for how every future Mistral datacenter comes online.

What You Will Do

  • Build the delivery pipeline in Go: provisioning, configuration, validation, burn-in, network bring-up, software stack install.

  • Build the team from scratch: make the first hires, onboard and coach them, own their performance and growth paths — and set the tooling standards and the playbook every future site reuses.

  • Own time-to-acceptance and drive it down relentlessly — measure it, break it down, kill the slowest step first.

  • Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Hardware Design and Fleet Health — reliability starts at delivery.

  • Handle GPU fleets at scale: H100 and GB200-class nodes, InfiniBand and RoCE fabrics, and the failure modes they bring.

  • Partner with Product Managers and the datacenter org to plan delivery waves against capacity commitments.

What We're Looking For

  • You have automated bare-metal fleets — you have written the software that turns racks into clusters. If you have done it by hand, you resented it and scripted it.

  • Hardware fluency: servers, GPUs, NICs, switches, firmware — you can read a parts list and a topology diagram.

  • 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems, with at least 2 years leading engineers — real people leadership: you have hired, coached, and grown engineers, not just set technical direction.

  • Deep Linux: you are comfortable well below the application layer.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • Willing to travel to datacenter sites when the work demands it.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Enterprise Core Account Executive, UK
descriptionHtml:

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Are you a high-achieving sales professional ready to digitally transform the physical operations that power our planet?
