At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. title: Field Operations Manager, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Exa

Exa is an applied AI research lab organizing the entire web for AI. Agents don't search like people do. They ask long, complex questions and need clean, accurate, real-time answers. So we train our own retrieval models and index hundreds of billions of webpages, giving agents grounded, cited answers instead of stale training data.

And it's working. We've grown about 10x a year for three years, to more than $100M in annualized revenue and 2B+ requests a month from 200K+ teams. HubSpot, monday.com, Revolut, Firefox, Cognition, Cursor and OpenRouter all build on Exa. We raised a $250M Series C at a $2.2B valuation, led by a16z with Benchmark, Lightspeed, NVIDIA Ventures and Y Combinator.

If you want to build core technology that's used every day, help build a generational company, and shape the revenue engine behind it, come join us.

About the role

Exa is hiring a Senior Field Operations Manager for EMEA, based in our new London office, to be the go-to partner for our EMEA sales leader, AEs, SDRs, partners and field engineers as the region grows from a handful of people into a full team.

You’ll bring our GTM operations and programs to EMEA, partnering with our Head of Revenue Programs to decide what we keep, what we localize and what we build new for the region’s markets.

You’ll be a swiss army knife across process, change management, light deal desk, insights and tools, with the relationships and judgment to tie it all together.

If you’ve helped build ops in a new region and you love being close to the field, we’d love to talk!

What you'll do

You'll lean hard on AI across all of this. We expect AI to do much of the reporting, drafting and checking, so your time goes to the field and the conversations only a person can have.

  • Be the person our EMEA sales leader and team go to first. Listen for what matters to them, flag it, help them prioritize, and turn their problems into programs that stick.

  • Stay really close to our EMEA AEs, SDRs, partners and field engineers. Know what’s working and what’s not, and work with our Insights team to spot patterns early, before they show up in the numbers.

  • Roll out every change in EMEA, localized for our markets. Think through what each change will affect, and give each one a clear why, a playbook, training and a check-in on whether it stuck.

  • Run EMEA’s operating rhythm: weekly pipeline and forecast reviews, QBR-style reviews and planning inputs, with decisions and follow-ups tracked.

  • Help EMEA deals move through pricing, quoting and approvals with our US deal desk, Finance and Legal, including EMEA specifics like VAT, GDPR and local entities.

  • Take our operations and programs from launch to running smoothly in EMEA, and adapt them to the region’s markets, languages and buying norms.

  • Partner with our AMER Field Ops Manager on SDR process, and make it work for our EMEA SDR team.

  • Get sellers up to speed on our tools and how each one fits into how we work with buyers, and help each seller set up a day that works for them.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in RevOps, sales ops or a similar GTM role at a B2B tech company, where you’ve done a bit of everything, from process and forecasting to deal support and reporting.

  • You’ve supported EMEA sellers and know how buying, contracting and selling differ across markets like UK and Ireland, DACH, France, the Nordics and Benelux.

  • You’re a builder and a doer who loves to optimize and organize. You’ve built processes and programs your team actually used, kept them running, and made them better.

  • You see how the whole GTM machine fits together, including where sales and field engineering meet. You think through the downstream impact of a change before it ships.

  • You’re AI-first and fluent in Exa and AI assistants like Claude, Devin and GrokBot. Our stack changes all the time, so you get up to speed fast on every tool, in the UI and through MCP, and you know when a moment calls for a human conversation instead.

  • You’re hungry, humble and curious, and change energizes you. You build trust fast, explain a change clearly to a room of reps or a VP, and you’re comfortable telling people what they need to hear.

Nice to have

  • You were part of the founding RevOps or GTM ops team in a new region.

  • You’ve worked closely with a US-based HQ across time zones.

  • You’ve worked at a usage or consumption-based company.

  • You speak a second European language.

Logistics

  • Based in our London office (hybrid), with occasional travel to our US HQs in NY and SF.

title: Finance
descriptionHtml:
About Nomos

Europe pays more than twice as much for electricity as the US or Asia. To reach competitive price levels, Europe has to lean on solar and deliver the flexibility that makes this feasible. Nomos is building a full-stack power company to unlock that flexibility by connecting millions of homes to Europe’s energy markets.

At Nomos, we care about our craft and take full responsibility for what we build. We hire for spikes, not an absence of weaknesses, and look for exceptional ability backed by a record of achievement. This has brought together IMO and IOI medalists, former founders and Olympic athletes in a team whose individual strengths reinforce one another.

 

What you’ll do

Nomos operates at the intersection of energy and finance. You will build and run our finance function, taking responsibility for the liquidity we need and the capital entrusted to us.

  • Plan and manage liquidity across electricity trading, household payments, and company operations.

  • Define and enforce how money moves: spending, approvals, and financial controls.

  • Run accounting, payroll, and the month-end close, with reliable reporting for the founders and investors.

 

Exciting challenges

  • Build the function from scratch. Decide what we run ourselves, where we need external expertise, and what we can automate. Work with engineering to build processes that stay accurate as transaction volumes grow.

  • Put our capital to work carefully. Understand what we can commit, anticipate future funding needs, and challenge spending that does not justify itself. As Nomos grows, explore where financial products could strengthen our energy offering.

title: Founding lead Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Raison is on a mission to provide humans with better skills so they can feel confident and have more opportunities in the AI era. We help companies make sure 100% their teams master AI, directly in the flow of work (Teams, Slack) so that AI knowledge spreads across the organization instead of pooling in a handful of champions.

We are passionate entrepreneurs believing that the ongoing AI revolution should be shared by all employees; and that the future of corporate interactions should not be restricted to private human-machine chats. Raison is capturing what champions create with AI, turning it into shared, governed skills, and propagating them so everyone feels capable and empowered; acting as a powerful lever to accelerate the AI transformation of corporates.

We recently raised €2m from a top French VC + BPI and a selection of high-profile business angels who believe AI mastery is the highest-leverage application of AI inside companies.

Tasks

User Research & Discovery

  • Own field research: contextual inquiry, user interviews, and observation of how teams actually work with AI and where it breaks.
  • Build and maintain a deep understanding of our core users — individual contributors, champions, managers, and corporate buyers — and the context they operate in.
  • Synthesize messy field data into sharp, actionable insight: jobs-to-be-done, adoption blockers, and the conditions under which a skill transfers between people.
  • Establish a continuous discovery habit so research is a foundational reflex, and champion the user's perspective in every product decision.

Product & Experience Design

  • What our experts do by hand today is the spec for what the product must automate tomorrow. Your job is to watch that closely enough to design it.
  • Design the surfaces: the client dashboard execs present to their board, the internal console our experts use to run a dozen live communities at once, and the conversations themselves.
  • Most of our product lives inside someone else's client. You are designing in Teams and Slack, not screens we control — no onboarding, no landing page, no second chance. A four-minute message to an accountant who has never opened Copilot is the hardest design problem we have.
  • Work mostly on enterprise, and partly on higher education, where we also have live deployments. Two audiences, two vocabularies, one product: part of your job is deciding what stays shared and what has to differ, so we build one coherent system rather than two half-products.
  • Work hand-in-hand with our AI product engineers so your field learnings ship as features, then get re-tested at the next pilot.
  • Own the design system: components, tokens, patterns, and the copy that goes with them.

Requirements

  • 4–8 years in product design, UX design, or a hybrid design-research role, ideally on complex, multi-user B2B products.

Until now, I've closed every deal at Dataleap myself. I need someone to do it better than I do.

You'll work directly with me, the CEO and founder, across the full sales lifecycle, from the first cold email to the signed contract. You'll also take over a large and growing pile of inbound leads and demo requests that we can't keep up with today.

As our founding sales hire, you won't be handed a playbook. You'll write it. Every pitch, objection and closed deal shapes how Dataleap sells for years. As we scale, you'll help hire and build the sales team underneath you.

You'll also have a front-row seat to AI. You'll sell the product that is changing how enterprises operate, and you'll use it to change how sales works.

descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As General Manager of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

title: Graduate Venture Operations Associate (12 Month FTC)
descriptionHtml:
Odin helps people to raise and deploy capital seamlessly

We envision a world where people can vote with their money on what the future looks like, and participate in creating it.

Our first product makes it radically easier for anyone, anywhere, to launch & run an investment firm - think "Shopify for asset managers".

We handle all the “plumbing” and paperwork through one seamless platform - everything from setting up the legal structure for an investment vehicle through to processing exits.

We’re already trusted by over 10,000 VCs, angels and founders, and we're one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the UK, tripling income YoY. We've raised $3m in seed funding from top angels, family offices and VCs to support our own growth, and we are just getting started.

The Role

We’re hiring two Graduate Venture Operations Associates to join our team. Your primary focus will be managing the Closing Process – the process of transforming fully fundraised live deals on the Odin platform into actual legal investments.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Calculating fees and final investment amounts

  • Reviewing and ensuring the accuracy of legal documents

  • Managing wire transfers to complete the investment process

  • Directly liaising with customers at every stage of the process, noting feedback and identifying pain points to enhance their experience

Must-Have Qualities

  • You have a drive to understand in detail how things fit together. It’s not just about execution for you; you want to get into the nuts and bolts of how things are happening and why

  • You’re a problem solver. You diligently resolve any challenges our customers face and act as their strategic partner to ensure they achieve their goals

  • Your mindset sets you apart. Beyond adeptly manoeuvring through spreadsheets, you recognise that to achieve process automation, leveraging technology is essential

  • You’re organised and focused. You know what it takes to get the job done, and you prioritise tasks logically so you’re doing the most to move the needle

  • You know how to balance multiple goals, tasks and priorities. You’re comfortable when given more than one task, and you thrive when given the autonomy to execute

  • You’re proactive. You’re always on the front foot, pre-empting any issues or concerns with urgency and care

Your Experience & Background

While we consider the outlined qualities indispensable for this role, we believe success in this role can stem from diverse backgrounds. You may fall into one of the following categories:

Must-Have

  • If you love building cool stuff and are brilliant with Excel, we’re flexible and open to learning about your previous role

  • Recent graduates seeking a post-graduation internship are encouraged to apply

  • Or, if you are currently enrolled in a university or a program and eager to commence a one-year placement at the earliest opportunity, we welcome your application

This is an impactful role, and we’re looking for someone ready to hit the ground running - this position is available for an immediate start.

Contract Details

The starting salary for this role is £35,000, with a review at the six-month mark. This is a 12-month fixed-term contract. As we grow, we’ll make every effort to explore future opportunities within the business - but we also see this as a role that sets you up for an exciting next step in your career, whether that’s at Odin or beyond.

Working at Odin

We’re a London-based team. This is a role where being in the office - working closely with the founders and wider teams - makes a real difference. The speed and intensity we operate at make in-person collaboration crucial, and we expect at least three days per week in the office.

Benefits

  • Health: Private health insurance (Vitality), paid sick leave including support for pregnancy loss and fertility treatments, and access to Spill for mental health support

  • Wellness: £1,000 annual budget for health, therapy or fitness

  • Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity, adoption, paternity and partner leave

Compensation: £30K

descriptionHtml:

Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Your impact

Great growth experiences are built by great engineers.

At Pennylane, Growth Engineering is about more than building landing pages or running experiments. It's about creating fast, reliable and seamless digital experiences that help entrepreneurs discover Pennylane and get started.

As we expand across Europe, our website and acquisition journeys need to become more scalable, more flexible and more effective.

We're looking for a Growth Engineer with strong frontend expertise to help us build the next generation of Pennylane's digital experiences.

You'll join our Growth Engineering team and work closely with Thomas, our Growth Engineering Team Lead, within the Marketing Website squad.

Your work will have a direct impact on how users discover, experience and adopt Pennylane.

What you'll do

Build great web experiences

You'll develop and improve our public website and acquisition journeys, with a strong focus on frontend engineering.

  • Build modern, responsive and high-performing interfaces using Vue.js and Nuxt.js.

  • Develop and maintain fullstack features using Ruby on Rails.

  • Improve website performance, accessibility and user experience.

  • Build reusable components and scalable frontend solutions.

Drive growth through engineering

You'll work closely with Growth, Marketing and Data teams to turn business opportunities into technical solutions.

  • Build and improve acquisition and registration funnels.

  • Design and implement A/B tests and new user experiences.

  • Improve conversion through technical experimentation.

  • Develop features that support our international expansion, including localization and multilingual experiences.

Connect systems and data

You'll contribute to the technical foundations that power our growth initiatives.

  • Build and maintain APIs and integrations between internal and external tools.

  • Ensure reliable data flows across our digital ecosystem.

  • Contribute to tracking implementations and data quality improvements.

  • Work with Data teams to better understand user journeys and experiment results.

Improve how we build

You'll help us move fast without compromising engineering quality.

  • Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify and automate workflows.

  • Use AI-powered development tools when they bring real value.

  • Take ownership of your projects, from technical design to production.

  • Share knowledge and contribute to engineering best practices.

Who are you?

We're looking for an engineer who enjoys building products, solving technical challenges and seeing the impact of their work.

Someone who combines strong engineering fundamentals with curiosity about user experience, experimentation and business impact.

You don't need to be a marketing expert. But you should enjoy understanding why you're building something, not just how to build it.

We'd love to meet you if...

  • You have experience in software engineering, with strong frontend development skills.

  • You're comfortable building modern web applications with Vue.js and/or Nuxt.js, or have strong experience with comparable frameworks and are ready to work with our stack.

  • You're fluent in AI-assisted development : you work with coding agents, create custom skills and instructions, use worktrees to parallelize work and keep code quality high.

  • You have fullstack experience and can contribute to backend development. Experience with Ruby on Rails is a strong plus.

  • You enjoy taking ownership of technical projects from idea to production.

  • You're comfortable collaborating with Engineering, Product, Growth, Marketing and Data teams.

  • You're curious about experimentation, conversion optimization and how users interact with digital products.

  • You're comfortable working in French and English.

Bonus points if you have experience with:

  • Web analytics and tracking tools such as Segment, Amplitude or Google Tag Manager.

  • A/B testing and experimentation platforms.

  • SEO, web performance or conversion optimization.

  • API integrations and marketing automation.

  • AI-assisted development workflows.

Our tech stack

  • Frontend: Vue.js, Nuxt.js, JavaScript

  • Backend: Ruby on Rails

  • Database: PostgreSQL

  • Development: Git, GitHub

You'll also have opportunities to work with analytics, tracking and experimentation tools depending on the projects.

Why you'll love this role

  • Real impact: Your work will directly influence how new customers discover and adopt Pennylane.

  • Engineering challenges: You'll build scalable solutions, not just implement marketing requests.

  • Ownership: You'll have the freedom to propose ideas, make technical decisions and drive projects forward.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: You'll work at the intersection of Engineering, Growth, Marketing and Data.

  • Room to experiment: You'll be encouraged to test ideas, learn from results and continuously improve what we build.

If you love building great web experiences and want your engineering work to have a measurable impact, we'd love to meet you.

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

title: Head of AI Factory Commissioning
descriptionHtml:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.  

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

Role Summary

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Head of AI Factory Commissioning to build and lead the function responsible for commissioning the physical infrastructure of our AI Factories across the Asia Pacific region. You will set the strategy, standards and governance that ensure every AI Factory is proven safe, resilient and performing to design before any compute is deployed.

An AI Factory is a building scale computer that places unprecedented demands on power density, liquid cooling, controls integration, operational resilience, and commissioning rigor. This role is responsible for ensuring these next-generation facilities are proven ready to support large-scale GPU deployments before handover to AI Cluster Commissioning. Firmus has AI factories under development ranging in size from tens of MW to GW scale.

This is a function lead role, at the same level as the Head of AI Cluster Commissioning. You will lead a team of Commissioning Managers who run the day-to-day commissioning. Your focus will be building the function, setting direction, managing risk across the portfolio, and owning the “ready for IT” gate: no data hall is handed over for cluster bring-up until its infrastructure has passed the appropriate level of commissioning acceptance.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Function Build

  • Build, lead and develop a high-performing team of Commissioning Managers and commissioning professionals.
  • Define the structure, capability and resourcing model for the function so it can scale with Firmus’ national and APAC project pipeline.
  • Allocate leadership and resources across the portfolio of AI Factory projects, balancing priorities and managing delivery risk.
  • Build a culture of safety, ownership, technical rigour and continuous improvement.

Commissioning Strategy & Governance

  • Set the strategic direction for AI Factory commissioning, including the methodology, commissioning levels (L1–L5), Integrated Systems Testing (IST) approach and acceptance criteria.
  • Direct the development of commissioning standards, frameworks and templates, delivered through the Commissioning Manager.
  • Set up governance, assurance and reporting that give leadership clear visibility of commissioning progress, readiness and quality across all projects.
  • Make sure commissioning strategies cover all critical infrastructure, including:
    • HV/MV/LV power distribution, UPS, generators and battery energy storage
    • Liquid cooling (CDUs, secondary fluid networks, chillers and heat rejection)
    • Air-side cooling (CRAH/CRAC units, fan walls, air handling and containment)
    • Controls and monitoring: BMS, EPMS and the CubeSense SCADA platform
    • Fire detection and suppression, security and other life-safety systems
  • Act as the final escalation point for complex technical issues, commissioning failures and acceptance decisions.

Handover & Stakeholder Interfaces

  • Own the facility “ready for IT” gate, jointly with the Head of AI Cluster Commissioning, so commissioned data halls hand over cleanly to cluster bring-up.
  • Set the standard for handover to operations, including as-built documentation, training, known issues and operational readiness.
  • Work with Engineering & Technology, Construction/Delivery, Operations and the AI Infrastructure Platform (AIIP) teams to embed commissionability from concept design onwards.
  • Represent commissioning with executive leadership, customers, partners and key suppliers.

Commercial, Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Set the strategy for engaging third-party commissioning agents and oversee their commercial and delivery performance.
  • Own the commissioning budget and oversee schedule, cost and risk across the portfolio.
  • Drive the use of digital commissioning platforms, automation and data-driven validation, so each AI Factory is commissioned faster and more repeatably than the last.
  • Make sure design performance (PUE, thermal and resilience) is validated, and feed lessons learned back into Firmus’ AI Factory designs and standards.

Skills & Experience

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 12+ years’ experience in mission-critical or data centre environments, building on a foundation in engineering. This should include substantial experience leading commissioning programmes, typically after starting in engineering design, delivery or operations.
  • Proven experience leading and developing commissioning managers or multi-disciplinary commissioning teams across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Strong understanding of L1–L5 commissioning and IST for large-scale critical power, liquid and air cooling, and controls systems.
  • Experience building or maturing a commissioning function, methodology or standards in a growing organisation.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including budget ownership and managing commissioning agents, contractors and OEMs.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and report clearly and credibly to executive leadership.
  • A strong safety leadership record.
  • Ownership and delivery mindset.

Preferred Experience

  • Commissioning of high-density AI/HPC environments, including direct-to-chip liquid cooling combined with air-side cooling.
  • Experience with hyperscale or GPU cloud builds and the handover into IT/cluster commissioning.
  • Experience introducing digital commissioning platforms and automated testing.

title: Head of Finance (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Your mission

About L1VE

L1VE is a growing media and technology company with locations in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K, 3D and 360° streaming technologies and innovative live formats, L1VE is transforming the way people experience sports, music and entertainment.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a full-time Head of Finance to join us as soon as possible. In this role, you will take overall responsibility for the further development of our finance function in Germany and Europe and create the financial structures and decision-making foundations for L1VE’s next phase of growth.

Your Role

As Head of Finance, you will act as a strategic partner to our CFO in New York and the executive team. You will translate the overarching finance strategy into scalable finance, controlling and reporting structures, as well as robust planning and management models.

You will combine strategic foresight with strong execution skills: you will develop financial models and scenarios, evaluate business models, investments, partnerships and growth options, and make opportunities, risks and economic implications transparent to management.

In this role, you will work closely with the CFO, the executive team, functional departments and internal and external finance partners. A particular focus will be on international legal entity and intercompany structures, licensing and revenue-share models, as well as the further development of KPI, forecasting and reporting processes.

Your Responsibilities
  • Develop and implement L1VE’s finance architecture for Germany and Europe, with a focus on growth, profitability, transparency and international scalability
  • Own integrated financial planning, budgeting, business cases, financial models, forecasts and scenarios as a basis for strategic decision-making
  • Build and further develop relevant KPI systems for Technology, Commercial, Product, Marketing and Sales
  • Evaluate business models, investments, partnerships, licensing models and growth options, including their financial opportunities, risks and implications
  • Support financing rounds, investor readiness, due diligence and the preparation of strategic transactions in close coordination with the CFO
  • Manage and further develop management, investor and partner reporting based on reliable and auditable data and processes
  • Coordinate interfaces with Finance Administration, Accounting, Tax, Audit, Legal and other external finance partners
  • Further develop finance, reporting and governance structures, as well as the systems and processes supporting them
  • Lead the AI-driven transformation of the entire finance function, from planning and controlling to accounting and reporting, with clear governance and review steps.

Your profile

  • At least seven years of relevant professional experience in finance, including several years in a strategically responsible finance role – ideally combining experience in a demanding consulting or Big Four environment with hands-on experience in a startup, scale-up or growth company
  • Experience building scalable finance structures and working with integrated financial planning, business planning, financial modelling, forecasting and management reporting
  • Strong knowledge of controlling, business performance management, governance, risk management and the evaluation of business models, investments and growth options
  • Understanding of German commercial, tax and corporate law requirements, as well as experience managing external professional advisors
  • Ideally, experience in the media, entertainment, sports rights, streaming, subscription or digital B2C environment, including licensing and revenue-share models
  • Experience with financing processes, investor reporting, due diligence or M&A is an advantage
  • Ability to structure complex financial topics clearly and act as a strategic sparring partner to the CFO, executive team and functional departments
  • Strong analytical and entrepreneurial thinking, a high degree of independence and a strong sense of ownership
  • Confident and practical use of AI tools in finance; you can demonstrate with specific examples which AI-supported solutions you have implemented and what additional value they created
  • Proven experience in designing and running AI-supported finance processes across a full finance function, including integration with ERP and finance systems, controls and data protection (GDPR), and measurable impact.
  • Excellent written and spoken German and English is required (C1 or above), as well as confident use of finance, reporting and collaboration tools

Why us?

  • You will shape the financial foundations of the next growth phase of an internationally active media and technology company.
  • You will work closely with our CFO in New York and the executive team and have a direct strategic influence.
  • You will have significant room to shape your work, short decision-making paths and the opportunity to build structures and systems that create lasting value.
Interested?

Please send us your CV along with a short cover letter or a few sentences outlining your interest in L1VE and why you would be a strong fit for the Head of Finance role.
We look forward to hearing from you!

descriptionHtml:
Du baust Founder-Brands, die Deals schließen?

Dann baue zwei B2B-Founder-Brands von 0 auf, steuere LinkedIn & Funnel und werde direkt am erzeugten Umsatz beteiligt.

Das ist eine Senior-Rolle mit voller Verantwortung, direkt an der Seite der beiden Gründer.

Vor 5,5 Jahren saßen wir zu zweit in einer WG in Düsseldorf. Kein Büro, kein Umsatz, keine Kunden. Nur ein Telefon.

Heute sind wir 35 Leute auf knapp 900 m² Office. Rügamer & Steiner ist eine E-Mail- und CRM-Marketing-Agentur für E-Commerce: Wir helfen Onlineshops, mehr Umsatz aus ihren Bestandskunden zu holen – mit E-Mail-Marketing, WhatsApp, Printmailings und datengetriebenem CRM. Für über 150 Shops steuern wir so über 200 Mio. € Jahresumsatz mit. Unser eigener Umsatz liegt im mittleren einstelligen Millionenbereich und hat sich seit der Gründung jedes Jahr verdoppelt.

Alles davon ist aus Telefonaten entstanden. Kein Marketing, keine Brand, kein Content. Erst haben wir selbst telefoniert, heute tut es ein 6-köpfiges Sales-Team, das gerade auf 10 wächst.

Unser Haken: Uns kennt kein Mensch.

Das ändern wir jetzt. Bis 2028 wollen wir 30 Mio. € Jahresumsatz machen und europäischer Marktführer werden in dem, was wir tun. Für unsere Kunden wollen wir jedes Jahr über 1 Mrd. € Umsatz bewegen. Dafür brauchen wir Sichtbarkeit. Und dafür brauchen wir dich.

Das Material liegt bereit: eine echte Geschichte, Zahlen, Cases und zwei Gründer, die jedes Jahr über 300.000 € investieren, um von den Besten zu lernen – unter anderem in der höchsten Mastermind von Alex Hormozi.

Deine Mission

  • Du baust die Personal Brands von Noah Rügamer und Aurelian Steiner auf – zuerst auf LinkedIn, später Newsletter, YouTube und Podcast.

  • Du entwickelst Positionierung, Content-Strategie, Formate, Hooks und Redaktionsplan – mit Fokus auf E-Commerce-Unternehmer, die mehr aus ihren Bestandskunden holen wollen.

  • Du baust den Weg von Reichweite zu Umsatz: Post → Kommentar oder DM → Termin → Auftrag für unser Sales-Team.

  • Daneben schärfst du den Marketing-Auftritt der Firma mit: Website, Ads, Bewerber-Kommunikation. Das ist der kleinere Teil.

Was du mitbringen musst

  • Du hast nachweislich eine B2B-Founder-Brand aufgebaut oder mit aufgebaut – deine eigene oder als Ghostwriter, Stratege oder Head of Content.

  • Über diese Brand ist nachweislich Umsatz entstanden: mindestens 100.000 € im Monat, idealerweise 200.000 bis 300.000 €.

  • Idealerweise kommst du aus dem B2B-Dienstleister- oder Agentur-Umfeld oder hast selbst eine Agentur über Personal Branding skaliert. Bonus: E-Commerce, Marketing oder SaaS.

  • Du denkst in Zahlen, nicht in Likes: Impressions → Leads → Termine → Aufträge.

  • Du bist stark in Strategie und dir trotzdem nicht zu schade, selbst Hooks zu schreiben, Posts zu veröffentlichen und DMs aufzusetzen.

  • Du arbeitest vor Ort in Düsseldorf.

Was wir bieten

  • 7.000 bis 10.000 € Fixgehalt im Monat. Mit variabler Vergütung sind 25.000 € und mehr im Monat möglich. Deine Ergebnisse bestimmen dein Gehalt.

  • Mentoring von den Besten auf dem internationalen Markt: Für Masterminds, Mentorings und Beratung geben wir jedes Jahr über 300.000 € aus, unter anderem für die höchste Mastermind von Alex Hormozi. Du bekommst Zugriff auf alle Inhalte und kommst als Teilnehmer mit auf die Events.

  • Direkter Draht zu beiden Gründern, keine Politik, keine Konzernstrukturen.

  • Ein hochmotiviertes Team, in 5,5 Jahren von 2 auf 35 Leute gewachsen.

  • Apple-Ausstattung, Urban Sports, Benefit-Card, Parkplatz, Team-Events.

So bewirbst du dich

Lade deinen Lebenslauf hoch und beantworte drei kurze Fragen: Links zu 1–3 Founder-Brands, für die du verantwortlich warst, welcher Umsatz darüber entstanden ist (3–5 Zeilen mit Zahlen) und dein LinkedIn-Profil.

title: Head of Strategy and Product
descriptionHtml:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

 

What You Will Need

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

 

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

 

Interview Process

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

descriptionHtml:
Middelharnis, Netherlands | Thermoheat B.V.

Join Thermoheat B.V. and help shape the future of HR in an international industrial environment.

We are looking for a HR Generalist (m/f/d) to support and develop our HR processes across the Thermoheat Group. This is a part-time position (20–25 hours/week).

Company Overview

Thermoheat B.V. is an established company with over 40 years of experience in the refractory industry and part of the internationally active LOEWE Group, a family-owned business founded in 1962.

With locations in the Netherlands and Portugal, Thermoheat delivers tailor-made refractory solutions for industrial clients worldwide. Our core markets include petrochemical, steel, aluminum, non-ferrous metals, energy, waste incineration, ceramics and glass.

Our portfolio covers the full range of refractory products and services, including thermal seals, refractory pre-shapes, and passive fire protection systems, all from a single source.

We are VCA certified, ISO 9001:2015 compliant, and audited according to NEN 4400-1, ensuring the highest standards in quality, safety, and compliance.

You will take ownership of both operational HR tasks and strategic HR initiatives, working closely with management to strengthen our organization and people development.

HR Strategy & Policies

Operational HR Management


  • Advise management on HR-related topics

  • Maintain job descriptions, compensation structures and performance processes

HR Administration

Your Profile

What We Offer

  • Professional training and development opportunities
  • Flexible working conditions
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture
  • Long-term perspective within a family-owned industrial group

title: Inbound Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,  generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a “win as a team” environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara’s ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs’ understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Infrastructure Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

  • Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

  • Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

You are the bridge between detailed infrastructure planning and the single integrated master schedule that governs Alpha's delivery. Without dedicated infrastructure schedule ownership, dependencies like infrastructure readiness for the magnet factory (drainage, cryo supply, extraction systems) quietly fall behind because nobody owns translating detailed site-level planning into the program-level view leadership actually uses to make decisions. You make sure that never happens by accident.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own and actively manage all infrastructure and siting project schedules across Alpha and Stellaris - buildings, utilities, permitting milestones, and site readiness

  • Translate infrastructure -specific schedule detail into validated, structured inputs for the Master Scheduler's integrated master schedule, ensuring infrastructure milestones, dependencies, and readiness dates are correctly reflected

  • Identify infrastructure -specific critical path items and interdependencies - for example, infrastructure readiness depending on equipment or magnet-line arrival dates - and flag risks early

  • Partner closely with the Master Scheduler, Risk & Change Manager, and Individual Project Managers (Alpha Construction Project Manager, Site Development Program Manager's team) to keep infrastructure schedules and the integrated timeline in sync

  • Maintain infrastructure milestone governance discipline across all programs, ensuring consistent coding and leveling conventions

  • Support gate-readiness by preparing infrastructure-specific schedule status inputs ahead of release gate decisions

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experienced in managing infrastructure or site development schedules on complex capital programs, ideally spanning multiple sites or projects in parallel

  • Comfortable working with a federated schedule structure - translating detailed infrastructure planning into a broader integrated programme view

  • Strong cross-functional communicator, able to align site project managers and technical teams with the Master Scheduler's baseline

  • Fluent in English; German is a strong advantage given the permitting and contractor landscape]

  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-scaling, still-being-built environment

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (60 min)

  • Technical Panel (2x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Intern Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

💻 Intern Engineer📍London (Hybrid, 60% in office) 💸 £30,000 pro-rata + Benefits

About the Internship

This is Trainline’s 3rd consecutive year running a software engineering internship scheme and following from last year’s success, we’re excited to speak to more up and coming emerging talent to work on real world projects that will give them the experience and exposure to set themselves up for future success.

As an Intern Engineer, you would work embedded in one of our 40+ engineering teams. Your manager or mentor within the team will assign you a self-contained project with real business impact. You will be tasked with delivering this project within your internship, with support from your manager, mentor and wider team.

As part of our commitment to your growth, we have tailored a technical onboarding curriculum to ensure you’re set up for success. All interns will be onboarded together during the first week, where they’ll receive targeted technical training designed to fill any knowledge gaps and introduce Trainline’s ways of working. This ensures that you’ll be ready to hit the ground running when you join your team and start contributing to your project right away. Additionally, you’ll have continuous support throughout your internship, including access to learning resources, regular check-ins with your manager, and the opportunity to grow through hands-on experience.

As a team member in one of our engineering teams, you will work within our agile processes, iterating on delivery of your project and take part in the team’s scrum ceremonies.

title: Internship
descriptionHtml:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

This is a 4-month program: 3 months in Berlin, 1 month in New York. You’ll join one of our tracks (CEO Office, Growth, Product, Ops or Talent) and own real work from day one. Like everyone at Augustus, you’ll run day-to-day work in parallel with one or two larger projects.


Recent projects run by interns:

  • Rebuilt our talent engine and cut time-to-fill from 82 days to 34.

  • Took a new product from first customer call to production launch.

  • Relaunched our CRM to drive data accuracy.

  • Built the sales case behind our largest deals.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You are low ego and ready to jump in where you are needed most.

  • You build your personal AI stack that optimizes your productivity and you treat new AI tools as defaults, not curiosities.

  • You can build workflows in n8n/zapier/make.

  • You are comfortable talking to senior leaders, external partners, and candidates from day one.

  • You are genuinely excited about what we are building.

This is not for you if:

  • You only want to work on strategic projects.

  • You need to know exactly what you will be working on before you join.

  • You are looking for a 9-5 role.

Hard Requirements

  • You are currently pursuing or have obtained a Bachelor's or Master's degree from a stellar institution.

  • You have 1-2 previous internships or roles in high-growth startups, venture capital, or consulting and/or you have demonstrated initiative through side projects, student organizations, research, or entrepreneurial experiences.

  • You are available for 4 months.

  • Based in Berlin or willing to relocate.

What You Get

Who you'll learn from:

  • Every intern is mentored by a founder or executive.

  • A peer buddy for day-to-day questions.

  • A 1:1 with one of our VC investors or angels.

Your setup:

  • A dedicated stipend covering unlimited AI token usage for your work.

What comes after:

  • Exceed our expectations and you can convert to full-time, or stay on as a working student.

 

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

  • Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.

  • Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status.

title: Investment Analyst (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über die Rolle

Eine gute Kaufentscheidung beginnt damit, dass jemand genau hinsieht. Bei Buena bist du das: Du verstehst das Unternehmen, hinterfragst Annahmen, erkennst Risiken und begründest, welchen Preis wir zahlen sollten.

Du verantwortest die Due Diligence für Hausverwaltungen, die wir übernehmen möchten: von der ersten Sichtung des Datenraums über die Bewertung und die Präsentation im Investment Committee bis zu den finanziellen und operativen Anlagen für den Kaufvertrag. Wenn das Committee ins Detail geht, kennst du das Unternehmen und kannst deine Empfehlung fundiert begründen.

Unser Prozess steht. Jetzt suchen wir jemanden, der die Verantwortung für die Qualität der Analysen übernimmt, die Due Diligence eigenständig steuert und unseren Prozess mit dem Wachstum weiterentwickelt.

Über Buena

Buena übernimmt Hausverwaltungen und digitalisiert sie mit selbst entwickelter Software. Wir verbinden Akquisitionen, operative Erfahrung und Technologie, um Immobilieneigentum und Verwaltung einfacher zu machen.

M&A ist ein zentraler Teil dieser Strategie. Die Unternehmen, die wir kaufen, werden Teil von Buena. Deshalb zählt unser Verständnis ihrer Zahlen, Verträge, Teams und Abläufe weit über den Abschluss einer Transaktion hinaus.

Deine Verantwortung

  • Das Unternehmen hinter dem Datenraum verstehen. Du führst Finanzdaten, Verträge, Objektlisten und Mitarbeiterinformationen zusammen. Du erkennst Lücken, gehst Widersprüchen nach und klärst offene Fragen mit den Verkäufern, bis ein belastbares Gesamtbild entsteht.

  • Die Bewertung fundiert herleiten. Du analysierst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung, arbeitest mit unseren Kaufpreismodellen und prüfst die zugrunde liegenden Annahmen. Du zeigst, was deine Erkenntnisse für den Kaufpreis und die Investitionsentscheidung bedeuten.

  • Deine Ergebnisse im Investment Committee vertreten. Du verdichtest die Due Diligence zu einer klaren Einschätzung von Chancen, Risiken und offenen Fragen und präsentierst sie direkt vor den Entscheidungsträgern.

  • Die Details bis zum Closing begleiten. Gemeinsam mit unserem M&A-Anwalt bereitest du die finanziellen und operativen Anlagen zum Kaufvertrag vor und stellst sicher, dass die Angaben stimmen.

  • Für die Qualität einstehen. Du prüfst die Beiträge unserer Praktikant, erkennst Fehler frühzeitig und übernimmst Verantwortung für die fertige Analyse.

  • Den Prozess weiterentwickeln. Du lernst unsere Playbooks kennen, setzt sie sorgfältig um und bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir Datenräume, Analysen und Entscheidungen besser organisieren können.

Du passt gut zu uns wenn

  • Du bereits an Transaktionen gearbeitet hast. Idealerweise bringst du ein bis zwei Jahre Erfahrung als Analyst im Transaktionsumfeld, bei Private Equity oder Venture Capital mit. Auch fundierte Praktikumserfahrung kann relevant sein. Entscheidend ist, wie tief du in die Arbeit eingestiegen bist und welche Verantwortung du dir jetzt zutraust.

  • Deine analytischen Grundlagen sitzen. Du bist sicher in Excel, kannst Finanzdaten interpretieren und verstehst Bewertungskonzepte wie Equity Bridge und Discounted-Cashflow-Analyse.

  • Du den entscheidenden Details nachgehst. Eine Zahl, die sich nicht nachvollziehen lässt, oder eine Vertragsklausel mit unerwarteten Folgen ist für dich ein Grund, genauer hinzusehen.

  • Du dein Urteil erklären kannst. Du gehst souverän mit Rückfragen um, unterscheidest belastbare Erkenntnisse von Annahmen und änderst deine Einschätzung, wenn neue Informationen es erfordern.

  • Du Verantwortung übernimmst. Du hältst den Prozess in Bewegung, verfolgst offene Punkte konsequent und holst dir Unterstützung, wenn sie gebraucht wird.

  • Du dich in einem direkten, informellen Umfeld wohlfühlst. Du bringst sorgfältiges Arbeiten aus dem Transaktionsumfeld in ein Startup ein und gestaltest mit, wie wir arbeiten.

Die Besonderheiten von Hausverwaltungen und unsere internen Abläufe kannst du bei uns lernen. Startup-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung.

Warum Buena

Früh eigene Verantwortung übernehmen. Du begleitest deine Targets durch die Due Diligence und stehst für die Ergebnisse ein. Deine Analysen fließen direkt in konkrete Kaufentscheidungen ein.

Direkt mit den Entscheidungsträgern arbeiten. Du präsentierst im Investment Committee und arbeitest eng mit Kolleg aus M&A, Legal und Operations zusammen.

Mit jeder Transaktion dazulernen. Unsere volle Pipeline bietet dir immer wieder die Gelegenheit, Unternehmen zu verstehen, Risiken zu bewerten und zu sehen, wie deine Erkenntnisse einen Deal beeinflussen.

Mitgestalten wie wir Unternehmen kaufen. Unser Prozess ist strukturiert und lässt sich weiter verbessern. Sobald du ihn kennst, hast du den Freiraum, einzelne Schritte zu hinterfragen und bessere Lösungen vorzuschlagen.

So lernen wir uns kennen

Wir sprechen über deine Transaktionserfahrung, deine Herangehensweise an Due Diligence und die Verantwortung, die du als Nächstes übernehmen möchtest. Anschließend bearbeitest du einen praxisnahen Case und lernst das Team kennen, auch bei einem gemeinsamen Mittag- oder Abendessen. Referenzgespräche sind Teil der abschließenden Phase.

Du möchtest die Due Diligence hinter Buenas nächsten Akquisitionen verantworten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: IT-Systemadministrator
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes IT-Systemhaus in Chemnitz und betreuen seit 2016 die IT von Geschäftskunden – vom Arbeitsplatz über Microsoft 365 und Server bis zu Netzwerk, Security und Cloud.

Wir suchen jemanden für den First und Second Level Support unserer Kunden. Nicht als Dauerposition am unteren Ende einer Support-Pyramide, sondern als Einstieg, aus dem sich in den nächsten Jahren eigene Kunden und eigene Fachthemen entwickeln sollen.

Was dieser Job ist, steht unten. Was er nicht ist, auch.

Aufgaben

  • Du nimmst Störungen unserer Geschäftskunden an – per Telefon, per Remote-Support und bei Bedarf vor Ort beim Kunden.
  • Du analysierst, priorisierst und löst eigenständig: Arbeitsplätze, Windows Clients und Server, Microsoft 365, Benutzer und Berechtigungen, Netzwerk, Drucker, Software, sonstige Infrastruktur.
  • Du dokumentierst nachvollziehbar im Ticketsystem. Nicht für die Statistik, sondern damit die Kollegin oder der Kollege nach dir nicht bei null anfängt.
  • Du kommunizierst mit Anwendern, die keine IT-Leute sind – verständlich und ohne sie dumm dastehen zu lassen.
  • Wenn du nicht weiterkommst, eskalierst du an unsere Engineers. Aber vollständig: Fehlerbild, deine Analyse, was du schon probiert hast.

Wie sich das entwickelt

Bei uns ist First Level kein Endzustand.

Je sicherer du in einem Thema wirst, desto mehr davon bekommst du. Konkret heißt das: zuerst einzelne Second-Level-Themen, dann Verantwortung für feste Kunden, dann ein eigener technischer Schwerpunkt – zum Beispiel Netzwerk, Microsoft 365, Server, Firewall oder Cloud.

Wie schnell das geht, hängt an dir, nicht an einer Beförderungsstufe im Organigramm. Wer zuverlässig arbeitet, bekommt bei uns mehr Entscheidungsspielraum, nicht mehr Kontrolle. Welche Weiterbildung du machst, besprechen wir nach Bedarf und Interesse, nicht nach Katalog.

Qualifikation

  • Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich, z. B. als Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration – oder vergleichbare praktische Berufserfahrung.
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft-Umgebungen: Windows Clients und Server, Microsoft 365.
  • Ein solides Grundverständnis von Netzwerken: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, VPN.
  • Eine strukturierte Fehleranalyse. Du rätst nicht, du grenzt ein.
  • Führerschein Klasse B für Kundeneinsätze.

Von Vorteil, aber keine Bedingung:
Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen, Remote-Support und Benutzer- und Rechteverwaltung; Kenntnisse in Firewall, Virtualisierung, Backup, Monitoring oder Cloud.

Was wir ausdrücklich nicht voraussetzen:
Eine lange Liste an Zertifikaten. Uns interessiert, ob du ein Problem sauber eingrenzen kannst und ob du sagst, wenn du etwas nicht weißt. Beides lässt sich in einem Gespräch schneller klären als über Kürzel im Lebenslauf.

Benefits

Entwicklung statt Stillstand:
Mit wachsender Kompetenz übernimmst du anspruchsvollere Aufgaben, eigene Kunden und einen eigenen technischen Schwerpunkt.

Entscheidungen ohne Umweg:
Wenn du etwas verändern willst, sprichst du direkt mit der Geschäftsführung. Nicht mit drei Instanzen dazwischen.

Weiterbildung nach deinem Bedarf:
individuell abgestimmt, nicht als Pflichtprogramm.

Firmenwagen oder JobRad nach Vereinbarung.

Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung. Individuelle Situationen regeln wir individuell, nicht nach Schema F.

Unterschiedliche Kunden und IT-Umgebungen statt einer einzigen Infrastruktur, die du nach zwei Jahren auswendig kennst.

Die IT-High-Systems Technology GmbH ist ein inhabergeführtes IT-Systemhaus aus Chemnitz. Seit 2016 begleiten wir Geschäftskunden beim Aufbau, Betrieb und der Weiterentwicklung ihrer IT-Infrastruktur. Aus der klassischen IT-Betreuung ist über die Jahre ein Portfolio aus Managed Services, Cloud-Lösungen, IT-Security, Kommunikation und ganzheitlicher Infrastrukturbetreuung geworden.

Unser Anspruch: IT, die unseren Kunden Arbeit abnimmt, statt neue Probleme zu schaffen. Technik ist für uns kein Selbstzweck. Unsere Lösungen sollen sicher, zuverlässig und für Anwender verständlich sein.

Intern arbeiten wir nach denselben Maßstäben: Ehrlichkeit, Verlässlichkeit, Verantwortung. Probleme werden offen angesprochen. Prozesse entstehen nicht ausschließlich von oben – wer Verbesserungspotenzial sieht, arbeitet an der Lösung mit.
