title: Junior Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
We help churches develop. Behind every church are people who give their time and heart to their community, and we want to make their work easier. Our software brings administration and communication together in one platform, so there’s less time for paperwork and more time for people.

More than 10,000 churches across Europe work with ChurchDesk, and together with Hagru we’re now growing fast in the Netherlands. Our Groningen team is at the heart of that growth, and we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with it.

Is this you?
You’ve just graduated or are about to, or you have your first work experience behind you. You love talking to people, you’re curious, and you want a job where you learn fast and see the results of your work. You don’t need years of sales experience. We’ll teach you how to sell. What we’re looking for is your energy, your curiosity and your drive to grow.

About your new role

  • Open doors: You reach out to churches and congregations across the Netherlands that don’t use ChurchDesk or Hagru yet.

  • Start real conversations: You learn about their daily work, their challenges and their plans, and show them how our platform can make life easier.

  • Own the process: You guide churches from the first conversation all the way to signing, and you hand them over smoothly to onboarding.

  • Present with confidence: You present ChurchDesk to church councils, staff and volunteers, online and in person.

  • Build relationships: You become a trusted partner in the Dutch church landscape and build relationships that last.

  • Learn every day: With training in consultative selling and your own coach, you’ll quickly develop into a confident sales professional.


  • A degree (or soon one) in any field, for example business, communication, theology or social sciences, or first work experience in a people-facing role.

  • First sales or customer experience is a plus, for example from a student job, an internship or a study association, but it’s not a must.

  • You’re outgoing, enjoy talking to new people and don’t give up easily.

  • You’re structured, take ownership and like working towards clear goals.

  • Fluent Dutch and good English, plus strong communication skills in conversations and in writing.

  • A connection to church life, whether through your own church, volunteering or a student association, is a real plus.

What We Offer

  • A great start to your career: Training in consultative selling and a dedicated coach who helps you grow.

  • Real responsibility from day one in a growing international tech company.

  • Open feedback culture: We’re transparent, supportive and learn from each other.

  • 30 days of vacation, because rest matters.

  • Trust and flexibility: We focus on results, not on counting hours, with a Scandinavian focus on balance.

  • Fancy a change of scenery? Visit our offices in Copenhagen, Berlin or Oslo, with travel and expenses covered.

  • Unforgettable team experiences: company events, sailing trips in Croatia, ski trips and visits to our Berlin office.

  • A diverse team of different nationalities, ages and backgrounds, and a great office crew in Groningen.

Ready to start?
Apply with your CV. A cover letter is optional, but we’d love to hear in a few lines why you want to start your career in sales with us. We look forward to meeting you!

About ChurchDesk

At ChurchDesk, we believe that the church plays an important role in society. Our platform is used by thousands of congregations to organise their work, improve communication with members, reach more people, and unlock new ways of fundraising.
Our customers are part of one of the largest and oldest institutions in the world: the Church. It is undergoing significant change to prepare for the future — and we are here to support that transformation. For churches across Europe, it is crucial to work more efficiently and stay connected to their members and communities.

ChurchDesk has been around for more than 15 years — evolving from a startup into an international company serving customers across Europe. And we’re just getting started!

We actively live our values in our daily work:

#challenge: We challenge ourselves — and our customers — to continuously improve. We work like a professional sports team: with ambition, discipline, and strong team spirit.

#dogoodbusiness: Doing good business is a marathon, not a sprint. It requires endurance, quality, and integrity — every single day.

#jointheride: The journey matters just as much as the destination. Be part of it, celebrate successes — and have fun! We value being together, especially in the office.

title: Junior Quantum Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a Junior Quantum Design Engineer, you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing.


What you'll be doing

  • Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines.

  • Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs.

  • Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints.

  • Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations.

  • Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust.


Your Profile

  • MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a concentration in Quantum Computing or Quantum Technology (PhD is a plus).

  • Understanding of microwave engineering, circuit theory, or superconducting devices, gained through coursework, a thesis project, or an internship.

  • Experience with EM simulation tools (e.g. HFSS, Q3D, Sonnet) and layout tools (e.g. KLayout, Qiskit Metal).

  • Python skills for design automation, simulation workflows, or data analysis.

  • Detail-oriented mindset with a structured approach to design, verification, and documentation.

  • Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow within a fast-moving, multidisciplinary team.

  • Familiarity with superconducting qubits, circuit quantisation, or cleanroom fabrication processes is a plus.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

title: Laboratory Technician
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.

Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development.

In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100.

At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today.

The Role & Key Responsibilities

The hands of the Trillion Gene Atlas. You will keep samples moving through our extraction, normalisation, and library preparation pipeline - precisely, reliably, and at pace.

  • Run the daily sample processing pipeline. Execute DNA extraction, normalisation, and library preparation workflows across soil, faecal, and other environmental sample types - following validated SOPs with precision and consistency at high throughput.

  • Operate and maintain laboratory automation.Work with automated liquid handling systems (including Myra9) and other platforms to process samples at batch scale. Perform routine maintenance, troubleshoot instrument issues, and flag deviations from expected performance.

  • Maintain accurate records in LIMS. Log all sample processing steps, QC data, and observations in Benchling LIMS in real time. Ensure full traceability of every sample from receipt through to sequencing dispatch.

  • Perform QC checks and flag anomalies. Carry out quantification, quality checks, and standard analytical assays at key pipeline stages. Identify out-of-specification results, escalate appropriately, and contribute to root cause investigations.

  • Support R&D protocol testing. Assist the R&D team with comparative experiments, kit testing, and protocol optimisation runs as new methods are validated for production. A practical, hands-on contributor to continuous improvement.

  • Maintain a safe, organised lab environment. Uphold high standards of lab hygiene, reagent management, and safety compliance including CL2 working practices. Help keep the lab stocked, organised, and ready to run at scale.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Hands-on laboratory experience in a molecular biology or life sciences setting - academic, commercial, or both

  • Practical experience with DNA extraction from biological or environmental samples using kit-based and automated methods

  • Comfortable working at high throughput with strong attention to detail - precise pipetting, consistent technique, reliable record-keeping

  • Experience using LIMS or equivalent electronic lab notebook for sample tracking and data recording

  • Ability to follow SOPs accurately, identify deviations, and escalate clearly and promptly

Advantageous Skills and Experience

  • Experience operating automated liquid handling platforms (Hamilton, Tecan, Bravo, or similar)

  • Familiarity with NGS library preparation workflows - even a basic awareness of steps from DNA input to sequencing-ready library

  • Experience with environmental or metagenomic sample types - soils, sediments, faecal, or other challenging matrices

  • CL2 lab certification or prior experience working with GMOs in a contained environment

  • A curiosity about sequencing technology and genuine interest in learning and growing within a fast-moving team

What we offer in return

Impactful Mission: This is a rare chance to do work that genuinely matters. You'll join a talented, fast-moving team, access unique biological datasets at scale, and see your contributions shape real breakthroughs in AI and curative therapeutics.

Collaborative Culture: You'll be surrounded by world-class engineers, scientists, and researchers who care deeply about their work and about each other. With offices in London and Boston, we've built a flexible, cross-functional environment where personal development and real ownership aren't just talking points.

High Growth: We truly believe in investing in our people. We make coaching available to team members during steep growth journeys and we have twice-yearly promotion opportunities. People who are really successful here own it and go directly to solve problems at pace, and we ensure reward increases with impact.

Comprehensive Benefits: We've built a benefits package people value. That means competitive salary, equity, and private healthcare with no medical history exclusions - so strong that most employees' family members opt into our plan over their own. We also offer Carrot Fertility with IVF stipend, salary sacrifice pension, bike-to-work scheme, life insurance, and more.

We are committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of ethnic or national origin, race, religion, sex, age, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, gender identity or any other basis. If you have a disability or additional need that needs accommodating do let us know.

title: Lead/Principal Machine Learning Scientist - Recommendation Systems
descriptionHtml:
About Tripadvisor 

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

About the role:

As a Principal Machine Learning Scientist, you will be the technical anchor for our core discovery engine. You will lead the machine learning strategy and execution that powers how millions of users search for, discover, and organize their complex travel itineraries. This is a high-impact role bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI research and production-grade engineering, directly influencing multi-objective business outcomes like user engagement, booking conversion, etc.

You will tackle complex, ambiguous problems at the intersection of deep multi-task ranking, sequential user modeling, and graph-based travel recommendations. If you are passionate about building state-of-the-art AI systems and mentoring a high-performing team of scientists, this role is for you

What You'll Do

  • Technical Leadership & Execution: Drive the technical roadmap for Search, Retrieval, Ranking, and Recommendation systems within the Trips vertical. Translate high-level business goals into concrete ML architectures and scalable production systems.
  • Advanced Algorithm Innovation: Design, prototype, and scale next-generation recommendation and ranking models. Solve complex, non-linear travel journeys by utilizing sequential recommenders, representation learning, and deep multi-objective frameworks.
  • System Architecture & Scalability: Oversee the deployment of low-latency, high-throughput retrieval and ranking pipelines (e.g., multi-stage retrieval, vector search) capable of processing billions of travel data points (reviews, photos, bookings, user intent) in real-time.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads, and Data Science peers to optimize multi-task business objectives simultaneously. Act as the primary technical authority for ML initiatives within the Trips vertical.
  • Talent Multiplier: Mentor and coach senior and mid-level ML scientists. Foster a culture of technical excellence, driving best practices for MLOps, rigorous A/B testing, data privacy, and code quality.

Skills & Experience:

  • Education: Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a highly quantitative field.
  • Experience: 10+ years of industry experience developing and deploying large-scale ML models in a production environment, with a proven track record of shipping systems at the scale of millions of active users.
  • Core Technical Expertise: Deep theoretical and practical knowledge in the following areas:
    • SOTA Retrieval & Ranking: Practical experience with Multi-Task Learning (MTL), Multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts (MMoE), or similar architectures optimized for multi-objective optimization.
    • Sequential & Temporal Modeling: Hands-on experience building sequential recommendation systems that capture real-time user session dynamics and long-term historical preferences.
    • Advanced Representation Learning: Deep understanding of embedding generation, deep semantic retrieval, and multi-modal representation learning.
  • Technical Stack: Mastery of Python and deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) alongside hands-on experience with distributed computing (Spark, Ray) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).

Desired:

  • Graph Neural Networks (GNNs): Strong experience applying GNNs, knowledge graphs, or graph embeddings to map complex relations between travel entities (e.g., users, destinations, itineraries, points of interest).
  • Agentic AI & Generative AI: Familiarity with Agentic AI frameworks, LLM-driven reasoning, or autonomous planning agents to enhance conversational search and automated itinerary generation.
  • Experience working in E-commerce, Travel Tech, or Two-Sided Marketplaces, specifically handling non-linear user journeys and highly constrained inventory (e.g., hotel availability, tour timings).
  • A strong track record of academic or industry contributions, including publications in top-tier AI/IR conferences (e.g., SIGIR, KDD, RecSys, NeurIPS) or open-source ML contributions.

What We Offer 

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars:

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us. 

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges. 

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

descriptionHtml:
Notre équipe "demand & commercialisation" recherche un·e LEAD SUPPORT ENGINEER. 

Au sein de la Business Unit PRISM, notre équipe recherche un Responsable de l'Animation du Support (h/f/d) pour accompagner et animer le processus de Sélection Pays sur l'ensemble de la chaîne, au sein des équipes Demand Pre-Season & commercialisation.
Le processus de Sélection Pays commence par le choix des produits, la définition de la gamme et les prévisions initiales, suivis du sourcing fournisseurs, de la synthèse économique et de la validation officielle de l'offre. Une fois validé, les parties prenantes finalisent le contrat Sales & Operations, s'engageant sur les quantités et les prix convenus, ce qui déclenche au final le lancement de la production et les ordres de fabrication dans SAP. Cela constitue le périmètre principal d'animation de bout en bout avec les parties prenantes Métier, Produit, Ingestion/Engineering et Data.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION 

Vous agissez au quotidien au service de nos utilisateurs métiers pour garantir que le processus de sélection est stable sur l'ensemble de la chaîne à différentes périodes.
Vos missions s'articulent autour de de ces axes principaux :

  • Animation du collectif: Il vous est demandé d'animer l'activité de support, et pas seulement de résoudre des tickets, et cela à travers une posture de leader épaulant l'ingénieur manager à la gestion du collectif support de l’équipe.

  • Support & Excellence Opérationnelle (Run) : Recevoir, analyser et animer les incidents / tickets fonctionnels et techniques tout au long du processus de sélection pays, en respectant des SLA et OLA stricts. 

  • Analyse des flux & Process Discovery : Investiguer les causes racines des écarts de flux ou de données le long de la frise fonctionnelle (de la stratégie à l'exécution métier), construire des tableaux de bord de monitoring et SRE, et offrir une visibilité de bout en bout du processus avec les impacts et goulets d'étranglement existants.

  • Assurer les campagnes de test de non régression: durant les sprints (3 semaines) ou les versions, vous devrez mettre en place une stratégie de test englobant tous nos processus.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Savoir-être (Soft Skills) : Leadership et grande curiosité fonctionnelle pour naviguer dans les processus de sélection pays de bout en bout à travers les équipes, le domaine et la business unit digitale, de fortes compétences en organisation, communication, ainsi qu'un esprit orienté client.

  • Compétences Métier : Compréhension de base de la Supply chain ainsi que les modules logistiques et retail de SAP, pour monter rapidement en compétences sur le processus de sélection.

STACK TECHNIQUE

  • ERP : SAP ECC, FMS, APO, APR, applications OpenStack
  • Flux & Données : API, KAFKA
  • Monitoring & Ordonnancement : Datadog/Splunk (monitoring) & Automic (ordonnanceur)
  • Compétences IA : Curiosité et connaissances IA sont un plus.
  • ITSM & Ticketing : SMAX, Jira

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

Organisation de travail hybride (3 jours en présentiel & 2 jours en télétravail) ;

Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;

Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;

Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;

Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.

Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire de candidature, celle-ci sera confidentielle. Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement"

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

descriptionHtml:
Lead UX/UI Designer

Fixed-term contract 6 months (maternity cover)

London — hybrid, with regular presence in our London office

Delta Capita is a global provider of managed services, technology and consulting to the financial services industry. Design sits at the centre of how we build our products. Our team shapes the interfaces our clients and their customers use every day.

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Lead UX/UI Designer to cover a 6-month period of maternity leave, starting November 2026 and based in our London office. You will own the design of complex, multi-stakeholder products end to end - from early problem solving through to prototypes and production-ready UI. You’ll work closely with engineering and product teams on a day-to-day basis, with support from senior stakeholders as needed.

You will be comfortable making confident design decisions, shipping in short cycles, and iterating once real feedback arrives.You will be responsible for leading other junior designers in the team, to make help them make decisions, give feedback and make sure work is delivered to a high standard and on time.


Key responsibilities

  • Own complex projects end to end. Take full design accountability for one or more product workstreams, from early discovery through wireframes, prototypes and final UI specification.

  • Design and prototype. Produce interactive prototypes in Sketch to test flows, validate concepts with users and align stakeholders before build.

  • Run and facilitate workshops. Across teams and features, driving strategic alignment.

  • Maintain and evolve the design system. Extend our component library and design standards so that work across the team stays consistent, accessible and reusable.

  • Support junior designers. Set direction, review work, run critique sessions and support the day-to-day development of junior members of the design team.

  • Partner with product and engineering. Work closely with product managers to shape requirements, and with developers to ensure designs are implemented faithfully and are technically feasible.

  • Deliver at pace. Prioritise, break large problems into shippable increments and keep momentum across parallel workstreams.

  • Uphold accessibility and quality. Ensure designs meet WCAG 2.2 AA standards and our internal quality bar before handover.

Essential skills and experience

  • Proven track record as a lead UX/UI designer, with a portfolio demonstrating ownership of complex, large-scale digital products.

  • Advanced working knowledge of Sketch, including symbols, libraries and shared styles.

  • Strong prototyping ability - you can move from a rough concept to a testable interactive prototype quickly.

  • Demonstrable experience mentoring or line-managing junior designers.

  • Confident collaborating with product managers, engineers, business stakeholders and, where relevant, clients.

  • Evidence of delivering high-quality work at pace in an agile environment.

  • Excellent communication skills - you can explain and defend design decisions to non-designers.

  • Right to work in the UK (we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this fixed-term role).

Nice to have

  • Previous experience designing for fintech, banking or another regulated financial services environment.

  • Familiarity with Sketch

  • Exposure to enterprise or B2B products with dense interfaces and complex workflows.

  • Experience running user research and usability testing directly.

title: Manager I, Applied AI - Distilled Models
descriptionHtml:
Applied AI is where Datadog's ambitious AI bets get built and shipped (Bits Chat, updog). We sit at the intersection of research and product: turning promising capabilities from Datadog AI Research lab and the research community into production systems that reach real customers. The team builds specialized models that replace frontier models where they are not necessary, making AI capabilities faster, cheaper, and more secure. The mandate is to move fast from idea to customer impact, and when a product finds its footing, to set it up for growth.

As a Manager I in Applied AI, you will lead a team of engineers and applied scientists working on one of these challenges. You will define technical direction, run short feedback loops, make deliberate decisions about what to pursue or stop, and work closely with product managers, research teams, and cross-functional partners to ship AI capabilities that matter.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture, the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do 

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers and applied scientists focused on cost-efficient specialized models and AI security capabilities
  • Work closely with product managers, research teams, and cross-functional partners to shape the team's bets from initial framing through to broader adoption, with a clear definition of success criteria at each stage
  • Own end-to-end delivery of high-quality AI systems, from early research exploration to production-grade reliability, with high standards for operational excellence, system reliability, and technical quality
  • Navigate the unique challenges of shipping AI-powered products: balancing quality, latency, cost, and safety considerations. Drive evaluation and iteration practices for AI systems: define the quality bar and guide the team in building the offline and online evaluation pipelines needed to measure quality and detect drift
  • Contribute to cross-team collaboration and knowledge sharing across the broader AI organization
  • Support career growth for engineers through coaching, feedback, and fostering a culture of experimentation, innovation, and learning. Participate in hiring and help shape the future team as the organization grows

Who You Are

  • A people-focused manager with experience leading and mentoring engineers, able to develop strong engineering talent in a fast-moving domain
  • A technical leader with deep expertise in one or more areas of AI or machine learning: large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, agentic systems, deep learning, or NLP
  • Well-versed in evaluation methodologies for AI systems, both offline benchmarks and online metrics
  • A strong product instinct: able to anchor early-stage work in concrete customer problems, define success criteria before writing code, and actively contribute to shaping product direction alongside product and research partners
  • Experience taking AI products from 0 to 1 is strongly valued: able to bring structure to early-stage work by scoping clear hypotheses, moving quickly toward signal, and making deliberate decisions about what to pursue, pivot, or stop
  • BS/MS/PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent professional experience

#LI-Hybrid

About Datadog: 

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

title: Manager of SME Account Management - Manchester
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

 

YOUR MISSION

We are looking for a high-impact Manager for our SME Account Management to lead, develop, and inspire a team responsible for driving dealer performance and growth. This role is critical in shaping team culture, delivering against departmental objectives, and ensuring our partners maximise value from our platform.

You will balance people leadership, operational excellence, and commercial impact, empowering your team to perform at their best while contributing to strategic direction and ongoing business performance.

title: Marketing Specialist
descriptionHtml:

Our international team is based across France, Spain, and the United States, and our vision is backed by six international investment funds.

You will be part of a growing team where you’ll have the opportunity to shape how we present our brand and reach new audiences. Localisation, Multilingual Adaptation & Content Rollout

title: Master Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

Master Data Engineer

As our Master Data Engineer, you own the accuracy and integrity of the master data behind every Aletta we build: items, bills of materials (BOMs), revisions and routings in our ERP system. You translate the engineering BOM released by R&D into the manufacturing BOM for products, sub-assemblies and spare parts. You also own the change control process between Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain, from the first change request to the verified change in the build. This is a newly created role in our Operations team.

First months at Vitestro

In your first months, your focus will be on two things. First, you set up the change process end to end: from an engineering change to its implementation in the build, including the impact on time and cost. You register changes, organize the impact assessment with Operations, Supply Chain and Quality, chair the change review board, and define effectivity and the disposition of existing stock. Second, you build the manufacturing BOMs for our products from the engineering BOMs. You structure sub-assemblies to match the assembly sequence, add consumables, packaging, labels, kitting and the make/buy split, and set up spare-part and service BOMs together with Service. Along the way, you define how system and module upgrades are managed through the BOM.

You become the single point of contact for master data and change implementation. You make sure every build uses the correct released configuration, so that each Device History Record traces back to the Device Master Record.

This is what success looks like:

After 12 months, engineering changes run through one controlled process, and every change is implemented, verified in the first build and closed in the change record. Product and spare-part BOMs are free of errors, and master data is audit-ready under ISO 13485. Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain know where a change stands and when it reaches the build. Regular comparisons between E-BOM, M-BOM and as-built show no open discrepancies.

You thrive at the intersection of engineering and operations. You are precise and process-minded, you keep the discipline when others are in a hurry, and you are comfortable holding a change that isn't ready yet.


What You’ll Bring:

  • A bachelor's or master's background in Mechanical, Mechatronics or Industrial Engineering, or a similar technical field

  • 3+ years in master data, BOM, configuration or engineering change management in a manufacturing environment, preferably MedTech or high-tech

  • Experience with an ERP system, such as Odoo, SAP or Exact

  • Solid understanding of E-BOM and M-BOM structures, item lifecycle and revision control

  • Strong ability to align cross-functional stakeholders and keep process discipline

  • Comfortable working with detail: analytical, accurate and process-minded

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Fluent in English

Nice to have:

  • Experience in a regulated environment (ISO 13485, DMR/DHR, design transfer)

  • Familiarity with a PLM system

  • Experience reading technical drawings, and basic 3D CAD knowledge

  • Experience with advanced Excel or data tooling for data validation

  • Dutch language skills

How We Work

At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.

We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means:

  • We take initiative rather than wait for direction.

  • We focus on execution and delivering results.

  • We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed.

  • We challenge ideas, not people.

  • We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar.

  • We celebrate team success over individual heroics.

We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals.

If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary including pension plan

  • 25 days of annual leave based on a full-time position

  • Hybrid work model

  • Working together in a high-skilled team with our home base in Utrecht

  • Frequent out-of-work activities with our team, and annual company weekend away.

  • Training budget

  • Opportunity to be key shaper of a new global industry niche: autonomous medical robotics

We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it.

Are you excited?

We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you!

If you think you've got what it takes, but you don't meet all the requirements - we still recommend you apply. We would love to learn about your interest and experience and consider if you can be a good fit for Vitestro. Nobody is a perfect fit, and we welcome applications with imperfections. We offer a learning environment where we grow together!

We are looking for a Mechanical Engineering / Composite Structures Intern to support the design, manufacture, testing, and improvement of the composite structures used in our launch vehicles.

This is a hands-on opportunity to work closely with structural engineers, composite manufacturing engineers, technicians, and the workshop team. You will contribute to real hardware while developing practical experience across CAD, composite materials, manufacturing processes, structural testing, and engineering analysis.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Support the design and modelling of primary and secondary composite structures, components, joints, and interfaces.

  • Assist with CAD, basic structural calculations, FEA, design documentation, and preparation of technical drawings.

  • Support composite manufacturing activities including lay-up, filament winding, vacuum bagging, curing, and demoulding.

  • Help design and produce tooling, mandrels, fixtures, prototypes, and test articles.

  • Prepare and support structural tests, material characterisation, inspections, and data collection.

  • Document work clearly and contribute to process improvements across design, manufacturing, and testing.

What we are looking for

  • Currently studying mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, materials science, composite engineering, or a related subject.

  • A solid foundation in mechanics, materials, structures, manufacturing processes, or engineering design.

  • Practical experience through a student engineering team, particularly in rocketry, Formula Student, robotics, aerospace, or a similar project.

  • Familiarity with CAD and an interest in developing skills in composite structures and manufacturing.

  • A practical, curious, and quality-conscious mindset, with a willingness to work hands-on with hardware.

  • Fluent English and the ability to communicate technical work clearly.

Desirable experience

  • Composite materials, carbon fibre, resin systems, prepreg, wet lay-up, or filament winding.

  • CAD or FEA work through academic, personal, or extracurricular projects.

  • Tooling, mandrel, fixture, prototype, or workshop experience.

  • Structural testing, materials testing, microscopy, or laboratory work.

  • Python, MATLAB, or similar tools for engineering calculations and data analysis.

  • Working proficiency in German.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

title: Mobility and Compliance Lead
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne.

In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave.

As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care.

Role Purpose

We are looking for a Mobility and Compliance Lead to be the champion of mobility policy and compliance across Neko as we scale. You will make sure that everyone who joins Neko from another country, relocates between our locations, or works across borders for us can do so lawfully and with a seamless experience, and that the business is never exposed to right-to-work, immigration or cross-border employment risk.

This role sits at the point where detail meets people. You will get into the detail of immigration rules, relocation packages and cross-border obligations, and you will be the visible, reassuring face of mobility for candidates, new joiners, employees and leaders. When the answer is no, or not by that date, you will say so clearly, explain why, and show what the compliant alternatives are.

You will lead through ownership, expertise and influence, working closely with People Enablement, Rewards, Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, Finance, Legal and our external advisers.

What you'll do in the first 6-12 Months

Own mobility policy and the programme behind it

  • Run and oversee Neko's Global Mobility Programme day to day: company-initiated relocations, self-initiated moves, long-term assignments and business travel, applying the Global Mobility Guideline consistently and fairly

  • Partner with Rewards, who own the guideline, to keep it current, fit for scale and clear on the edge cases, including short-term remote work abroad

  • Manage the mobility process end to end: feasibility review, approval, vendor engagement, assignment and relocation letters, repayment agreements and post-move check-ins

  • Manage our immigration, relocation and tax vendors, brief them well, hold them to timelines and quality, and keep costs visible

Protect the business on right to work and immigration

  • Run pre-offer mobility and right-to-work checks with Talent Acquisition, giving a clear outcome before any offer goes out (clear, hold or stop) and a realistic earliest safe start date

  • Own work permit, visa and sponsorship casework across the UK, Sweden, Germany, Belgium, Switzerland and Ireland, and flag where US requirements differ

  • Keep right-to-work evidence in Workday complete and audit-ready, and track permit expiries and renewals well before they lapse

  • Give the business a straight answer when a plan cannot work, and hold the line on compliance even when timelines are tight

Manage cross-border compliance risk

  • Assess the wider consequences of a move or remote working arrangement: permanent establishment, social security, payroll, tax reporting, posted worker and business visitor rules

  • Work out how each arrangement behaves under direct employment and under an employer of record, and raise the gaps early

  • Consider both our HQ and Clinic populations, including professional registration and licensing for clinical roles and the impact of shift patterns

  • Keep a clear audit trail for every decision: the facts, the source, the reasoning and who approved it

  • Escalate complex or high-risk cases promptly to the Head of People Enablement, Europe, and to external counsel where needed

Create a seamless experience for our people

  • Be the front-facing point of contact for candidates, new joiners, employees and leaders: explain what happens next, who is doing what, and by when

  • Run kick-off calls and pre-move briefings, and prepare the documents people need, such as relocation letters, invitation letters and employment certificates for visa applications

  • Build clear self-serve guidance, FAQs and SOPs in the People Hub and the People Enablement SOP manual, so routine questions are answered without a ticket

Build for scale

  • Improve how cases are tracked, reported and automated with People Tech, across Workday, Ashby and our case tools

  • Report on the mobility pipeline, cycle times, spend and risk, so that leaders can plan hiring and openings with eyes open

  • Spot patterns across cases and turn them into policy, process or tooling changes

What good looks like

  • No one starts work without a verified right to work, and no permit lapses unnoticed

  • Offers go out with a mobility outcome and a start date that holds

  • Candidates and employees say the experience was clear and well supported, including when the answer was no

  • Every case has a documented, defensible decision trail that stands up to audit

  • Routine questions are handled through self-serve guidance, and your time goes to the hard cases

Minimum Requirements

  • Substantial experience in global mobility, immigration or right-to-work compliance, ideally in a fast-growing, multi-country organisation, or in an immigration adviser, law firm or mobility provider

  • Working knowledge of immigration and right-to-work requirements across several of the UK, Sweden, Germany, Belgium, Switzerland and Ireland, and an understanding of the US

  • Understanding of relocation programme design and delivery, including the tax, social security and payroll implications of moving people across borders

  • An analytical mind: you can read a complex case, find the risk in the detail, and build a clear recommendation from the evidence

  • Confident and credible with candidates, employees and senior stakeholders, able to deliver a firm no calmly, with reasons and alternatives

  • Strong problem-solving instincts and good judgement on when to escalate

  • Meticulous record keeping and comfort with trackers, reporting and audit trails

  • Experience with Workday

  • Fluent English; Swedish or another European language is an advantage

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a healthcare, medtech or other regulated environment, including registered clinical professionals

  • Experience managing sponsor licence obligations or employer of record arrangements

  • A formal immigration or mobility qualification

  • Background in process automation or people analytics

About titles at Neko

We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so the title on this posting may differ from your internal title. We’ll be open about the scope and level of the role throughout the process, so you know exactly what you’d be taking on.

title: New Patient Nurse
descriptionHtml:
If you became a nurse because you wanted to genuinely make a difference to patients lives, but you are ready to do it in a completely different way, this could be the role for you.

We are looking for experienced nurses who are ready to step away from traditional ways of working and into an innovative, fully remote clinical environment. You will speak to patients who have often spent years trying different treatments and managing conditions that have had a huge impact on their everyday lives.

This is a different way of nursing. You will use your clinical experience, judgement and ability to really listen to patients to help decide the next step in their treatment journey.

It is fast paced, constantly evolving and you will need to be comfortable with change. Most importantly, you will be working somewhere where the patient genuinely is at the centre of what we do and where the decisions you make can have a real impact on someone's quality of life.

What is the Role?

This is a remote clinical role sitting at the heart of the patient journey at Montu. As a New Patient Nurse, you will be the first clinical point of contact for patients seeking cannabis-based medical treatment. You will conduct structured video consultations to gather medical histories, assess suitability, and determine whether a patient is ready to progress to one of our consultants.

This role does not include prescribing or treatment delivery. What it does include is complex clinical decision-making, a fast-moving caseload, and patients who have often tried everything else before reaching us. You will need to be confident working autonomously, comfortable in a fully remote environment, and genuinely invested in getting the right outcome for every patient.

If you are looking for a quiet life, this is not the role for you. If you want to do meaningful clinical work from home and be part of a growing team that is changing how patients access medicine, it is.

This is a full-time role, working 40 hours per week. You will be required to work 1 Saturday per month, for which a day in lieu will be provided. This role is fully remote.

What Will You Be Doing?

  • Conducting video-based pre-assessment consultations with prospective patients

  • Taking detailed medical histories including current medications, relevant family history, and prior treatment

  • Assessing patient suitability for referral to Montu's clinical consultants

  • Maintaining accurate, confidential patient records

  • Guiding patients clearly through the onboarding process and answering clinical questions appropriately

  • Escalating safeguarding concerns and contraindications in line with Montu policy and national guidance

What You Need

Essential

  • NMC-registered Nurse with a minimum of 5 years post-registration clinical experience

  • UK-based nursing degree or equivalent qualification

  • Previous experience working as a nurse in a remote clinical environment, including conducting patient consultations via telephone or video

  • Confident autonomous decision-maker with strong clinical reasoning

  • Clear and effective communicator, both written and verbal

  • Comfortable working in a fully remote, tech-enabled environment including video platforms and EMRs

  • Sound understanding of safeguarding, GDPR, and clinical governance

Desirable

  • Background in pain management, cannabis-based medicinal products, or complementary therapies

  • Experience in a fast-paced or high-volume clinical setting

What We Offer

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + 8 bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Private Healthcare Scheme

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

title: Offre de stage Développement et optimisation des mesures automatiques d’ammoniac réalisées en air ambiant
descriptionHtml:
Unité : CERI Energie Environnement - DEMO MERA/LCSQA

Responsables : Emmanuel TISON, Anthony LAGACHE

Catégorie : Stagiaire de Master 2 ou de fin d’études ingénieur (6 mois)

Lieu de travail : Douai – Bourseul, Bâtiment Curie

Contexte :

École sous tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle, énergétique et numérique, et école de l’Institut Mines Télécom, IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20000m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les domaines suivants :

  • Systèmes Numériques

  • Energie Environnement

  • Matériaux et Procédés

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr.

Le stage est à pourvoir au sein du Centre d’Enseignement, de Recherche et d’Innovation Energie Environnement (CERI EE) de l’IMT Nord Europe. Une partie des missions du CERI EE (https://recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr/energie-environnement-ceri/) est de réaliser des travaux techniques et scientifiques pour le Ministère chargé de l’Environnement dans le cadre du Laboratoire Central de Surveillance de la Qualité de l’Air (LCSQA, https://www.lcsqa.org/fr) et de l’observatoire de Mesure et Évaluation en zone Rurale de la pollution Atmosphérique à longue distance (MERA, https://www.lcsqa.org/fr/le-dispositif-mera). En concertation avec les Associations Agréées de Surveillance de la Qualité de l'Air (AASQA), le CERI EE est chargé de proposer et qualifier les méthodes de mesure à déployer, de définir les protocoles, d’évaluer la qualité des données et de piloter l’observatoire MERA intégré au dispositif français de surveillance réglementaire de la qualité de l’air.

Contexte :

L'ammoniac (NH3) est un polluant atmosphérique nocif pour la santé humaine, les écosystèmes et l'environnement, mais aussi un précurseur de particules fines inorganiques notamment responsables de forts épisodes de pollution printaniers en Europe. En France, la source dominante d'ammoniac (environ 95%) est attribuée aux activités agricoles (épandage de fumier, utilisation d'engrais azotés, élevage). À partir de 2027, la directive européenne 2024/2881 exige que le NH3 soit mesuré spécifiquement sur les supersites implantés dans des lieux caractéristiques de la pollution de fond rurale. La France répond à cette obligation en déployant 6 supersites de surveillance de typologie fond rural, répartis dans des zones représentatives de la pollution longue-distance, et sélectionnés au sein des stations de l’observatoire MERA. Ces supersites sont équipés d’analyseurs automatiques en continu pour mesurer le NH3 à une très haute résolution temporelle. Ces méthodes permettent une mesure en temps réel, pour capturer la variabilité temporelle du NH3. Cependant, le NH3 est un polluant particulièrement complexe à mesurer notamment en raison de difficultés métrologiques (absence de méthode standardisée, interférences etc.) et de ses propriétés physico-chimiques (grande réactivité avec les surfaces, volatilisation, formation de particules etc.).

Objectif :

L'objectif de ce stage est d’apporter des éléments méthodologiques qui permettront d’établir des recommandations nationales concernant la sélection et les pratiques de mise en œuvre des préleveurs automatiques, afin d’améliorer la fiabilité et l’harmonisation des mesures de l’ammoniac.

Livrables :

· Synthèse bibliographique ciblée sur les difficultés métrologiques de la mesure du NH₃ et les solutions à évaluer

· Production d’un plan d’expériences détaillé à suivre durant le stage et d’un protocole d’assurance et de contrôle qualité des données.

· Jeu de données documenté, fichiers ou scripts de traitement reproductibles et bilan des performances observées.

· Présentation des résultats au groupe de travail national pour la mesure de NH3

· Projet de note de recommandations pour le prélèvement de NH₃ en zone rurale, soumis à la validation des encadrants et du groupe de travail national. Les conclusions distingueront les points établis des points restant à confirmer.


Profil du candidat :

Ce stage est destiné à un.e étudiant.e en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou M2 universitaire avec un profil en analyses physico-chimiques, en instrumentation, mesure et assurance qualité appliquées à l’environnement, avec un goût prononcé pour les approches expérimentales.

De grandes qualités d’analyse, de rédaction, d’organisation, de communication et d’autonomie sont attendues.

Curiosité scientifique, rigueur et aptitude au travail en équipe sont recherchées. Un bon niveau d’anglais scientifique est souhaité pour la lecture bibliographique. Des compétences en traitement de données (Python, R ou Matlab) seront appréciées. Une première pratique de la chimie analytique et des notions de métrologie et d’assurance qualité seront des atouts.

Conditions :

Le poste est à pourvoir à compter du 01/03/2027 pour une durée de 6 mois

title: Performance Marketing Lead
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The role

We're hiring the first dedicated owner of Omnea's performance marketing.

You're not starting from scratch. Paid campaigns, the website and our social channels all exist (and are working to varying degrees). But nobody's job is to work out what actually produces pipeline and then make more of it. That's this role: take what's already running, find the ROI, and professionalise it into something we can be proud of.

In one week you might work out why a paid campaign is generating leads that never convert, rebuild the landing page that's losing them, build a new LinkedIn audience off the back of our closed-won data, and show the exec team what the pipeline picture looks like.

If you want to run one channel and hand-off the numbers, this might not be for you. If you want to own the loop from spend through to pipeline, and have the data to prove what worked, it is.

You'll work closely with our digital agency partners, the field marketers running events in the UK and US, and the sales team who rely on the pipeline you generate.

What you'll own

Pipeline and performance

You'll build the picture of what marketing is actually returning, and you'll be the person with the answer when someone asks whether a channel is worth the money.

  • Own the pipeline number for our digital channels: how much, from where, and at what cost

  • Build and maintain dashboards in Dreamdata using sources like HubSpot and GA4

  • Track campaigns from first touch through to closed won, and use what you find to change what we run next

  • Run a proper testing cadence. Set the test, call the result, and stop the things that aren't working

  • Report on what the numbers mean, not only what they are

Paid

You own paid. Our agency handles campaign build and optimisation, and you set the direction they work to.

title: Ph.D. Position in Computer Science (Wearable Intelligence & Data Fusion)
descriptionHtml:
Constructor University in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs and Constructor Technology

About the Position

The research group of Dr. Sari Sadiya at Constructor Knowledge Labs (CKL), in collaboration with Constructor University (CU) and Constructor Technology (CT), invites applicants for Ph.D. student positions in Computer Science with a focus on wearable intelligence, multimodal data fusion, and edge AI.

The project investigates how wearable data streams can be transformed into structured knowledge and integrated into a knowledge-grounded digital avatar that supports bi-directional collaboration in education and research.

Ph.D. students will work in a highly interdisciplinary environment, combining AI/ML, edge computing, cognitive science, and human–computer interaction. In close collaboration with academia and industry, they will contribute to building privacy-preserving, real-time personalization frameworks while pursuing their doctoral dissertation.

About the Program

The PhD program is research-centered, emphasizing original contributions in:

  • Wearable data analytics and fusion methods
  • Biomedical data analytics
  • On-device processing and performance modeling
  • Personalization and adaptive reasoning systems
  • AI for Education

Doctoral students will also have access to specialized courses in:

  • Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Edge Computing
  • Advanced Computational Methods and Data Science
  • Cognitive Science and Human-Centered Computing

As part of the program, students will collaborate with Constructor Technology to gain first-hand industrial experience, contributing to real-world testbeds and prototypes.

Research Focus

This PhD position is part of the Wearable Intelligence Project, with two main research directions:

  • Data fusion of heterogeneous temporal streams
    • Designing algorithms to unify multimodal signals (physiological, cognitive, contextual, scheduling, and learning data).
    • Developing pipelines that produce structured insights powering the Agentic Personalization Engine (APE).
  • On-device data processing & performance modeling
    • Developing models balancing computation, energy, and data flows across wearable, edge, and cloud environments.
    • Exploring feasibility of running compact micro-LLMs directly on wearables.

The overarching goal is to create scalable, ethical, and transparent personalization systems that support education and research.

Funding

The appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:

  • Monthly stipend of €1,650
  • Monthly research-cost allowance of €100 (Forschungskostenpauschale)
  • Health-insurance subsidy of €100 per month
  • Supplementary €603 mini-job allowance to support parallel part-time employment (optional)

Constructor Knowledge Labs actively supports candidates in preparing applications for external funding — doctoral scholarships, foundations, or international mobility grants — and can provide institutional support and references

Applicant Profile

Mandatory requirements:

  • MSc degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Cognitive Science, or related disciplines.
  • Strong background in AI/ML, signal processing, or edge computing.
  • Hands-on experience with wearable or multimodal data (e.g., heart rate, EEG, activity, sleep, GPS).
  • Solid mathematical and computational modeling skills.
  • Proficiency in academic English writing (e.g., reports, papers, theses).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with LLMs, multimodal data fusion, or agent-based AI systems.
  • Familiarity with privacy-preserving ML, dynamic consent, and GDPR-compliant frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct independent research and collaborate across disciplines.
  • Interest in teaching, mentoring, and applied industrial research.

Application Details

  • Deadline: August 31, 2026

Required documents:

  • Curriculum Vitae (CV);
  • Academic transcripts;
  • Letter of motivation outlining research interests and career goals;
  • 2 recommendation letters.

Applications to be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interviews.

descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.

Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.

At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization. 

Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.

Job Overview

Role can be based in any of our UK offices

Jensen Hughes is a company fiercely committed to our purpose, our clients, and each other. Every single member of our team is essential to our success. Due to the continued growth and success of our External Walls and Facades team, we have an exciting opportunity for a Principal Engineer to join our market leading UK team.

As a Principal Engineer, you will provide advanced technical delivery and project leadership across façade engineering and external wall fire consultancy services, you will be responsible for exercising independent engineering judgement on complex projects, leading technical workstreams, and ensuring that deliverables are technically robust, proportionate, and defensible. You will be a senior technical contributor within project teams, support quality assurance and peer review processes, mentor developing engineers, and contribute to maintaining Jensen Hughes’ reputation for high-quality, risk-based advice.

Responsibilities
