title: Principal Engineer, Privacy
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is working on frontier AI systems that handle sensitive information at enormous scale. How we protect that data, and how we build privacy into our systems rather than bolting it on afterward, is central to our mission of building AI that is safe and beneficial.

As one of our principal privacy engineers, you will be among Anthropic's most senior individual contributors on privacy. You will set technical strategy for how personal data is handled across products, research, and infrastructure, and execute the hardest parts of delivering it. You'll work at the intersection of privacy engineering, distributed systems, and AI safety, on problems without established answers. You will lead through influence, quality of thinking, and trust rather than formal authority.

Key responsibilities

  • Define and drive technical strategy and architecture for major areas of privacy, spanning product surfaces, research and training data, internal tooling, and multiple clouds
  • Identify and lead the highest-complexity, company-critical privacy initiatives, guiding engineers across many teams. Be comfortable building the most difficult pieces yourself
  • Architect the primitives that make privacy the default and the safe path the fastest one: data discovery, classification, lineage, purpose-based access control, audit, retention, deletion, and export
  • Turn regulatory, contractual, and consent obligations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, the EU AI Act) into enforced, continuously verified technical controls in partnership with Legal, Policy, and Compliance team
  • Anticipate where AI capabilities, regulation, and customer expectations are heading, and position our systems ahead of them
  • Mentor and develop staff and senior staff engineers, raise the bar for privacy design across engineering, and help hire senior privacy talent
  • Represent Anthropic's privacy engineering to customers, regulators, standards bodies, and the research community

Minimum qualifications

  • A track record of operating as a Principal engineer or equivalent: setting technical direction that multiple teams adopted, and delivering company-critical, multi-year initiatives
  • Deep experience applying privacy engineering principles in production systems with a large user base, including privacy by design, data minimization, and purpose limitation
  • Experience architecting data governance infrastructure (classification, lineage, access control, retention, or deletion) across distributed systems and cloud infrastructure at scale
  • Proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages; you are effective writing design docs, making architectural calls, and coding in critical paths
  • Understanding of privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA, and the ability to work as a peer with legal and policy experts to turn requirements into technical designs
  • Written and verbal communication that builds alignment across engineering, research, legal, and product teams, up to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building privacy infrastructure or controls for machine learning or AI systems, including training data governance or AI agents
  • Hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (e.g., differential privacy, homomorphic encryption, secure enclaves, secure multi-party computation)
  • Experience establishing or re-architecting a privacy engineering practice under enterprise-customer or regulatory scrutiny
  • Experience briefing executives, auditors, regulators, or enterprise customers on privacy risk, and defending your recommendations under challenge
  • A history of growing engineers into Staff-level and more senior roles
  • Contributions to open-source privacy tooling, privacy research, or industry standards

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:$485,000—$625,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

If you are great at what you do, enjoy working in a startup environment, and are passionate about developing leading-edge electronics for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. At the Principal level, you will be tasked with full-stack hardware development for complex modules and hardware systems. You will have the opportunity to start at concept development and progress through detailed design, analysis, layout, build, test, and delivery, doing hands-on work at each phase. The Principal level also includes technical leadership opportunities, gaining responsibility for critical designs and teams of engineers developing new products and systems. At a small company and a startup, your work will make direct contributions to the success of the business. The work is challenging and impactful, requiring both breadth and depth of technical knowledge. Our products are made for high-reliability space and airborne applications, so designs require high levels of technical rigor while maintaining the agility of a startup environment. The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.
JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Own end-to-end design of complex electronics modules and systems, from concept and architecture through schematic, layout, test, and production. Products may include high-speed digital, power electronics, and/or RF.
  • Lead teams of hardware engineers to develop new products with multiple electronics modules.
  • Provide subject matter expertise in support of hardware development across the company.
  • Develop hardware architecture and write hardware requirements for systems of high complexity.
  • Perform detailed and complete schematic design for complex boards, ranging from key components to supporting passives.
  • Perform detailed PCB layout in Altium Designer for complex boards, often working with a PCB Drafter.
  • Complete analysis such as worst-case circuit analysis, signal integrity analysis, and power integrity analysis. Guide analysis methodology.
  • Develop bring-up plans and design verification plans for new hardware and complex systems.
  • Perform bring-up and key verification testing of modules and complex integrated systems, often working with a team to complete validation.
  • Release modules and assemblies to production, working with the Manufacturing and Test Engineering teams.

  • Experience owning the design phase of complex board-level electronics and small hardware systems, including architecture design, trade studies, key part selection, and detailed design.
  • Multiple experiences delivering hardware products through production and deployment.
  • Expertise in PCB layout and manufacturing, including high-density interconnect (HDI) stackup design, IPC standards, and industry best practices.

  • Expert-level proficiency in electronics design tools such as Altium.
  • Extensive lab experience for bring-up and verification of new hardware, based on in-depth understanding of specialized lab equipment.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills.

title: Principal Product & Brand Designer (m/f/x)
descriptionHtml:
Build something that truly matters

At Cortea, we envision a world where every audit is proactively managed by humans and AI agents collaboratively. Where auditing professionals have superhuman capabilities at their fingertips to strengthen the trust in the world's most critical systems.

We're not just improving auditing workflows, we're redefining how audits are done from the ground up. With a rapidly growing, global customer base and backing from world-class investors, the market is ready. What we ship next decides how big this gets.

This is your chance to join a team of sharp, ambitious and kind builders extremely early. Shape the company at its pivotal moment and build something that truly matters.

About the role

At Cortea, design earns trust, and we sell to an industry that exists to produce it. Auditors are paid to be skeptical, and people judge quality by what they can see: the product, the website, the deck a partner opens in a boardroom, the newsletter someone reads with their first coffee. All of it is Cortea.

This is a role for someone with great taste in designing software and AI systems. You'll find novel patterns for problems that haven't existed in software before, and you'll own how Cortea looks and feels to the outside world.

Roughly 70% product, 30% brand. The product work is deep, expert-facing and systems-heavy. As we are doubling down on design, you'll be working on taking the core flows to the next level. The brand work is yours to own outright: website, marketing and sales visuals, newsletter, event and content assets. It'll be on screen in a Big4 boardroom, in every customer's inbox, and on the wall at the events we host. A lot of surface for one designer, and all of it yours.

We're not looking for someone to ask whether the logo goes left or right. We're looking for someone with opinions.

What you'll do

  • Work directly with our founders, engineers, and customers to turn audit flows into intuitive, delightful interfaces

  • Work with Jonas on product design and design strategy overall

  • Own our brand designs and visuals

  • Evolve our visual identity and design system

  • Take increasing ownership of brand direction. Website, marketing and sales material, content and event assets

  • Help shape the product vision, roadmap, and user experience standards

  • Run usability tests, build user feedback loops, and bring a systems mindset to design decisions

You'll be great at this if you

  • Have product design experience in B2B / SaaS, ideally in fast-moving startups.

  • Think in experiences, not screens. With taste you can defend. Product and brand are one surface; you can explain why details work, and you call out when they don’t.

  • Want to create a unique brand, which auditors love. Identify, marketing, web should be a draw, not a tax. Taste and passion matter more than volume.

  • Can hold complexity without losing clarity. You turn configuration-heavy, expert workflows into clear systems.

  • Use AI without sacrificing quality. You've worked out which parts of the job benefit from automation and which need your judgment.

  • Work well in ambiguity. You take rough direction and deliver great work without handholding.

  • Have low ego. Best idea wins. You give and take feedback without making it about you.

Titles are fuzzy. If you're operating at principal level, or you're currently freelancing and curious rather than actively looking, talk to us anyway.

What you will get

  • Full brand ownership, shape how the product feels. Work face-to-face with experienced founders and learn directly from customer insights.

  • Real influence on strategy. In a small team of excellent engineers and operators with high autonomy, you will shape product direction. Best idea wins, regardless of seniority.

  • Fast, ambitious, and fun team. Decisions get made in hours, not weeks. Rapid experimentation is the default.

  • Meaningful equity and competitive salary. You are one of the first to build this, and you share in the upside.

  • A mission that matters. Building intelligent systems for a $200bn industry from Berlin, with AI at the core

Interview process

  • First Call — Intro on what we do with Liza

  • Second Call — Portfolio walkthrough with Jonas

  • Third Call — Get to know our product and culture with our Co-Founder Valentin

  • On-site Day — Meet our full team in our Berlin office and work on a real problem together with us.

descriptionHtml:

Nous recherchons pour notre client, un Product Owner Data Technico-Fonctionnel (H/F) dans le cadre d'une création de poste en CDI.

VOS MISSIONS :

Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction des Systèmes d’Information, vous intégrez une DSI à taille humaine pour piloter la vision, la roadmap et la gouvernance Data de notre client.

Vos missions sont les suivantes :

Pilotage stratégique et orientation de la roadmap data

  • Piloter la trajectoire produit : Concevoir, ajuster et prioriser la feuille de route des différents actifs et de la plateforme data en fonction de la valeur métier apportée.
  • Gérer le cycle de vie de la plateforme : Animer et séquencer les différents chantiers d'évolution et de structuration de l'écosystème data, incluant son volet gouvernance.
  • Cadrer les besoins métiers : Écouter, qualifier et hiérarchiser les demandes émanant des différentes entités de l'entreprise (réseau, animation, marketing, finance et support).

Centralisation des données et unification des référentiels

  • Orchestrer le DataHub relationnel : Garantir la fiabilité du golden record (conseillers et clients), piloter l'identifiant pivot et centraliser la gestion des flux de leads entrants.
  • Alimenter l'écosystème CRM 360° : Centraliser l'historique des interactions et veiller au respect des niveaux de confidentialité pour les équipes du siège.
  • formaliser les contrats de données : Négocier et rédiger les data contracts avec les équipes en charge des applications et les éditeurs tiers.

Déploiement d'une gouvernance des données robuste

  • Instaurer le catalogue de données : Mettre en œuvre et administrer le référentiel documenté, clarifier les définitions métier et identifier les data owners.
  • Assurer la qualité des données : Définir et surveiller des indicateurs de contrôle stricts (fraîcheur, taux de complétude, déduplication).
  • Veiller à la conformité réglementaire : Travailler main dans la main avec le DPO pour appliquer le RGPD (politiques de rétention, automatisation des purges, tenue du registre).

Conception et mise en valeur des produits data

  • Industrialiser les flux : Concevoir les pipelines de données et superviser l'alimentation continue du datalake.
  • Moderniser la BI : Rationaliser et repenser les outils de reporting existants pour concevoir des tableaux de bord pertinents destinés au siège et au réseau.
  • Piloter la performance : Valider et certifier les indicateurs clés de pilotage, y compris ceux mesurant l'avancement de la trajectoire DSI.
  • Soutenir l'innovation IA : Préparer et structurer les jeux de données nécessaires aux cas d'usage portés par l'équipe IA Factory.

Pilotage du delivery et animation agile

  • Spécifier les besoins : Rédiger les user stories orientées data, formaliser les spécifications techniques de flux et définir les critères de recette.
  • Animer les rituels de livraison : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les data engineers et les intégrateurs, rythmer les cérémonies agiles et valider les mises en production.
  • Favoriser l'appropriation : Assurer la montée en compétences des utilisateurs finaux et encourager l'autonomie à travers des usages en self-service.

ENVIRONNEMENT TECHNIQUE :

Data & Gouvernance : Mise en place d’une plateforme Data moderne, gouvernance, qualité et observabilité des données.

Compétences techniques : SQL | Data : Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, ClickHouse, Metabase, DataHub.

Connaissance du RGPD et de son application aux données personnelles.

VOUS :

De formation supérieure au minimum Bac+5 types ingénieur ou commerce, vous justifiez d’au moins 6 années d’expérience dont 3 ans en tant de Product Owner ou Chef de Projet Data.

Au cours de votre parcours, vous avez déjà contribué activement au déploiement d'une plateforme data moderne ainsi qu'à la mise en place d'une démarche de gouvernance globale (incluant le catalogue, le datahub, la qualité et l'observabilité). Sur le plan technique, vous maîtrisez parfaitement le SQL et comprenez les technologies modernes de la data telles qu'Airflow, dbt, les entrepôts analytiques (Snowflake, ClickHouse), les outils de BI (Metabase) et de catalogage (DataHub).

Nous recherchons une personne rigoureuse et soucieuse de la qualité des livrables, sans jamais perdre de vue l'usage final pour les utilisateurs. Vous faites preuve d'une excellente capacité d'analyse pour traduire des besoins métiers parfois flous en indicateurs clairs, précis et partagés. Doté(e) d'un sens de la pédagogie, vous savez évangéliser et diffuser la culture de la donnée auprès des équipes. Enfin, votre diplomatie vous permet d'aligner facilement plusieurs directions autour d'une vision et d'une définition communes.

PROCESS :

Après un premier échange en visio avec un membre de notre équipe, vous rencontrerez :

  • Le Responsable des Systèmes d’information en visio
  • Puis un entretien final sur site avec la direction

Une décision rapide est prise à l’issue des entretiens.

title: Project Quality Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Project Quality Manager, you own the Project & Program pillar of Harmattan’s Quality organization. You set the quality standards that carry every programme from first prototypes through to mass production. You lead the Project Quality Engineers and act as the quality counterpart of Program Management, Engineering and our institutional customers. Your work keeps quality gates rigorous at the right level for each development phase, in line with ISO 9001 / EN 9100.

Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Building

  • Lead, coach and grow the Project Quality Engineering team, and allocate engineers across active programmes.

  • Act as the quality counterpart of Program Management, Engineering leads and institutional customers.

  • Standardize project quality practices across programmes and turn lessons learned into company standards.

Quality Gates & Product Development

  • Own quality gate governance from EVT to PVT and transfer to mass production, including go/no-go recommendations.

  • Drive advanced product quality planning (APQP / EN 9145): quality plans, DFMEA / PFMEA, special characteristics and control plans.

  • Ensure design and development quality per EN 9100: design reviews, verification and validation evidence, configuration and change control.

  • Arbitrate open development non-conformities, risks and deviations, and lead structured problem solving.

Customer Deliverables & Performance

  • Deliver customer quality documentation, including quality and management plans and qualification and acceptance files.

  • Prepare customer audits and delivery verification readiness together with Site Quality.

  • Align with Supplier Quality and Industrialization on first article inspection and production readiness.

  • Define and report project quality KPIs, including risks, non-conformities and gate readiness, reviewed regularly with Programs.

Candidate Requirements

  • Engineering degree (MSc or equivalent) in quality, aeronautical, mechanical, electronics or systems engineering.

  • 8+ years in project, programme or design quality in aerospace, defense, automotive or high-tech hardware.

  • 2 to 3+ years leading a team, or leading quality on a full programme.

  • Strong command of EN 9100 / ISO 9001, APQP / PPAP (EN 9145), DFMEA / PFMEA, control plans, design reviews and 8D.

  • Experience taking complex electromechanical or embedded products through EVT / DVT / PVT to serial production.

  • Structured and pragmatic, applying the right level of rigor per phase and holding firm at gates when needed.

  • Knowledge of AQAP 2110 and defense customer requirements is a plus; comfort with Jira and Confluence.

  • Regular on-site presence at the production site, alongside Paris-based work.

  • Fluency in French and English required.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: QA Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the role

At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. As a QA Engineer you don't work at the end of the chain, but right in the middle of our development teams. You think along before any code is written, test smartly where it matters, and act as the bridge between development, product and the rest of the company when it comes to quality. You report to the Teamlead Frontend and work daily with the frontend, mobile and backend teams.

What you'll do

  • Think along from the start. You join refinements and help teams see the risks and impact of a feature before they start building;

  • Choose the right test approach. Together with the team, you decide per feature what to test automatically, what to test manually, and why;

  • Build and maintain automated tests. You set up tests for key platform functionality and keep them reliable;

  • Manual and exploratory testing. You go through the app yourself, look for edge cases and find what a script misses;

  • Central point of contact for bugs. Bug reports from across the company come to you. You reproduce them, gather all the information a developer needs to get started, and get them ready in Jira with the right priority;

  • Advise on releases. You map out risks and give clear advice on the quality of a release;

  • Provide insight. You collect test data and show how our software quality is doing;

  • Keep the balance. You help teams weigh fixing bugs against building new features.

What you bring

  • A bachelor's level of working and thinking, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field;

  • At least 2 years of work experience, including at least 1 year as a QA Engineer, Software Tester or Test Automation Engineer;

  • Experience setting up and carrying out a test approach and test plans;

  • Experience with test automation and test frameworks;

  • You're comfortable working with AI tools and use them purposefully: to test faster and better, and to set up automated tests;

  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum team and with a bug tracking system, preferably Jira.

  • You work independently, make decisions in your own work and give advice, whether asked or not;

  • You're critical and analytical, take initiative and work well with developers, product and business.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and you're comfortable working with code;

  • You look beyond "does it work?": also at accessibility, speed, security and multilingual support.

  • Experience with tests that run automatically on every code change, and you know how to deal with unreliable tests;

  • You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues test better;

  • Experience testing mobile apps.

We're looking for someone who sees quality as something the whole team owns. You don't just perfect your own testing work; you ask yourself what needs to change structurally so the whole team tests better. Our own values guide the way: Own it, Say it, Make it.

What we offer

  • A gross salary between €3,400 and €4,800 based on full-time employment;

  • 25 vacation days, 6.5 ADV days and 1 additional holiday per calendar year, based on a 40-hour workweek;

  • 8% vacation pay, a pension plan, and (if you live more than 10 km from the office) a travel allowance;

  • We prioritize mental well-being in collaboration with our partner OpenUp;

  • Great perks such as: a yearly fitness budget, a freshly prepared healthy lunch every day, snacks, bi-weekly afternoon drinks, XL borrels every three months and much more;

In partnership with the VP of Quality Assurance, the manager sets team priorities, supports employee development, and translates quality objectives into effective departmental actions.

title: Recruitment Manager
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij op operationeel niveau bouwen aan de mensen die het onderwijs van duizenden leerlingen versterken? Als Resource Manager bij Lyceo in Leiden krijg je een sleutelpositie binnen een landelijke marktleider die volop groeit. Een baan met directe impact, veel verantwoordelijkheid en volop ruimte om recruitment en capaciteitsmanagement verder te professionaliseren.

Taken

Maak het verschil als Recruitment Manager

Als Resource Manager zorg je ervoor dat Lyceo nu en in de toekomst beschikt over de juiste begeleiders om scholen en leerlingen tijdig te ondersteunen. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor hun beschikbaarheid, kwaliteit en inzetbaarheid. Je maakt deel uit van het MT en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de directie van Lyceo. Met ondersteuning van het datateam bepaal je welke begeleiders waar en wanneer nodig zijn. Op basis daarvan laat je gerichte recruitmentacties uitvoeren en geef je richting aan selectie, matching en onboarding. Met KPI’s bewaak je de instroom, retentie, vervulling en doorlooptijden en stuur je gericht bij. Daarnaast optimaliseer je processen en geef je leiding aan een team met onder andere een Recruiter en een Coördinator Matching en Onboarding. Samen met de Operationeel Manager zorg je voor voldoende geschikte mensen en een succesvolle uitvoering van alle onderwijsprojecten. Bij afwezigheid kunnen jullie elkaars verantwoordelijkheden overnemen.

Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

• realiseren van voldoende gerichte instroom en een kwalitatief sterke recruitment, selectie en onboarding;

• verbinden van vraag en aanbod op basis van regio, vakgebied, onderwijstype, beschikbaarheid en reisbereidheid;

• voorspellen, bewaken en bijsturen van de capaciteitsbehoefte met data en KPI’s;

• optimaliseren van recruitment en instroomprocessen en adviseren over selectiecriteria, retentie en capaciteit;

• aansturen van het team en bewaken van het recruitmentbudget.

Vereisten

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Je vertaalt recruitmentdoelstellingen naar concrete acties en stuurt met data op kwaliteit, instroom en capaciteit. Historische resultaten combineer je met verwachtingen en ontwikkelingen in de markt. Ook wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat, kijk je vooruit, maak je keuzes en stuur je tijdig bij. Als leidinggevende sta je dicht bij je team, geef je richting en neem je mensen met positieve energie mee. Ervaring binnen recruitment, arbeidsbemiddeling, detachering of vergelijkbare dienstverlening helpt je om wisselende capaciteitsvragen snel te doorgronden.

Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

• minimaal hbo werk- en denkniveau;

• ervaring met recruitment, werving en selectie;

• leidinggevende ervaring binnen recruitment, capaciteitsmanagement of een vergelijkbare dienstverlenende omgeving;

• ervaring met het sturen op data en KPI’s binnen recruitment of capaciteitsplanning;

• ervaring met het optimaliseren van recruitment- of instroomprocessen.

Jouw werkgebied

Jouw nieuwe werkplek bevindt zich in Leiden, vlak bij Leiden Centraal. Vanuit het kantoor werk je nauw samen met de verschillende afdelingen van Lyceo. Dankzij de ligging nabij het centraal station is de werkplek goed bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer.

Benefits

Als Recruitment Manager kun jij rekenen op:

Een verantwoordelijke functie bij een groeiende onderwijsorganisatie waar ontwikkeling niet alleen voor leerlingen centraal staat. Lyceo biedt je ruimte voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën. Via de Lyceo Academie blijf je bovendien zelf leren en krijg je volop mogelijkheden om binnen de organisatie door te groeien.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

• een verantwoordelijke functie van 32 tot 40 uur per week, waarbij je tijdens de drukke periodes in het schooljaar flexibel beschikbaar bent;

• 25 vakantiedagen, waarvan je naar rato 10 vakantiedagen opneemt in de zomervakantie;

• de mogelijkheid om 5 extra verlofdagen bij te kopen;

• 8% vakantiegeld, uitbetaald in mei;

• reiskostenvergoeding per kilometer of volledige vergoeding van OV-kosten;

• een pensioenregeling waarbij Lyceo 6% premie betaalt;

• een laptop en telefoon van de zaak;

• toegang tot exclusieve kortingen via Benefits at Work;

• deelname aan de Lyceo Academie met diverse online en fysieke trainingen;

• volop mogelijkheden om door te groeien binnen Lyceo;

• leuke activiteiten via onze personeelsvereniging Nablijven.

Werken bij Lyceo

Wie werkt bij Lyceo, blijft leren. Lyceo is een toonaangevende landelijke organisatie in aanvullend onderwijs en helpt jaarlijks duizenden leerlingen met onder andere huiswerkbegeleiding, bijspijkertrajecten, examentrainingen en lente- en zomerscholen. Scholen beoordelen de dienstverlening van Lyceo gemiddeld met een 8,5 of hoger.

Als marktleider is Lyceo volop in beweging en heeft de organisatie duidelijke groeiambities. Je werkt in een betrokken en energieke omgeving waarin samenwerking centraal staat en ruimte is voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën. Samen werkt Lyceo aan de beste verbinding tussen regulier en aanvullend onderwijs, zodat ieder kind tot zijn recht kan komen.

Wir betreuen kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen ebenso wie internationale Konzerne bei SEO, Google Ads, Social Media und Webentwicklung. Viele Texte entstehen bei uns heute mit eigenen KI-Werkzeugen. Damit daraus gute Texte werden, suchen wir jemanden mit sicherem Sprachgefühl, der prüft, kürzt, verbessert und freigibt.

Aufgaben

• Du lektorierst Website-Texte, Ratgeber und Kategorietexte für unsere Kunden: Rechtschreibung, Stil, Fakten und Lesefluss.

• Du schreibst und überarbeitest SEO-Texte nach Keyword-Briefing, eng abgestimmt mit dem SEO-Team.

• Du planst und schreibst organische Beiträge für Instagram, Facebook und LinkedIn, für Kunden und für SUMAX selbst.

• Du arbeitest mit unseren KI-Werkzeugen für Text und Social Media und achtest darauf, dass am Ende nichts nach Maschine klingt.

• Du hältst Tonalität und Vorgaben der Kunden ein. Bei Gesundheitskunden gehört das Heilmittelwerbegesetz dazu, das bringen wir dir bei.

Qualifikation

• Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise Erfahrung im Lektorat oder Korrektorat

• Erfahrung mit SEO-Texten: Suchintention, Überschriften, interne Verlinkung

• Gespür für Social Media: Hooks, Formate, Redaktionsplan

• Offenheit für KI-Werkzeuge und einen kritischen Blick auf ihre Ergebnisse

• Studium oder Ausbildung in Medien, Germanistik oder Kommunikation, alternativ vergleichbare Praxis

Benefits

• 30 Urlaubstage

• Arbeitsplatz mit zwei Monitoren direkt am Phönixsee und planbare Tage im Homeoffice

• MacBook als Arbeitsgerät

• Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

• Schulungen, Workshops und berufliche Weiterbildung

• Kaffee, Getränke und Snacks im Büro

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und zwei bis drei Textproben, gern auch einen Social-Media-Beitrag von dir. Nenn uns dazu deinen frühestmöglichen Starttermin und deine Gehaltsvorstellung.

title: Release Train Engineer (RTE)
descriptionHtml:
SAFe ist eingeführt, die Kadenz läuft, die Teams sind eingespielt – und genau hier fängt die eigentliche Arbeit an. Für einen gewachsenen Agile Release Train mit mehreren Teams suchen wir einen erfahrenen Release Train Engineer, der den ART nicht verwaltet, sondern weiterentwickelt.

Im Fokus stehen Flow, Qualität und messbare Wertschöpfung: Wo hakt es zwischen den Teams? Welche Abhängigkeiten kosten jedes PI aufs Neue Tempo? Welche Routinen sind Ritual statt Nutzen? Als Teil des ART Leadership Teams gestaltest du die Antworten – gemeinsam mit Teams, Führungskräften und Stakeholdern.

Die Rolle verbindet Facilitation, systemisches Coaching und echte Gestaltungsverantwortung.


Aufgaben:

  • Orchestrierung des Agile Release Trains sowie Vorbereitung, Moderation und Nachbereitung von PI Plannings, ART Syncs, System Demos und Inspect & Adapt

  • Aktives Management von Abhängigkeiten, Risiken und Impediments über Team- und Bereichsgrenzen hinweg

  • Standortbestimmung des ART-Reifegrads und Ableitung einer konkreten Entwicklungsroadmap mit klaren Etappenzielen

  • Aufbau und Interpretation von Flow-Metriken als Grundlage für Entscheidungen statt für Reporting

  • Unterstützung von Product Management und Product Ownern bei Backlog-Qualität, Priorisierung und Value-Fokus

  • Coaching von Scrum Mastern, Product Ownern und Führungskräften entlang der Lean-Agile-Prinzipien

  • Stakeholder- und Change-Management auf mehreren Ebenen, inklusive Mitwirkung im ART Leadership Team

  • Mitverantwortung für Planungs- und Budgetthemen sowie Steuerung der Zusammenarbeit mit externen Partnern

Anforderungen:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Release Train Engineer in einer skalierten agilen Organisation

  • Zertifizierungen im SAFe-Umfeld (RTE zwingend, SPC von Vorteil)

  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Lean-Agile Leadership und systemischem Coaching – über das Framework hinaus

  • Souveränität in Moderation und Facilitation grosser Gruppen sowie im Umgang mit Konflikten

  • Erfahrung im Change Management und in der Einführung agiler Kennzahlen, die tatsächlich genutzt werden

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungswillen

  • Kommunikationsstärke zwischen Teams, Management und Business

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse

Generelle Rahmenbedingungen:

  • Start: Kurzfristig, nach Absprache

  • Dauer: Initial 12 Monate, auf Verlängerung angelegt

  • Pensum: 100 %

  • Präsenz: Hohe Vor-Ort-Präsenz erwünscht, punktuell remote

  • Sprache: Deutsch

title: Chief Financial Officer
descriptionHtml:
360Learning is entering its next phase of growth. Today, more than 2,500 organizations worldwide rely on us to turn internal expertise into business performance. As AI reshapes how companies develop skills and share knowledge, we are bringing together Collaborative Learning, AI and enterprise-grade infrastructure to redefine the future of L&D.

We are now looking for a Chief Financial Officer / VP Finance to help lead this next chapter.

Reporting directly to Benjamin Marchal, our CEO, you will lead our global Finance organization and act as a strategic partner to the CEO, Executive Committee and Board.

Your mission: drive sustainable, profitable growth while strengthening financial discipline, operational performance and long-term value creation. You will help shape our SaaS operating model, optimize resource allocation and balance growth, profitability and cash generation.

Working closely with leaders across Revenue, Product, People and Operations, you will turn financial insights into business decisions, foster accountability and support our strategic priorities, including M&A, investor relations and future liquidity events.

We are looking for a Finance leader who combines strategic vision, strong business judgment and hands-on execution. Whether you are an experienced CFO or a VP Finance ready to step up, this is an opportunity to work directly with the CEO and Board and shape some of the company's most consequential decisions.


Within 1 month, you will:

  • Understand 360Learning's strategy, financial performance, organization, culture and key business priorities.

  • Build strong relationships with the CEO, Executive Committee, Finance team and key internal stakeholders.

  • Review our financial reporting, forecasting, budgeting and performance management processes.

  • Assess the maturity of our Finance organization, systems, internal controls and financial governance.

  • Identify the main drivers of growth, profitability, cash generation and operational efficiency.

  • Deliver an initial diagnostic highlighting key risks, opportunities and short-term priorities.


Within 3 months, you will:

  • Build and align with the CEO on an 18-month Finance roadmap, covering financial performance, operational efficiency, systems, processes, governance and team development.

  • Strengthen financial visibility through accurate forecasting, clear SaaS metrics and actionable management reporting.

  • Establish a strong financial business partnering approach with Revenue, Product, People and other functions.

  • Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency, productivity and resource allocation while protecting strategic investments.

  • Review our financial systems and data infrastructure, identifying automation and scalability opportunities.

  • Take ownership of Board reporting, investor communications and financial planning processes.

  • Assess our current M&A framework and identify opportunities to strengthen due diligence and post-acquisition performance tracking.


Within 12 months, you will:

  • Drive measurable progress towards our growth and profitability ambitions, improving financial efficiency, cash generation and Rule of 40 performance.

  • Establish a best-in-class financial operating model, with reliable forecasts, transparent KPIs and clear accountability across functions.

  • Lead strategic financial initiatives to optimize our cost structure, improve unit economics and support sustainable ARR growth.

  • Build a high-performing, scalable global Finance organization combining strategic business partnering with strong operational execution.

  • Strengthen financial governance, compliance, audit readiness and risk management across our international entities.

  • Support the evaluation, execution and financial integration of strategic acquisitions.

  • Partner with the CEO and Board on long-term financial strategy, capital structure and potential future fundraising or liquidity scenarios.

  • Make Finance a key driver of business performance and shareholder value creation.


The Skill Set:

  • 10+ years in Finance, including senior leadership in B2B SaaS, ideally scaling from €30–50M to €100M+ ARR.

  • Strong grasp of ARR, NRR, CAC, LTV, gross margin, retention and Rule of 40.

  • Expertise in forecasting, financial modeling, performance management and data-driven decision-making.

  • Ability to balance growth investments, profitability, cash generation and operational efficiency.

  • Trusted advisor to the CEO and Executive Committee, able to challenge assumptions and drive accountability.

  • Experience with PE/Growth Equity investors, Board reporting, financial governance and capital allocation.

  • Exposure to M&A, due diligence, fundraising and capital structure; transaction leadership is a plus.

  • Strong command of accounting, reporting, treasury, cash management, compliance and internal controls.

  • Track record of building high-performing teams, automating processes and scaling international Finance operations.

  • Hands-on, pragmatic and accountable, aligned with Convexity’s values of Impact, Rational Thinking, High Accountability and Scalability. Fluent English; French is a plus.


What we offer:

  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈

  • Benefits/Perks: Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent.

  • Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠

  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝

  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter 🌎🌏🌍

  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L & find out more about the teams, product and processes https://bit.ly/42H1ggC 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆


Interview Process:

  • Phone Screen with our Head of Talent Acquisition.

  • Discovery meeting with Benjamin Marchal, CEO.

  • Financial and strategic business case discussion with our CEO and our VP Startegy and Operations.

  • Culture Fit Meeting with our Chief People Officer.

  • Final discussions with key stakeholders and, where relevant, Board representatives.

  • Background Check

  • Offer!

Who We Are360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.
360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.
Learning Includes Everyone.In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment. We want to learn from and with you!

title: Financemanagement Specialist - Fintech (m/w/d) - Germany
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Deine Mission

Du bist die Stimme unserer deutschen Kunden und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass sie mit Pennylane erfolgreich sind. Du hilfst kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen (KMU), ihre Finanzprozesse zu vereinfachen und das volle Potenzial unserer Finanzmanagement-Plattform auszuschöpfen. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du mit uns den Aufbau von Pennylane in Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Onboarding mit Wirkung: Du begleitest neue KMU-Kunden und ihre Steuerkanzleien durch den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess. Du sorgst dafür, dass der Einstieg reibungslos gelingt und Unternehmen schnell von den Möglichkeiten unserer Plattform profitieren.

  • Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und weiterentwickeln: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere bestehenden KMU-Kunden. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, erkennst Potenziale für zusätzliche Funktionen und eine erweiterte Nutzung und hilfst deinen Kunden, ihre unternehmerischen und finanziellen Ziele mit Pennylane zu erreichen.

  • Proaktiv beraten: In regelmäßigen Gesprächen prüfst du, wie erfolgreich deine Kunden mit Pennylane arbeiten und wo sie Unterstützung brauchen. Du steigerst ihre Zufriedenheit, optimierst die Nutzung der Plattform und erkennst frühzeitig, wenn eine Abwanderung droht.

  • Gemeinsam den deutschen Markt gestalten: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem deutschen Sales-Team und dem lokalen Leadership-Team zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Abläufe weiter, bündelt Produktfeedback und treibt das Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland voran.

  • Expertise aufbauen und teilen: Du entwickelst dich zur gefragten Ansprechperson für unsere Plattform und die deutsche Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft. Dein Wissen und bewährte Vorgehensweisen gibst du direkt an unsere KMU-Kunden weiter.

Das bringst du mit

  • Relevante Erfahrung: Du hast 8+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, im Finanzmanagement, in Corporate Finance oder in einer vergleichbaren unternehmensinternen Rolle. Idealerweise hast du selbst mit Finanzprozessen, Rechnungsstellung oder Buchhaltungsabläufen gearbeitet. Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld, bei einem Fintech oder in einer Steuerkanzlei ist ein Plus.

  • Fachliche Grundlage: Du hast ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen. Alternativ bringst du eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, eine Weiterbildung als Steuerfachwirt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Rechnungswesen mit.

  • Verständnis für den deutschen Markt: Du kennst die Anforderungen von KMU an ihr Finanzmanagement und verstehst die zentralen Abläufe rund um Rechnungswesen, Rechnungsstellung und das finanzielle Tagesgeschäft in Deutschland.

  • Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, versetzt dich in deine Kunden hinein und erklärst komplexe finanzielle oder technische Themen einfach und verständlich.

  • Lust, selbst anzupacken: Du möchtest Teil eines Teams sein, das in Deutschland noch am Anfang steht und wächst. Du ergreifst die Initiative, denkst in Lösungen und hast Freude daran, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du freust dich darauf, unser Team beim Onboarding im Pariser Headquarter kennenzulernen, und bist bereit, gelegentlich Kunden in Deutschland zu besuchen – etwa einmal im Monat.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2) und fließend Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren internationalen Teams.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionaryin 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

As an AI Forward Deployed ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.


You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

What you'll be doing:

  •  Deploy and prove. Own the journey from first process file to production workflow. At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see. At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments.

  • Drive organizational adoption. Work across technical and business stakeholders to build understanding and trust, turning early deployments into lasting customer capability.

  • Work at depth technically. Configure and run Camunda clusters locally and in cloud environments. Debug integration failures. Build custom agents where platform defaults don’t fit. Write connector logic that gets legacy enterprise systems talking to ProcessOS.

  • Build the playbook. There is no deployment template yet. Document what good looks like as you discover it, and make the next implementation faster.

  • Feed the product. Custom integrations you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS.

  • Hand off deliberately. Leave customers with a team that can operate independently, is trained on the platform, and acts on improvement results without you.

What you bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

  • Enterprise production experience: you’ve shipped something inside a large organization and stayed to see it operate. You know why governance and resilience matter at scale.

  • Technical depth: You can debug an integration failure, write a custom agent against a legacy API, stand up a Camunda cluster from scratch, and explain generated BPMN to both engineers and business leads.

  • Stakeholder communication: you work effectively across engineering, architecture, and business leadership and adapt how you communicate without losing precision.

  • Practical AI experience: you’ve used AI to solve real problems in production – not just experimented. You understand context management, prompt engineering, agent testing, and integration tradeoffs.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you make sound judgment calls without a playbook and document what you learn.

  • Occasional travel may be required

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in a customer-facing engineering or professional services role.

  • Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or insurance

  • Production experience with agentic systems or AI-integrated workflows.

  • Contributions to a shared platform or open source project that others built on.

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenCreative Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We build AI-powered engines that make, localize, launch and learn from creative, using ElevenLabs’ full audio and video stack. Enterprise customers are already working with us. While our product teams focus on self-serve, these roles seed a dedicated enterprise engineering team: the people who make ElevenCreative work for our biggest customers and unblock enterprise deals. You sit between the customer and the product. You’ll talk to enterprise customers, understand their requirements, and decide whether to build a bespoke integration for them or a product improvement for everyone. Making that call well is the job.

Requirements

  • Has worked directly with customers as a forward-deployed engineer, solutions engineer or founding engineer at a B2B startup, including presenting to enterprise clients.

  • Strong full-stack product engineer, comfortable with integrations, APIs, auth and enterprise plumbing such as SSO, access control and security reviews.

  • Turns a customer’s ask into the real requirement: builds bespoke when it unblocks a deal, and generalizes when several customers want the same thing.

  • Ships end-to-end with little direction. There’s no PM to define everything first.

Bonus: experience with localization or TMS integrations, brand or marketing tooling, or adtech.

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere between the US East Coast and Europe, with the ability to operate in European timezones required and flexibility for customer timezones when deals need it. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London, New York and Warsaw

title: Sales Development Representative (German Speaking)
descriptionHtml:
At Sanity.io, we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like PUMA, Carhartt WIP, Anthropic, Just Eat Takeaway, Spotify, HiPP, and Mercedes AMG are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

You're early in your sales career and you'd like a product you can actually get curious about. We're hiring a German-speaking SDR to open up conversations with the teams building the next wave of content and AI products in the DACH region.

SDRs are the front door to Sanity. You'll start the conversations that become pipeline, and because we're growing quickly, you'll also help decide how those conversations should go. No script handed down from three years ago.

What you will do

  • Own your pipeline from day one
    You're not waiting for leads to land in your lap. You'll be out there, on the phone, in inboxes, sliding into LinkedIn DMs (professionally), starting real conversations with people who have real problems Sanity can solve. You find them, you qualify them, you build the pipeline.

  • Become the person who gets it
    Sanity isn't your average SaaS pitch. We're selling a new way of thinking about content: treat it like data, so AI and teams can actually do something with it. You'll get deep on the product, then put it in language that makes both developers and execs lean forward. In German and in English.

  • Have a seat at the table
    This isn't a smile-and-dial role. Your frontline conversations shape messaging, strategy and the product roadmap. Marketing wants your feedback. Sales needs your handovers to be tight. Leadership is listening. What you hear on calls travels.

  • Get serious about your craft
    Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn. You'll know your tools cold and use them to run a clean, sharp operation. Good data hygiene isn't glamorous, but it's what separates good SDRs from great ones.

  • Help build something from scratch
    We're growing fast and the playbook isn't finished, because you'll help write it. Spot a better way to run outreach? Say so. We'll try it.

About you

  • You have previous experience in an SDR role or similar, out-bounding prospects, preferably in SaaS

  • You speak fluent German, and English

  • A target motivates you more than it worries you

title: Senior Growth Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work.

Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked.

We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging.

What You'll Do

  • Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them.
  • Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads.
  • Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first.
  • Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own.
  • Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them.
  • Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers.

Hiring Process

  1. Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work)
  2. 15-minute phone screen
  3. First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo.
  4. Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem
  5. Culture fit (45 min)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

You Should Have

  • 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS: you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work.
  • Product craft and taste: you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX.
  • An AI-native way of working and building: you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change.
  • You do your own analysis: you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything.
  • Experience with technical products: you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs.
  • Clear writing and comfort working async: we're a distributed team across 12+ countries, and most decisions happen in writing, in English.

The five years don't all have to be in a PM role. If you were a product engineer or a founder and owned a growth metric, please apply.

Good to Have

  • Data quality, data observability, data governance, or data infrastructure experience.
  • Experience with product-led growth at a company that also sells to enterprises.
  • Experience with Shape Up or another fixed-time, variable-scope way of working.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Compensation €120,000–140,000/year + equity.
  • Outside Belgium, this is a contractor position.
  • Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
  • In-person kickoffs every two months in cool locations across Europe, three days with the whole product and engineering team.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • A senior team that ships, across 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • You own the adoption metrics: you decide how we measure adoption and what we do to improve it.
  • Lots of room to improve: we already have enterprise customers and usage data, and we've done very little growth work so far.
  • Your own engineering team: you'll work with dedicated engineers who build agentically, so your ideas get shipped quickly.
  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours, colleagues in 12+ countries.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Small numbers: we have relatively few accounts and feedback is slow. If you're used to deciding from consumer-scale data, you may find that frustrating.
  • No playbook: this is the first dedicated growth PM role at Soda.

title: Software Engineer (Computer Use & Integrations) (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Software Engineer – Backend (Computer Use & Integrations) (m/w/d)

Remote job

About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

What to expect as our Software Engineer – Backend (Computer Use & Integrations) (m/w/d):

  • Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

In this role, you can make an impact and grow with us as Software Engineer

You'll help build Recare's Operator, our agent that gets AI-generated clinical output into hospital systems by operating their existing software the way a person would, no bespoke interface required. It's the sharp end of our integration strategy: a Windows desktop application that automates UI interactions with hospital systems, running on doctors' devices and often inside RDP or Citrix environments. The first version is already live – you'll help expand its capabilities and make it reliable in production.

  • You build and improve integrations between hospital systems and Recare products.

  • You implement and harden computer-use automation flows so they work reliably in production, including edge cases, recovery, and safety rails.

  • You partner with clinical domain experts to turn ambiguous workflows into shippable plans and robust implementations that solve real customers' needs.

  • You contribute across the stack as needed, including our Go-based gateway.

  • You invest in observability foundations (logs, metrics, traces) so we can trust the system in production.

How we work:

  • AI-native – our engineers reach for frontier coding agents every day to move fast across the whole stack, and we want strong, opinionated views on how to wield them well.

  • Frontier models – we build on the best models available and adopt new capabilities as they ship, not a release later.

  • Human-in-the-loop by default – this is healthcare: AI proposes, people stay in control, and we design the approval and validation loops that make that real.

  • Unglamorous foundations – engineers get the time to build the eval harnesses, guardrails, and observability that make AI trustworthy in production, not just the feature on top.

  • Ship and observe – always deployable, telemetry-driven, fix in the open.


Here's how we picture you as our Software Engineer

  • You're a builder with a hacker mindset: you default to building rather than waiting, and you're solution-oriented rather than problem-oriented.

  • You have professional backend experience in Go, Python, or TypeScript, and you can point to production software you shipped and owned.

  • You're comfortable working on integration-heavy systems: APIs, workflows, data models, auth, and real-world edge cases.

  • You're pragmatic about reliability: you care about monitoring, debugging, test coverage, and making systems operable.

  • You're excited to use AI coding agents daily and have opinions on how to use them effectively.

  • You're ambitious but frustration-tolerant. Hospital IT is complicated and progress is hard-won; you stay relentless, get your hands dirty, and iterate until it works.

  • You communicate confidently in English and collaborate well across Product, Engineering, and Operations.

Nice to have:

  • German language skills.

  • Experience with Electron or TypeScript on the desktop side.

  • Experience with healthcare IT systems (HIS, KIS, PVS, EMR) and interoperability standards such as HL7 v2 or FHIR.
