Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

An overview of this role

As a Threat Research Engineer, you’ll take ideas from the first question to a working proof of concept, deploy it, and analyze the results yourself. This is a full-stack role, with AI central to how we work. You’ll build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection, and use AI tools every day to move faster.

What you’ll do

  • Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.
  • Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.
  • Analyze software supply chain incidents and events.
  • Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.
  • Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.
  • Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.
  • Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.
  • Take part in on-call or operational support where your team's ownership model requires it.

What you’ll bring

  • Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with both a developer mindset and an adversarial mindset: you can build systems and think about how to break them.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI in real work, such as building with large language model APIs or agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or agent SDKs.
  • Strong programming skills in Go or Python, with good software engineering practices including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery, and maintainable code.
  • Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.
  • Understanding of how package ecosystems work and how software supply chain attacks happen.
  • Ability to map possible attack vectors, name trade-offs, and make data-driven decisions, balancing quality and speed with customer outcomes in mind while keeping up with security and AI industry trends.
  • Clear writing that explains findings to both engineers and a general audience.
  • Helpful, but not required: published vulnerability findings; security research on AI agents, large language model applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers; Google Cloud Platform experience; or infrastructure as code experience with Terraform or OpenTofu.

You don’t need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing engines. A high-level understanding is enough.

About the team

The Threat Research group researches security threats as they emerge and turns what we learn into protection for GitLab customers. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab’s dependency scanning. We also build detection capabilities, do original vulnerability research, and publish what we find. Recent work includes the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Serena, a popular MCP coding agent. You can read more on the Security Labs blog.

title: Sales Planning & Strategy
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🧩 Context of the role

You will be part of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, whose goal is to

  • Define an ambitious strategy to achieve our business objectives and translate this into an actionable plan

  • Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives

  • Enable our Sales and Account Management teams to achieve these business objectives and become the most effective commercial teams in the tech industry (i.e., Sales and AM effectiveness, tools, analytics and training)

Across all these areas we work very closely with the Senior Leadership, the Sales, Account Management and Go-to-Market teams. The scope is Global (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada for the time being).

You will be owning medium to large scale/complexity projects (depending on your skills and experience) on the Business Planning and Strategy area. These would include:

    • Propose adjustments to the plan on a quarterly basis and support Board preparation

  • Sales & Account Manager Planning

    • Translate the plan into actionable sales & Account Management objectives, ensuring their quality, scalability and accuracy

  • Performance monitoring & Steering

    • Lead or support strategic explorations (e.g. new segment, new distribution models) to frame strategic decisions

    • Monitor closely results and execution to gather learnings and adjust where necessary, sharing key learnings with the community and the company on a monthly basis

    • Work on transversal topics that allow us to gain insights & better steer the team performance (competition analysis, implementation & monitoring of pricing strategies, ...)

🧐 Skills we are looking for

We look above all for exceptional people motivated and committed in building one of the most effective Strategy and Planning team.

At least 3 years of experience within either:

  • Business strategy, sales strategy & operations, revenue operations or business finance/ strategic finance departments in a B2B company (preferably)

  • Management consulting, investment banking or private equity

Critical thinking and problem solving skills:

  • Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity, bringing structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity

  • Deep analytical rigour, bringing clarity on complex topics through deep insights

  • Great Excel skills and moderate SQL knowledge. Experience with AI tools and building moderate to complex flows.

  • Ability to handle workload & short turnaround time, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility, when some topics are top priority for the company

Business sense:

  • At ease with B2B operational and financial metrics

  • Passion for getting close to the business and Sales/Marketing teams and understanding the operational details of their work, not just the strategic ones

Communication and presence:

  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and align multiple stakeholders in a collaborative way

  • Ability to build successful relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance and be seen as a trusted contributor/advisor

  • Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility

  • Great written and oral structure and communication

  • Fluency in English (French is a strong plus)

Nice to have

  • Experience in the SaaS/Tech sectors

  • Exposure to large sales teams (100+)

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

title: SAR Remote Sensing Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As SAR Remote Sensing Engineer, you are the subject matter expert on applying advanced signal processing and machine learning to SAR data within our RF analytics team. You own the analytics layer end to end: algorithm design, real-time implementation and field validation on real captures from our own platforms. You will also shape the move toward multi-modal solutions that combine SAR with optical and RF sensor feeds. Cycles are measured in months, and the scope grows with the company.

Responsibilities

  • Lead initiatives using SAR polarimetry and coherence for automated change detection.

  • Design and prototype state-of-the-art machine learning models for SAR image segmentation.

  • Develop algorithms for target detection and object classification on SAR data.

  • Fuse SAR with optical, RF and other data sources to support GNSS-denied operations.

  • Port algorithms from Python prototypes to real-time pipelines with software and embedded/FPGA teams.

  • Build the capture, labelling and replay tooling that makes performance claims reproducible.

  • Validate performance on simulated and real-world datasets, in the lab and on field-test campaigns.

  • Work with radar, radio, electronic warfare and computer vision teams to define what the analytics layer needs from each sensor.

Candidate Requirements

  • Master’s or PhD in electrical engineering, telecommunications engineering, signal processing, applied mathematics or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in radar signal processing or SAR remote sensing.

  • Deep understanding of SAR phenomenology and its information content, including coherence, amplitude, phase and polarimetry.

  • Theoretical and practical expertise in machine learning, both deep learning and classical techniques.

  • Experience taking at least one algorithm from prototype to real hardware running on real signals.

  • Strong Python skills and sound engineering practices (Git, code reviews, testing, documentation).

  • Exposure to GEOINT, ELINT or SIGINT work is a plus, and you are comfortable with defense security vetting.

  • Willingness to travel periodically to lab and field tests.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

About the Team

The Senior Accountant owns core areas of the general ledger and month-end close, delivering accurate, timely financials in a high-growth environment. As a Senior Accountant, this role is expected to demonstrate strong competency across all key areas of the position, own outcomes end-to-end within their assigned areas, identify and propose process improvements, and collaborate cross-functionally with Central Cash, FA, Intercompany and Leases, AP/AR, payroll, tax, and external auditors. The role works independently on established processes, escalates early on blockers, and is measured against Coreweave defined HR plan.

Key Responsibilities:

Month-End Close & General Ledger

Own assigned tasks on the month-end close checklist, completing them by their working-day deadlines and escalate any issues as needed.  Review journal entries (cash, accruals, prepaids, reclasses, allocations) prepared by shared service center with complete supporting documentation. Review balance sheet reconciliations for an assigned portfolio of accounts by WD as assigned, resolving reconciling items so no unexplained differences remain above materiality thresholds. Understand fixed assets including additions, disposals, and amortization, leases and intercompany prepared by the central team. 

Reporting & Analysis

 Review monthly flux/variance analysis for assigned P&L and balance sheet accounts, explaining all variances above defined thresholds with business drivers.Review monthly reporting packages prepared by shared service organisation and prepare a highlights memo for leadership Test assumptions and recommend data-informed solutions when investigating discrepancies or unusual activity.  Review and close the transaction in the secondary ledger.

Controls, Audit & Compliance

Execute assigned internal controls (SOX or equivalent) accurately and on time, maintaining complete evidence with zero exceptions.  Deliver assigned PBC requests for external audit and internal testing, complete and within agreed turnaround.   Ensure accounting treatment complies with US GAAP and company policy; flag technical questions to management early.

Process Improvement & Team Support

Identify inefficiencies in close, reconciliation, and reporting processes and propose or implement improvements (automation, standardization, checklist redesign). Maintain current desktop procedures for all owned processes.  Support onboarding of new team members and provide peer review and coverage during high-volume periods, including quarter-end and year-end.

Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • 3+  years of progressive accounting experience, including ownership of month-end close tasks and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP.
  • Hands-on experience with a major ERP (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle) and advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups/INDEX-MATCH).
  • Track record of meeting hard close deadlines with high accuracy and complete documentation
  • Track record of setting up new processes and controls

Preferred Skills:

  • CPA/ACA/ACCA/CIMA or active CPA/ACA/ACCA/CIMA candidate.
  • Public company or public accounting (audit) experience, including SOX control execution.
  • Experience in high-growth technology, infrastructure, or data center environments.
  • Exposure to close-management or reconciliation tools (e.g., FloQast) and an interest in automation.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast!  We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values: 

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:

  • Family-level Medical Insurance
  • Family-level Dental Insurance 
  • Generous Pension Contribution 
  • Life Assurance at 4x Salary 
  • Critical Illness Cover 
  • Employee Assistance Programme 
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Work culture focused on innovative disruption

Benefits may vary by location. 

Equal Opportunity 

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

Recruitment Agencies

CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.

Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to technology and/or source code subject to U.S. export control laws. Any such access will be provided only in compliance with applicable U.S. export control requirements. As part of the recruitment process, CoreWeave may request limited information reasonably necessary to assess applicable export-control requirements. 

Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications 

When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by CoreWeave UK Ltd. (“Controller”), which is located at

Phosphor (6th Floor), 133 Park Street, London, SE1 9EA

and can be contacted by emailing ----- Controller’s data protection officer can be contacted at ----- Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. Such processing is legally permissible under Art. 6(1)(f) of (i) Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”) and (ii) the GDPR as it forms part of the laws of the UK (“UK GDPR”), as necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the Controller, which are the solicitation, evaluation, and selection of applicants for employment. Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Controller to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Controller’s behalf. With respect to transfers originating from the UK or the European Economic Area ("EEA") to a country outside the UK or the EEA, we implement the appropriate transfer mechanism(s) and other appropriate solutions to address cross-border transfers as required by applicable law. You may request a copy of the suitable mechanisms we have in place by contacting us at Your personal data will be retained by Controller as long as Controller determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for employment. Where permitted by applicable law, we may also retain your personal data for a limited period after the recruitment process ends in order to consider you for future job opportunities, respond to legal claims, or comply with record-keeping obligations. Under the GDPR and the UK GDPR, you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. You also have the right to data portability. In addition, you may lodge a complaint with the relevant supervisory authority: (i) A list of Europe’s data protection authorities can be found here; and (ii) for the UK, this is the Information Commissioner's Office.

For additional information, please see our Privacy Policy.

title: (Senior) AI Engineer (w/d/m)
descriptionHtml:
Du verantwortest AI-Systeme für den Mittelstand, vom ersten Termin bei Kund:innen bis zum laufenden Betrieb. WE BUILD AI gibt es seit Februar 2025. Wir sind rund zehn Leute in einem Loftbüro in Köln-Ehrenfeld und bauen AI-Lösungen für den gehobenen Mittelstand.

  • Level: Regular oder Senior

  • Ort: Köln-Ehrenfeld und Homeoffice

  • Start: ab sofort

Bei uns gehört dir ein Projekt

Du arbeitest immer in einem Projektteam mit anderen Engineers und Consultants. Gemeinsam klärt ihr mit Fachbereich und IT-Leitung unserer Kund:innen, was sie brauchen. Die Architektur verantwortest du, und das System bauen und betreiben wir zusammen.

So läuft ein Projekt bei uns

Ein typisches Projekt hat drei Phasen, und du begleitest alle als technisch verantwortliche Person im Projektteam.

  1. Discovery Sprint mit dem Fachbereich: Wir legen fest, welches Problem wir lösen und woran wir den Erfolg messen.

  2. Pilotphase mit klaren Go/No-Go-Kriterien: Ihr baut eine erste Version, die Nutzer:innen im Fachbereich testen.

  3. Ausbau und Betrieb: Trägt der Pilot, bringt ihr das System in den Alltag und haltet es mit Monitoring stabil.

Deine Aufgaben

Bei aktuellen Projekten dreht es sich viel um das Training von eigenen VLMs und um das, was jedes Unternehmen umtreibt: den Einsatz von Agentic AI im gesamten Unternehmenskosmos.

  • Du konzipierst LLM-Anwendungen mit RAG, strukturierter Extraktion und Agentic Workflows und entscheidest die Architektur.

  • Backend-Services und APIs entwickelst du in Python, meist mit FastAPI.

  • Auf Azure, meist mit Azure OpenAI und AI Foundry, bringst du die Systeme in Betrieb und betreust sie dort.

  • Mit Tests, Evaluation und Monitoring sicherst du die Qualität von Anfang an.

  • Gemeinsam mit unseren Consultants klärst du Anforderungen mit Fachbereich und IT-Leitung der Kund:innen.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens eine LLM-Anwendung oder ein ML-Modell selbst in Betrieb gebracht, die Menschen im Arbeitsalltag nutzen.

  • Python beherrschst du sicher, inklusive Tests und Deployment.

  • Erfahrung mit einer Cloud-Plattform bringst du mit, am liebsten Azure, alternativ AWS oder GCP.

  • Deine technischen Entscheidungen kannst du begründen, auch gegenüber Kund:innen.

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine Ausbildung in Informatik, Mathematik, Data Science oder einem verwandten Feld, alternativ vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, weil der Kundenkontakt auf Deutsch läuft.

  • Klassisches Machine Learning ist ein Plus.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Den Aufbau eines Unternehmens begleiten und eine neue Generation von Beratung und Engineering prägen

  • Benefit-Budget von 30 Euro im Monat für Gutscheine bei über 100 Anbietern, Urban Sports Club oder das Deutschlandticket

  • Dienstrad-Leasing per Gehaltsumwandlung mit bis zu 40 Prozent Ersparnis, Vollkasko und Wartung inklusive

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice nach eigener Verantwortung

  • Mentoring, Peer Reviews und regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche mit ehrlichem Feedback

  • Gemeinsame Workations und regelmäßige Teamevents

  • Loftbüro in Köln-Ehrenfeld mit Bürohunden, Getränken, Snacks und Mario Kart

Ehrlich vorab

Wir sind ein kleines Team ohne eigenes Plattform-Team, und viele technische Entscheidungen triffst du selbst. Wer lieber in einem großen Team an einem eigenen Produkt arbeitet, ist woanders vermutlich glücklicher.

Bewirb dich bei uns

Das ist der Ablauf unseres Bewerbungsverfahrens:

  1. Gemeinsamer Call, etwa 30 Minuten. Wir sprechen über dich und über uns.

  2. Probeaufgabe mit etwa 2 Stunden Aufwand. Danach stellst du deine Lösung in 45 bis 60 Minuten vor.

  3. Treffen in Köln mit gemeinsamem Essen, Einblick in laufende Projekte und fachlichem Sparring im Team.

Nach jedem Schritt hörst du innerhalb von einem Werktag von uns. Von der Bewerbung bis zum Angebot planen wir drei Wochen.

title: Senior AI Product Manager - Platform
descriptionHtml:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior AI Product Manager to join our Platform team. Platform powers every customer journey at Zego: the core services behind quoting, buying, paying for, changing, renewing and cancelling a policy.

You’ll own a product domain within Platform, defining its quarterly strategy and goals and helping refine the longer-term platform strategy as we rebuild and modernise some of Zego’s most critical services. You’ll turn technical challenges into business value, and make sure your services are resilient, compliant and ready to be used by AI agents as well as our apps.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Define your domain’s quarterly strategy and goals, and help refine the longer-term plans for Platform, balancing new capability, legacy rebuilds and reliability.

  • Lead complex discovery autonomously as we modernise the policy lifecycle, moving capability off legacy systems one safe slice at a time.

  • Dive deep into technical detail, understanding dependencies and failure modes, and making informed trade-offs with engineering.

  • Treat internal teams as your customers, so launching a new product, price or journey on the platform is fast and predictable.

  • Make your services AI-ready, with clean, well-documented APIs and data that agents and automations can use safely, and establish AI-enabled workflows for your domain.

  • Put the right metrics in place, from reliability and incidents to time-to-launch and cost to serve, and build the business case for platform investment.

  • Build compliance in from day one with Legal, Compliance and Finance, so money flows and customer communications are accurate and auditable.

  • Bring stakeholders along, running ceremonies with senior stakeholders, facilitating big-room planning and knowing when to escalate.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • Platform product ownership. A track record of owning a technical, platform or backend product domain and delivering material business impact in a high-growth environment.

  • Technical literacy. Confident with engineers on system architecture, APIs, event-driven services and workflow orchestration. Ideally, you come from engineering or data science.

  • Legacy modernisation. You’ve led incremental rebuilds of business-critical services while keeping the lights on.

  • Data and commercial fluency. You use financial, behavioural and usage data to ground decisions, query Snowflake or Looker yourself, and can build the case for platform investment.

  • Clarity in complexity. You untangle dependencies across multiple business domains and explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Regulated environment. Ideally, experience in insurance, payments, lending or financial services, with compliance built into product design.

  • You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

Equal opportunities 🌈

We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: Senior Applied Research Scientist - Personalization
descriptionHtml:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.
Within Personalization, the Speak Team owns the development of Spotify's state-of-the-art speech models, contributing to speech recognition, speech synthesis, and speech-to-speech models. We craft voice models that match human-level emotional expressiveness, so we can deeply engage our listeners and support creators at scale. Our groundbreaking work on speech synthesis relies on state-of-the-art deep learning methods and evaluation techniques, highly efficient data processing and model serving, and capturing audio of outstanding quality from our voice talent pool.
We're looking for a senior applied research scientist with experience in developing novel ML techniques and architectures and with a strong interest in working across a full production pipeline to produce state-of-the-art generative conversational speech-to-speech models. You'll collaborate with our engineering teams to help develop our production pipelines, explore new ideas and methods to improve quality, understanding and realism, as well as push the frontiers of what is possible with our speech technology.
What You'll Do
  • Develop and experiment with new methods for speech synthesis and speech recognition, along with end-to-end approaches, building on the latest research and ideas.
  • Work towards the expansion of our speech use-cases targeting different markets and products.
  • Be part of a highly motivated research team dedicated to building and creating models at scale to power the Spotify platform.
  • Champion best practices for research and development, sharing your knowledge and experience with other researchers within Speak.
  • Collaborate with our engineering and data teams on ideas requiring new infrastructure or new high-quality data, as well as to help improve our speech recognition and speech synthesis pipelines, and help turn proven ideas into scalable products.

    • Who You Are
  • You have a strong background in ML (PhD degree on top of professional experience), and experience in working with any of the following: transformers, GANs, diffusion models, flow matching, VAEs, audio codecs.
  • You have experience in developing generative models for speech synthesis, speech recognition, audio/music, natural language processing, or computer vision.
  • You have strong experience with Python, particularly PyTorch.
  • You have strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical ideas with clarity to technical and non-technical people alike.
  • You have experience in an academic or professional setting conducting high-quality research.

    • Where You'll Be
  • This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home
    • Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens. At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Engineer (Terraform / AKS / Azure DevOps) – Freelance
descriptionHtml:
About the opportunity

For an international enterprise project in the semiconductor and mechanical engineering industries, we are seeking 5 highly experienced Senior Azure Cloud Engineers.

We are looking for hands-on engineers who can independently build, automate, maintain, secure, and troubleshoot complex Microsoft Azure environments.

The project operates within a business-critical enterprise landscape with SAP-related dependencies. Strong production experience, automation expertise, and a structured approach to complex technical incidents are essential.

Project details

  • Start: Early December 2026

  • Duration: End of February 2027

  • Workload: Full-time (5 positions available)

  • Location: Primarily remote from within the EU

  • On-site requirement: Netherlands, 14 January – 7 February 2027

  • Language: English C2 or demonstrably equivalent proficiency

  • Contract: Freelance

Your responsibilities

  • Design, implement, operate, and optimize infrastructure and cloud services on Microsoft Azure.

  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform.

  • Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

  • Provision and manage Azure IaaS and PaaS resources, incl.: Azure Virtual Machines, Azure Storage Accounts, Azure Key Vault, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Databricks, Azure Application Gateway

  • Deploy, administer, and troubleshoot containerized workloads and Kubernetes environments.

  • Develop and maintain infrastructure automation using PowerShell, Shell scripting, YAML, and Python.

  • Implement and improve automated infrastructure security checks and security controls.

  • Establish reliable logging, monitoring, and alerting across cloud infrastructure and applications.

  • Investigate and resolve complex production incidents in business-critical enterprise environments.

  • Collaborate with infrastructure, database, SAP, and application teams to ensure stable operations.

  • Contribute to performance improvements, operational resilience, and cloud engineering best practices.

Your profile

Required qualifications

  • Extensive hands-on experience as a Senior Azure Cloud Engineer, Platform Engineer, or DevOps Engineer.

  • Strong production experience with Microsoft Azure IaaS and PaaS services.

  • Proven expertise in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.

  • Advanced experience with CI/CD pipelines, particularly Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

  • Strong practical knowledge of Kubernetes, containers, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

  • Experience working with Azure Storage, Virtual Machines, Key Vault, Application Gateway, and Databricks.

  • Proficiency in PowerShell, Shell scripting, YAML, and Python.

  • Experience implementing automated infrastructure security controls.

  • Strong knowledge of logging, monitoring, alerting, and operational troubleshooting.

  • Ability to resolve complex technical problems independently in business-critical environments.

  • English language proficiency at C2 level or demonstrably equivalent.

  • Residence within the EU and willingness to work on-site in the Netherlands during the specified period.

  • Availability for a full-time freelance assignment starting in December 2026.

Additional advantages

  • Experience supporting SAP-related cloud infrastructure or SAP-dependent enterprise environments.

  • Strong DevSecOps and cloud security expertise.

  • Experience with high-availability architecture, disaster recovery, and production incident management.

  • Azure certifications or comparable evidence of advanced Azure engineering expertise.

  • Previous experience in large international enterprise environments.

What we offer

  • A technically demanding assignment in a large international enterprise environment.

  • The opportunity to work on complex Azure infrastructure and automation challenges.

  • A primarily remote engagement with a defined on-site project phase.

  • Collaboration with experienced cloud, database, and infrastructure specialists.

  • An hourly rate aligned with your qualifications and seniority.

  • Direct communication and ongoing support through Sidekick Network.

Interested?

Please apply through JOIN and provide:

  • Your current CV or detailed technical profile

  • Your earliest availability

  • Your location and country of residence

  • Your expected hourly rate in EUR

  • Confirmation of your availability for on-site work in the Netherlands from 14 January to 7 February 2027

  • A short summary of your hands-on experience with Azure, Terraform, AKS, Azure DevOps/GitHub, and business-critical production environments

We look forward to connecting with senior Azure engineers who combine strong automation skills with the ability to take ownership of complex production environments.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or UK Remote | 💰 Senior Engineer (L50) £105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Technology - Engineering  

About our Engineering Teams:

We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.

These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.

We contribute to open source software as much as possible. Our blogis a good place to learn even more about what we do!

Your day-to-day   

This role is all about collaborating with your team to make a difference to your customers. As a backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside other disciplines like product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more! 

Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). They are: Core Banking, Business Banking, Wealth, Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Platform, Fincrime, Security & Expansion. All of our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront- from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.

They’re all looking for additional Backend Engineers right now, we do a standard interview process across all our collectives and at the end we will find the best match for you based on your skills, experience, preferences and aligning with the business need! 

Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.

How we work 💻

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️

Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency 🕣✨

If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

You should apply if:

  • you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product
  • you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day
  • you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions
  • you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity
  • you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software
  • you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).
  • you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing

We're on the look out for L50 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our Engineering Progression Framework - we will interview you across the whole frame work, so if you are not sure what level you are aiming for please chat to your recruiters! 

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything thats listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

descriptionHtml:
About AllShore Talent

AllShore Talent partners with growing organizations to build high-performing technology and consulting teams. We connect skilled professionals with meaningful, long-term engagements across web technologies, digital experience platforms, and enterprise software delivery — offering competitive compensation, flexible engagement models, and a collaborative, remote-friendly culture.

About The Role

The Senior CJA Consultant is a senior, customer-facing digital analytics specialist responsible for helping customers successfully migrate from Adobe Analytics to Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA). Extensive web analytics experience is fundamental to the role, together with proven hands-on experience delivering at least one Adobe Analytics-to-CJA migration. The consultant combines deep knowledge of Adobe Analytics and CJA with strong measurement, reporting, migration and stakeholder consulting skills.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead customer discovery focused on the existing Adobe Analytics implementation, business measurement requirements, reporting estate, users and priority use cases.

  • Assess report suites, variables, events, classifications, segments, calculated metrics, attribution approaches, Analysis Workspace projects and governance practices.

  • Define a pragmatic Adobe Analytics-to-CJA migration approach, identifying what should be migrated, rationalised, redesigned or retired rather than defaulting to a one-for-one recreation.

  • Translate business questions, KPIs and measurement requirements into CJA dimensions, metrics, filters, calculated metrics, derived fields, attribution models and reporting experiences.

  • Configure and govern CJA Connections, Data Views and Analysis Workspace reporting in collaboration with Data Architects and technical consultants.

  • Work with AEP specialists to ensure schemas, datasets, identities and ingestion designs support the required analytics and reporting outcomes.

  • Define and execute reporting validation and reconciliation between Adobe Analytics, source data, AEP and CJA; investigate material differences and explain them clearly to stakeholders.

  • Guide customers through changes in analytics concepts and ways of working, including where CJA should improve on rather than simply reproduce the legacy Analytics implementation.

  • Build priority CJA workspaces and reporting components and enable analysts and business users to adopt CJA effectively.

  • Provide senior consulting leadership in workshops, design reviews, migration decisions, acceptance discussions and customer enablement.

  • Understanding of AEP guardrails and licensing constraints, including recognising when a design is technically possible but not available under the customer’s licence.

  • lead workshops, present and recommend solutions, document designs and gain customer agreement.



Experience and skills

Essential

  • Extensive professional experience in web analytics and digital measurement, including complex enterprise websites or digital products.

  • Deep hands-on Adobe Analytics experience, including implementation design, report suites, eVars, props, events, classifications, processing rules, segments, calculated metrics, attribution and Analysis Workspace.

  • Proven hands-on experience delivering at least one Adobe Analytics-to-Customer Journey Analytics migration.

  • Strong hands-on Customer Journey Analytics experience, including Connections, Data Views, dimensions, metrics, filters, derived fields, calculated metrics, attribution and Analysis Workspace.

  • Working knowledge of Adobe Experience Platform and how XDM schemas, datasets and identity choices affect CJA analysis and reporting.

  • Ability to assess a large legacy Analytics implementation and make informed recommendations on migration, rationalisation and redesign.

  • Strong experience in analytics QA, data validation and reconciliation, including diagnosing differences between Adobe Analytics and CJA.

  • Ability to translate business objectives into measurement frameworks, KPIs and practical reporting solutions.

  • Strong customer-facing consulting skills, including discovery, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management and constructive challenge.

  • Ability to communicate the differences and trade-offs between Adobe Analytics and CJA to both business and technical audiences.

Highly desirable

  • Experience with Adobe Tags / Adobe Launch and Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK.

  • Experience with mobile analytics and Adobe Experience Platform Mobile SDK.

  • Understanding of CJA identity approaches, including field-based and graph-based stitching.

  • Experience migrating or rationalising Analytics Workspace projects, segments, calculated metrics and other reporting components.

  • Experience with cross-channel analytics, combining web or app behavioural data with CRM, transactional or other offline datasets.

  • Experience defining CJA governance, component standards and self-service analytics practices.

  • Familiarity with SQL, AEP Query Service or other data-query tools for migration validation and troubleshooting.

  • Relevant Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics or Adobe Experience Platform certification.

Expected deliverables

  • Current-state Adobe Analytics and reporting assessment.

  • Analytics component inventory, rationalisation recommendations and migration plan.

  • Measurement and KPI mapping from Adobe Analytics to CJA.

  • CJA Connection and Data View design and configuration guidance.

  • Priority CJA Workspace projects, metrics, filters and reporting components.

  • Data validation, reconciliation and acceptance approach.

  • Migration risks, assumptions, dependencies and decision log.

  • Customer analyst enablement, governance recommendations and transition documentation.

Engagement details section:

  • Contract role.

  • Starts soon; a two-week notice period is acceptable.

  • Lasts 1–3 years.

  • Remote anywhere in EMEA, preferably Central Europe.

  • Occasional business travel, with expenses covered.

Program context: two migration paths built on AEP (AA → CJA and Campaign Classic → AJO). Customers are mostly B2C, across the UK, France, Spain, Germany, Norway and Italy.

Languages: strong professional English is required. German, French or Italian is highly valued.

title: Senior Counsel, Competition & Litigation
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

Our global Legal team has built a strong reputation within the company for our highly collaborative and supportive approach to counseling, always with a bias for action. We are a diverse group of lawyers and legal professionals with a shared passion for providing creative, best-in-class service to our business partners. The Competition & Litigation team advises DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo on antitrust, competition, and litigation matters across every market we operate in.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Counsel, Competition & Litigation to join our growing Legal team and work globally across the DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo brands. Reporting to the Director, Competition & Litigation, you'll be a generalist antitrust attorney who can move fast: advising product and business teams in real time, supporting M&A and strategic investments alongside our Corporate Development team, and driving forward regulatory investigations and inquiries, with a particular focus on Europe. This is a hybrid role that will require you to work from our London HQ or Brussels office for a minimum of 3 days a week.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Serve as a trusted antitrust/competition advisor to product, business, and corporate development teams, delivering fast, practical counsel that lets the business move with velocity while properly managing risk.
  • Advise on the competition and antitrust dimensions of M&A transactions, strategic investments, and commercial partnerships, partnering closely with Corporate Development and our sales teams.
  • Manage antitrust and competition regulatory investigations and inquiries globally.
  • Help build out DoorDash's international competition compliance program, partnering with the Director, Competition & Litigation on training, policies, and processes across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.
  • Support competition-related litigation matters as needed, including document collection and review, witness preparation, and responses to third-party subpoenas.
  • Partner with policy and government relations teams to track legal and regulatory developments that could affect the business.

We're excited about you because…

  • You are a qualified solicitor in England & Wales (or bring similar qualifications in another European jurisdiction) with significant experience providing strategic legal advice to international businesses.
  • You have 7+ years of experience at a leading law firm and/or in-house legal department, with a strong grounding in antitrust/competition law as a generalist — spanning M&A counseling, litigation, and regulatory/government investigations.
  • You have experience advising on competition issues in mergers, acquisitions, and strategic investments, including regulatory filings and clearance strategy.
  • You have experience handling antitrust/competition regulatory inquiries or investigations, ideally including direct engagement with regulators such as the European Commission, UK CMA, DOJ, FTC, or other competition authorities.
  • You're comfortable operating as a generalist across a broad portfolio — you don't need deep pre-existing expertise in every sub-area, but you can quickly get up to speed and give practical, business-minded advice.
  • You're an excellent product counselor: able to translate complex antitrust concepts into clear, fast, actionable guidance for product and business teams.
  • You're comfortable working across multiple jurisdictions and legal systems, and can navigate the added complexity of advising across three global brands (DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo).
  • You have strong organizational skills and can juggle multiple concurrent workstreams in a fast-moving environment, both independently and as part of a team.
  • You're an outstanding communicator, both orally and in writing, with sound judgment on when to escalate and when to move forward independently.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Partner closely with business stakeholders with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Learn something new everyday Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine. Our interview process typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Analyst (B2C) – Marketing Automation (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Analytics first: Du baust CRM und Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji komplett neu auf, vom analytischen Fundament bis zur Integration der Systeme – datengetrieben, KI-enabled und mit hohem Iterationstempo.

In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle verantwortest du die Segmentierungs- und Journey-Logik unserer B2C-Kommunikation. Dein Werkzeug sind Daten, nicht Pixel: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in Events, Segmente und Journey-Konzepte, wertest Tests aus und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse. Kampagnen und Content kommen aus dem Marketing- und UI/UX-Team, du lieferst das Wer, Wann und Warum. Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind Analytics, und KI-Tools wie Claude nutzt du dabei ganz selbstverständlich.

Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Dazu kommt eine riesige Datenbasis: Fast alle Kund:innen sind registriert und haben ein eigenes Profil. Du entwickelst die Logik für dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kommunikation über alle Kanäle – von der Foodji App über In-App-Messages, Push und Mail bis zum Foodji Screen direkt am Gerät – und nutzt Daten, um sie kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Deine Mission bei Foodji

  • Du legst das analytische und konzeptionelle Fundament für eine skalierbare CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion für unsere B2C-Kund:innen.

  • Von der Hypothese über Segmentierung und Testdesign bis zur Auswertung von A/B-Tests und Kohorten: Du definierst, was wir ausprobieren, misst, was wirkt, und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse.

  • Welche Events lösen welche Kommunikation aus? Du definierst sie auf Basis unserer Daten, konzipierst dynamische Segmente und Journeys, die Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen, und entscheidest datenbasiert, ob App, In-App, Push, Mail oder Foodji Screen der richtige Kanal ist.

  • In Snowflake und mit KI-Tools wie Claude analysierst du Daten eigenständig, findest die relevanten Hebel und priorisierst Maßnahmen nach ihrem erwarteten Impact.

  • Mit Marketing, Product, Revenue Management und BI arbeitest du eng zusammen und machst Daten und technische Möglichkeiten für CRM nutzbar. Dem Team, das Kampagnen und Content umsetzt, lieferst du Segmente, Journey-Konzepte und klare Briefings.

  • Du verantwortest Datenqualität und Governance deiner Segmente, Events und Systeme und stellst sicher, dass alles performant, sicher und datenschutzkonform läuft.

  • Du baust unser CRM komplett neu auf und übernimmst die Projektverantwortung für die Integration in unsere System- und Datenlandschaft, von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zum Go-live. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder vergleichbare Plattformen kennst du so gut, dass deine Konzepte direkt umsetzbar sind.


DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in CRM Analytics, Data Analytics, Lifecycle Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

  • Ausgeprägter Datenblick: Du arbeitest sicher mit Daten in Snowflake oder vergleichbaren Data Warehouses, baust komplexe Segmente und Kohorten und leitest daraus klare Maßnahmen ab.

  • Analytics first: Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind für dich Analytics. Du iterierst schnell über Hypothesen, A/B-Tests und Kohortenanalysen, statt lange an der perfekten Gestaltung zu feilen.

  • Du bist komplett KI-enabled: Tools wie Claude oder MCP nutzt du ganz selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder einer vergleichbaren CRM-Plattform: Du weißt, was technisch möglich ist, und konzipierst Segmente und Journeys entsprechend. Ein Plus ist Erfahrung mit Omnichannel-Journeys über App, Push, In-App und Mail.

  • Technisches Verständnis und Lust auf enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product: Du kennst die Abläufe zwischen CRM-Systemen, Plattformen und Datenquellen und achtest auf Performance, Sicherheit und Datenschutz.

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Einführung eines CRM-Systems: Du übernimmst Ownership, treibst die Integration als Projekt eigenverantwortlich voran und koordinierst die beteiligten Teams und Dienstleister.

  • Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch oder Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

Noch Fragen?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Office Foodji: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven!

  • Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

ÜBER UNS

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Corporate - Life Sciences
descriptionHtml:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

Location: London (In office presence required)

About the Team:

The Customer Success organisation is composed of four teams: pre-sales, customer success managers, account management and support. The CS org is dedicated to ensuring every client realises the full value of their investment in our platform, working as an integrated partner to help clients achieve meaningful outcomes and embed AlphaSense into their everyday decision-making.

By blending industry knowledge, product expertise, and a deep understanding of client priorities, the team helps organisations uncover new use cases, accelerate adoption, and sustain long-term growth. Their close engagement with clients also creates a powerful feedback loop—informing product innovation, shaping content strategy, and ensuring that the evolving needs of the corporate community are consistently reflected in how AlphaSense delivers value.

About the Role: 

As a Senior Customer Success Manager (Sr. CSM) at AlphaSense, you will be the strategic lead for our most complex and high-value accounts within the Corporate sector. You are responsible for navigating multi-million dollar global organizations and driving long-term ROI through technical group/individual training while ensuring company-wide adoption across multiple business units. You will manage a concentrated portfolio of strategic accounts, remaining at the forefront of product and Corporate vertical expertise, while scaling your impact across the organization through account strategy, leadership and innovation.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Strategic Account Influence: Navigate and influence multiple business units and key power users across the world largest and most complex global organizations. Create a groundswell of positive user sentiment to drive renewals and expansion with Senior Leadership.
  • Architect Deep Adoption & Value Realization: Synthesize complex usage into actionable insights. Design multi-quarter adoption roadmaps in tandem with your Account Management peers that align AlphaSense capabilities with business objectives.
  • Onboarding & Ongoing Training: As an expert on the product, you will guide new clients through onboarding, training, and best-practice adoption to ensure a strong foundation, both virtually and in person.
  • Technical & Domain Mastery: Independently lead sophisticated technical conversations regarding Managed Content Providers (MCP), APIs, and Large Language Models (LLMs) with technical stakeholders and platform owners.
  • Executive Presence & Communication: Command virtual and in-person rooms with executive presence, and leverage powerful, strategic follow-ups as a tool to drive adoption and link AlphaSense to specific Senior Leader business objectives.
  • Solo On-Site Leadership: Fully own high-stakes, multi-day on-site engagements and lead customer "Lunch & Learns,’’ tailoring presentations to diverse user groups and core personas using our WWH (Why, What, How) framework.
  • Company Innovation: engage in cross-functional initiatives outside the standard CSM scope, such as product feedback loops, hiring committees, mentorship programs and process innovation to improve team efficiency.

Who You Are:

  • 4 -6+ years of professional experience in Customer Success or Account Management, with a proven track record of managing a strategic portfolio. 
  • Ability to travel 20% of time. 
  • Experience working with clients in the Life Sciences industry, including Pharma, Biotech, Medical devices and diagnostics - additional bonus for familiarity with competitive intelligence, business development and clinical and commercial strategy workflows. 
  • Possess the technical acumen to navigate complex conversations around data integrations, APIs, and AI-driven market intelligence solutions.
  • Ability to identify the 5% of users who drive the majority of sentiment and influence within an account, focusing on high-level business outcomes over basic feature adoption.
  • Excellent communication skills with a demonstrable track record for collaborating internally in a cross-functional environment and onsite with customers. 
  • A natural leader who thrives in fast-paced environments and is committed to contributing to the "AlphaSense Playbook" through mentorship and internal innovation.

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
LiveRamp is shaping the future of responsible data collaboration between the world’s leading brands, retailers, financial services providers, and healthcare innovators. As consumers embrace new AI-driven experiences, the LiveRamp data collaboration network exponentially expands the breadth and accuracy of the data on which marketing AI capabilities operate, powering deeper customer insight and measurable performance on a global scale. LiveRamp is headquartered in San Francisco, California, with offices worldwide. Learn more at LiveRamp.com.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a commercially minded, relationship-driven Customer Success Manager to join our UK Brands team.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives on building relationships, understands the advertising and media landscape, and is passionate about helping clients succeed and grow.

You’ll take ownership of a portfolio of established brand and agency relationships, becoming a trusted strategic partner to some of the UK’s leading advertisers. Your role will go beyond traditional account management: you’ll proactively engage clients, uncover new business opportunities, expand relationships and drive long-term commercial growth.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys being out in the market, meeting clients face-to-face, understanding their businesses and identifying where LiveRamp can deliver even greater value.

You’ll combine commercial instinct with strategic thinking, working closely with our Sales, Product and Solutions teams to turn client needs into opportunities.

If you’re naturally curious, commercially ambitious and energised by building relationships, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

Build and Develop Strategic Client Relationships

  • Own and develop relationships across a portfolio of established brand and agency clients, acting as their primary commercial and strategic partner.

  • Proactively build meaningful, long-term relationships through regular face-to-face meetings, client visits, industry events and strategic business reviews.

  • Develop strong relationships at multiple levels within client organisations, from day-to-day stakeholders to senior decision-makers and budget holders.

  • Build a deep understanding of your clients’ businesses, commercial priorities, media strategies and challenges to identify where LiveRamp can add value.

  • Become a trusted adviser, bringing clients new ideas, industry insights and opportunities rather than simply responding to requests.

  • Build relationships across the wider advertising ecosystem, including media agencies, technology partners and data providers.

Drive Account Growth and Commercial Opportunities

  • Take commercial ownership of your portfolio, with a clear focus on customer retention, revenue growth and account expansion.

  • Proactively identify and develop upsell, cross-sell and new use-case opportunities within existing accounts.

  • Build and execute strategic account growth plans, identifying key stakeholders, commercial opportunities and opportunities to deepen client partnerships.

  • Spot opportunities through client conversations, market developments and an understanding of evolving advertising and data strategies.

  • Work closely with the Sales team to develop and convert expansion opportunities, ensuring a joined-up approach to growing existing relationships.

  • Lead commercial conversations, renewals and negotiations, protecting existing revenue while maximising long-term account potential.

  • Maintain clear visibility of account health, revenue forecasts, growth opportunities and commercial risks.

Deliver Exceptional Customer Success
