title: Senior Data Engineer, Training Data Platform
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

About the team

Join the AI team at Prosus, a global technology group with businesses in food delivery, ecommerce, classifieds, travel and payments. We build LCM, the Large Commerce Model: our own foundation model, trained on billions of transactions and interactions from proprietary data across the portfolio. LCM already powers search, recommendations and marketing in production at iFood. We are extending it across our companies around the world and to businesses outside the group, while broadening its capabilities in agents and real-time prediction tasks. Your work will shape what LCM learns next and feed directly into products used by millions of people.

About the role

We’re looking for a senior data engineer to build and operate LCM’s training-data platform, covering acquisition, processing, synthetic generation, quality evaluation and dataset versioning.

Our core data includes events, sessions, orders, catalogues and feedback, supplemented by external sources and generated examples. In our flat team of around 30 engineers, you’ll work with scientists and ML engineers to turn these sources into reproducible datasets and measure how changes to the data affect model performance. You’ll also build tools and agents that automate preparation, task design and quality analysis.

In the first three months, we expect you to take ownership of a part of the platform, such as a pipeline, the dataset versioning layer or the quality checks, deliver a reproducible dataset that a research project uses in a training run, and work with scientists to measure how your data changes affect model quality.

What the role involves

  • Build acquisition and processing pipelines for portfolio data and relevant public and licensed sources, including connectors and content extraction. Turn commerce records into ordered histories and link behaviour to outcomes without leaking future information.

  • Develop the shared platform for inspecting sources, configuring processing and publishing training datasets. Operate distributed workflows, monitor reliability and cost, and implement access controls and retention requirements.

  • Work with scientists, engineers and the relevant teams on data provenance, permitted use across companies and privacy-aware handling of customer histories.

  • Implement dataset versioning and lineage across source snapshots, processing code and dataset configurations, so releases can be reproduced and traced to the training runs that used them.

  • Build quality checks for completeness, freshness, duplication, extraction accuracy and coverage. Combine automated checks with sampled review to investigate problems that aggregate metrics can miss.

  • Provide tools for source tagging, sampling and weighting, and maintain evaluation datasets with temporal splits and overlap checks. Work with scientists on controlled comparisons to establish whether data changes improve model quality.

  • Build synthetic data pipelines supporting pre- and post-training, including instruction examples, preference data and agent trajectories. Implement generation, validation, scoring and filtering. Work with the research team to measure how the generated data affects model performance, and manage generation throughput and cost.

  • Build agents that turn catalogue sources into training datasets: propose tasks based on available data and target model capabilities, configure processing and generation, curate outputs and investigate quality failures. Keep agent actions traceable and validate proposed changes before dataset release.

Minimum qualifications

  • At least five years of relevant data engineering experience, including ownership of substantial production pipelines.

  • Strong Python and SQL, with experience writing tested, maintainable code.

  • Hands-on experience with distributed processing using Spark, Ray, Beam or a comparable framework.

  • Experience with cloud storage, workflow orchestration and operating pipelines through source changes, failures and backfills.

  • Practical knowledge of data quality, versioning and lineage, and the ability to translate evolving research requirements into reliable implementations.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with LLM datasets, commerce data, content extraction, synthetic data generation or agents for data tasks.

  • Experience with AWS, Databricks or EMR.

  • Strong distributed-data engineering experience is welcome without prior experience on an LLM team.

What we offer

  • Ownership of the platform supplying LCM’s training and evaluation data, with direct collaboration with researchers and ML engineers.

  • Access to proprietary commerce datasets, distributed processing infrastructure and models for generation and evaluation.

  • Scope to make technical decisions and build reusable tools across portfolio companies.

  • Colleagues who have released Hugging Face models with more than 100 million downloads, authored papers at NeurIPS, created benchmarks and built multiple production AI systems.

  • Current ML frameworks and unlimited access to coding assistants.

  • A base at our Amsterdam office and AI House, with relocation support. We also consider remote arrangements for candidates with particularly strong experience relevant to the role.

  • Competitive compensation and a top-spec MacBook Pro.

If you’ve built data systems at scale and want to help shape what a foundation model can do, we’d like to hear from you. Tell us about something you’ve built, the challenges involved and the difference it made.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Experimentation
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Deliveroo, your goal is to maximise business impact within one of our product areas. A core part of the role is designing, running and interpreting experiments, and using causal inference to guide product decisions in complex, real-world settings.

You will go beyond simply answering "did this feature work?" and instead focus on understanding what the true impact is, why it worked or did not work, and how results generalise across users, markets and time.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Driving Strategy/insights through Experimentation: Leading the design of both simple and complex experiments and proactively translating findings into strategic direction.

  • Master Causal Inference: Apply advanced techniques to estimate long-term and heterogeneous treatment effects.

  • Drawing reliable conclusions in settings with selection bias or imperfect randomisation.

  • Drive Deep Product Insights: Uncover the fundamental drivers of experiment performance, determining why features succeed and how results generalise across different users, markets, and timeframes.

  • Using insights from past experiments to improve future decision-making.

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • Strong experience designing, running and interpreting A/B experiments in production environments

  • Solid understanding of causal inference concepts

  • Ability to apply statistical thinking to messy, real-world product problems, not just ideal experimental setups

  • Great communication skills in person, in writing and in code, with both technical and non-technical audiences

  • A problem solver with a deep analytical mindset

  • Ability to think creatively and insightfully about business problems

Why Join Us?

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰 £138,000 - £175,000 + Equity + Benefits 

About the Role 

This role is for a Senior Engineering Manager where you’ll be a manager of managers. You will be leading across multiple teams in an org of around 20-30 people. We’re expanding and your role as the Senior EM will be to grow and build new squads as needed. Your direct reports will include Tech Leads, Senior Engineers and 2-3 Engineering Managers.

Senior Engineering Managers at Monzo are part of cross-functional, autonomous teams and groups. Our teams are mission driven, and typically include Product Managers, backend, web and mobile engineers as well as data scientists, designers and subject matter experts relevant to that mission. Teams are organised into groups, and then collectives - we aim to keep our line management structure as shallow as possible, and for teams to directly own decision making relevant to their work.

Senior Engineering Managers are accountable for the technical and delivery outcomes for their area - that means supporting and developing best in class engineering talent, as well as creating an inclusive team environment for people to do their best work. You’ll be responsible for structuring, organising, supporting and challenging your team to deliver on their mission.

You can read more on the expectations of Senior Engineering Managers in our Progression Framework.

Is this role right for you?

While this is not a role which requires hands-on-coding, we are looking for an experienced manager who has a strong technical and delivery background and has worked as a software engineer in previous roles.

We recognise that Senior Engineering Managers lead in different ways, we’re looking for someone who is adept at: 

  • Delivery and Execution: Enjoys taking accountability for delivery across your squad(s), collaborating with the Technical Lead and Product Manager.
  • Engineering and Operational Excellence: Actively fosters a high bar for engineering excellence within your teams. You’re accountable for the technical outcomes your teams deliver alongside individual engineer performance and growth, so holding a high bar (and clearly articulating your expectations) is key.
  • People Leadership: Has experience directly managing at least 2-3 Engineering Managers and leading orgs of around ~20 engineers. You can support, coach and develop them through their career with regular 1:1s and continuous feedback.
  • Technical Influence: Partners with senior engineers to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices.
  • Stakeholder Relationships: Builds strong stakeholder relationships with other teams, and creates a focus space for engineers to do their best work.
  • Organisational Wide Impact: Collaborates with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards.

We consider your application across all open EM roles at Monzo independent of which role you've applied for, so if you've recently applied to a similar role at Monzo and have been unsuccessful, please wait 6 months before applying again.

How we work 💻:

Locations & Flexible Working : 

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. 

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. 

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

The interview process:

After an initial informal recruiter call you go through two main stages

  1. Initial Call (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our Senior Engineering Managers or Engineering Directors. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)

  2. Loop Stage (3 hours 30 mins) The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability) and one 30 minute reverse interview (more details below).

The Loop is one stage and the interviews in this stage are:

- Team and Org Management (1 hour)An example based interview with 1-2 of our engineering leaders. They’re interested to hear examples from your previous experience on the teams you’ve led, how you’ve shaped and partnered with product, and the impact you had.

- System Design (1 hour)You'll partner with a Staff or Principal Engineer on a technical whiteboarding exercise.

- Behavioural (1 hour)Similar to Team and Org Management, this is an example based interview with 1-2 Engineering Leaders. This interview focuses on your people leadership style and core behaviours as an Engineering Manager.

- Chat with an Engineering Leader (30 mins)At Monzo, we believe interviews are a two-way street. This will be your opportunity to ask us any questions about Monzo, engineering leadership or our teams – whatever’s on your mind. 

All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. 

What’s in it for you:

💰 £138,000 - £175,000 + Equity + Benefits 

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK  

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here

#LI-Remote #LI-AL1

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

title: Senior Enterprise Account Manager - Nordics
descriptionHtml:
monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition.

Role summary

We're looking for an Senior Enterprise Account Manager to join our expanding team in London focussing on some of the largest accounts across the Nordics region. There are a few things we take really seriously here at monday.com: building an amazing product and providing the best possible service to our customers. Our clients love what we've built and this role puts you at the centre of it, working with some of the world's most recognisable brands as they reimagine how work gets done.

 

As a Senior Enterprise Account Manager, you'll work with a book of global enterprise accounts — household names operating across multiple markets — to deepen their investment in monday.com and expand it. These are organisations at the forefront of enterprise AI transformation, moving fast to rewire their workflows, integrate intelligent agents into how they operate, and get ahead of competitors who aren't moving as quickly. Your job is to be the strategic partner that helps them do exactly that.

This is a quota-carrying role that requires strong executive-level sales skills, relationship-building capabilities, and a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences.

 

Please note this is a hybrid role with a 3 day per week in the office requirement.

 

About the role;

  • The Account Manager position is a growth focused quota-carrying position; you will own the full sales cycle from generating opportunities, building strategic relationships with key stakeholders to negotiation, contracting and eventual renewal.

  • Research, identify, and engage opportunities within a territory of Enterprise accounts with existing spend. Proactively prospect into your accounts (cold calls, emails, social selling, networking, etc.) to build a robust pipeline.

  • Use the value framework and MEDDPICC to enact robust deal progression processes in collaboration with management to advance and close opportunities with new, complex use cases.

  • Strategically build relationships within accounts to build qualified champions. Gaining access to C-Level and VP economic buyers to ensure monday.com becomes a strategic partner of our Enterprise customers, aligned to corporate level goals.

  • Possess a comprehensive understanding of monday.com’s solution and connect this knowledge directly to customer ROI at the enterprise level.

  • Work closely with the Customer Success team and other internal stakeholders to create the conditions for account growth. This means setting the strategic direction, aligning internal resources, and ensuring monday.com shows up as one coordinated partner to our most demanding customers.

  • Continuously build and refine in-depth knowledge of the target industry, including trends, challenges, key players, and opportunities, to effectively position our solutions and add value to C-Level client conversations.

Requirements:

  • Experience: 5+ years of sales experience in a closing role at a SaaS or technology-related field, with a focus on larger Enterprise accounts with a global footprint.

  • Proven Success: Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and driving revenue growth with large, complex organizations. Experience of the Nordics region is preferred.

  • Sales Skills: Strong ability to prospect, qualify, and close deals with large, complex businesses. Experience with a consultative, value-based sales approach at the executive level.

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication and negotiation skills with the ability to articulate complex concepts in a clear and relatable manner to senior stakeholders.

  • Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with technology, with the ability to quickly learn and demonstrate the functionality of software products, particularly in the context of enterprise solutions.

  • Disruptive technology: Experience selling genuinely new, category-defining technology. Comfortable helping customers navigate the shift from legacy ways of working to something meaningfully better.

  • CRM Proficiency: Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot for managing sales activities and pipeline.

  • Internal leadership: Proven ability to lead without direct authority, rallying Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, Legal, and Executive sponsors around a shared account strategy. You're the person internal teams look to for direction on the accounts you own.

  • Problem Solver: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify complex business challenges and develop tailored, enterprise-level solutions.

  • Customer-Centric: Passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences and adding strategic value to key client relationships.

  • Self-Starter: A proactive attitude with the ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage time effectively.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (AI Agent) - Germany
descriptionHtml:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. 

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the role:

At Cresta, the AI Agent team is on a mission to create state-of-the-art AI Agents that solve practical problems for our customers. We are focused on leveraging the latest technologies in Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI Agent systems, while ensuring that the solutions we develop are cost-effective, secure, and reliable. 

As an AI Agent Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of deploying AI agents that address real-world challenges. In this role, you will work closely with customers as well as our software and machine learning engineers, ensuring high-impact AI Agent deployments and contributing to the continuous improvement of our core AI platform. You’ll develop intelligent AI agents, integrate them seamlessly with external systems and offer hands-on technical expertise to ensure successful deployments.. This position requires strong engineering skills, adaptability, and customer engagement. If you are self-driven, analytical, and eager to leverage AI in practical applications, this role is for you.

What You'll Do :

  • AI Agent Development: Develop, configure, deploy, and optimize AI agents using Cresta’s AI platform and tools.
  • System Integration: Build AI agent integrations with external systems (APIs, databases, CRMs, etc.) to ensure seamless workflow integration.
  • Performance Optimization: Optimize AI agent performance (e.g. fine-tune prompts and configurations) and troubleshoot issues in complex enterprise environments.
  • Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to gather technical requirements and translate business needs into AI Agent solutions.
  • Demos & Iteration: Conduct interactive demos and present compelling proof-of-concepts to prospective customers, proactively gather feedback, and iteratively refine solutions to meet objectives.
  • Project Coordination: Define project milestones, create implementation plans, and coordinate execution with internal teams to ensure on-time delivery. Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams — identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through real-world deployment learnings.
  • Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate with PMs to define agent goals, iterate rapidly based on customer feedback, and shape product capabilities that maximize customer ROI.
  • Technical Guidance: Serve as a trusted technical advisor for the customer, guiding best practices for AI agent adoption and usage. Provide technical guidance on AI agent best practices, including architecture design, security considerations, and scalability planning.

What We're Looking For:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience of full time working experience in software development/ consulting, AI/ML engineering, or system integration, or as FDE
  • Programming Skills: Proficiency in Python and Golang, with the ability to write clean, efficient code.
  • AI/ML Knowledge: Familiarity with AI/ML concepts. Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering techniques are strongly preferred.
  • AI Agent Frameworks: Strong understanding of general AI agent frameworks, function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Hands-on experience of building such a system is strongly preferred.
  • Cloud & DevOps: Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and DevOps practices (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring).
  • Integration Expertise: Hands-on experience with integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and project management skills.
  • Analytical Approach: Ability to use data-driven decision-making, including A/B testing and performance monitoring, to refine solutions.
  • Collaborative Builder: You thrive in cross-functional environments, working hand-in-hand with PMs and engineers to turn real customer problems into scalable AI solutions.

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

This posting will be used to fill a newly-created role.

Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.

Recruiting impersonation scams: We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the ----- domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.

Das erwartet dich bei uns:

  • Du arbeitest in Beratungs- und Softwareentwicklungsprojekten bei Kunden wie AXA, BMW, ZDF und der Deutschen Bahn

  • Du konzipierst, entwickelst und implementierst Softwarelösungen, in dem du AI-Methoden und Tools im gesamten Softwareentwicklungsprozess anwendest (z.B. LLMs, agentische Frameworks, Codegenerierung und Testautomatisierung)

title: Senior Fullstack Developer .NET
descriptionHtml:
Bij OrtaX, onderdeel van Centric, werk je aan software die gemeenten ondersteunt bij het efficiënt, betrouwbaar en transparant uitvoeren van het WOZ-proces. Onze ambitie gaat verder dan het onderhouden van bestaande software. We ontwikkelen OrtaX continu door en investeren daarbij in nieuwe technologie, data, automatisering en een toekomstbestendige architectuur.

Als Senior Fullstack Developer speel je daarin een belangrijke rol. Je beweegt je vanzelfsprekend tussen frontend en backend, bouwt zelf mee aan nieuwe functionaliteit en helpt tegelijkertijd onze applicatie stap voor stap te moderniseren.

Daarbij kijken we nadrukkelijk naar jou om technische richting en structuur te helpen aanbrengen. Niet door keuzes alleen te maken, maar juist door technische vraagstukken scherp te krijgen, verschillende perspectieven bij elkaar te brengen en samen met het team tot goede, gedragen oplossingen te komen.

1. Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Fullstack Developer werk je samen met developers, analisten en andere specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van OrtaX. Je bent daarbij niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor je eigen code, maar kijkt ook naar de samenhang en kwaliteit van de oplossing als geheel.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • ontwikkelen van nieuwe backendfunctionaliteit in C#/.NET;

  • ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van frontendfunctionaliteit met één van de grote frontend frameworks

  • ontwerpen en verbeteren van API's, integraties en dataoplossingen;

  • maken van technische ontwerpen die frontend, backend en data met elkaar verbinden;

  • schrijven en stimuleren van onderhoudbare, testbare en kwalitatief goede code;

  • bijdragen aan CI/CD, automated testing en DevOps;

  • analyseren van complexe technische vraagstukken en deze vertalen naar pragmatische oplossingen;

  • aanbrengen van technische structuur en bewaken van samenhang tussen verschillende onderdelen van de applicatie;

  • richting geven aan architectuur- en ontwerpkeuzes en inzichtelijk maken van de consequenties van verschillende opties;

  • begeleiden van technische discussies en ervoor zorgen dat kennis en ideeën van andere teamleden worden meegenomen;

  • ondersteunen van collega-developers bij complexe technische vraagstukken;

  • herkennen en bespreekbaar maken van technische schuld, risico's en mogelijkheden voor verbetering;

  • stap voor stap moderniseren van bestaande onderdelen van OrtaX.

Je werkt aan een volwassen product waarin continu de afweging wordt gemaakt tussen vandaag waarde leveren en bouwen aan de architectuur van morgen.

Als senior developer help je het team om die afweging bewust te maken. Soms betekent dat investeren in een structurele technische verbetering, soms juist kiezen voor een pragmatische oplossing die past bij de situatie.

2. De technische uitdaging

OrtaX heeft een bestaand softwarelandschap én een duidelijke moderniseringsopgave. Daardoor werk je niet alleen aan de vraag: “Hoe bouwen we deze feature?” maar juist ook aan vragen als:

“Hoe past deze oplossing in de rest van onze architectuur?” “Welke keuze helpt ons niet alleen vandaag, maar ook over een paar jaar?” “Hoe voorkomen we dat verschillende onderdelen van de applicatie ieder hun eigen richting opgaan?” En misschien nog belangrijker: “Hoe komen we als team tot een technische keuze waar verschillende inzichten goed in zijn meegenomen?”

Als Senior Fullstack Developer neem je hierin het voortouw. Je kunt een technisch vraagstuk structureren, alternatieven onderzoeken en een richting voorstellen. Tegelijkertijd begrijp je dat de beste technische oplossing zelden door één persoon wordt bedacht. Je zoekt actief de discussie met andere developers, luistert naar argumenten en gebruikt de expertise binnen het team om de uiteindelijke oplossing beter te maken.

Bij OrtaX gebruiken we AI als een belangrijk hulpmiddel bij het ontwikkelproces. Daarbij geloven wij ook dat de developer verantwoordelijk is dat we goede code en een duidelijke architectuur opleveren. Ook op lange termijn willen we beschikken over een goed onderhoudbaar product. Daarbij is AI inmiddels een essentieel hulpmiddel, maar niet zonder input van de developer.

Technisch leiderschap betekent bij ons dus niet bepalen wat anderen moeten bouwen, maar richting geven, structuur aanbrengen en het team helpen betere technische keuzes te maken.

3. Wie zoeken we?

We zoeken een ervaren developer die zich daadwerkelijk thuis voelt aan beide kanten van de stack.

Voor deze seniorrol zoeken we dus niet naar een backenddeveloper die af en toe frontendwerk doet, of andersom. Je hoeft niet overal dezelfde diepgang te hebben, maar je bent in staat om zelfstandig aan zowel frontend als backend te werken en kunt technische vraagstukken over de volledige keten overzien. Je:

  • hebt een hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau op het gebied van Software Engineering, Informatica, Computer Science of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • hebt ruime professionele ervaring met C# en .NET;

  • hebt ruime ervaring met moderne frontendontwikkeling en kunt zelfstandig werken met één van de grote frontend frameworks

  • hebt ervaring met het ontwerpen en bouwen van API's en integraties;

  • hebt gedegen kennis van databases en begrijpt hoe keuzes in de datalaag doorwerken naar backend en frontend;

  • kunt technische oplossingen ontwerpen over meerdere lagen van een applicatie;

  • hebt een goed begrip van softwarearchitectuur en kunt architectuurprincipes toepassen zonder de pragmatiek uit het oog te verliezen;

  • hebt oog voor aspecten als onderhoudbaarheid, testbaarheid, performance, security en technische schuld;

  • bent gewend te werken met CI/CD, automated testing en een Agile/Scrum-werkwijze;

  • kunt complexe technische vraagstukken structureren en terugbrengen tot heldere keuzes;

  • durft besluiten te nemen wanneer dat nodig is en kunt duidelijk uitleggen waarom een bepaalde richting wordt gekozen;

  • staat tegelijkertijd open voor andere inzichten en bent bereid je eigen oplossing ter discussie te stellen;

  • helpt minder ervaren developers groeien door kennis te delen, feedback te geven en samen naar oplossingen te zoeken;

  • communiceert gemakkelijk met developers, analisten en andere collega's.

Wat maakt jou senior?

Voor ons zit senioriteit niet alleen in het aantal jaren ervaring of hoeveel technologieën je beheerst.

We zoeken iemand die over de grenzen van een individuele feature heen kijkt.

Je ziet patronen en afhankelijkheden, herkent wanneer een technische keuze gevolgen heeft voor andere onderdelen van het systeem en brengt structuur aan wanneer een vraagstuk complex wordt.

Je bent bovendien iemand naar wie collega's toe kunnen stappen wanneer een technisch vraagstuk vastloopt. Niet omdat je altijd direct het antwoord hebt, maar omdat je kunt helpen om het probleem scherp te krijgen en gezamenlijk tot een goede oplossing te komen.

Daarbij kun je leiden zonder alles zelf te willen bepalen. Je geeft richting wanneer dat nodig is, maar creëert ook ruimte voor discussie, andere ideeën en de expertise van je collega's.

4. Waarom OrtaX?

OrtaX ondersteunt gemeenten en samenwerkingsverbanden bij het WOZ-proces en richt zich op consistente, uitlegbare waarderingen en slimme automatisering. Daarbij investeren we in technologieën zoals data-analyse, AI, automatisering en integratie. Je werkt daardoor aan software waarvan de maatschappelijke toepassing heel concreet is. Tegelijkertijd kom je in een omgeving waarin technisch nog veel te ontwikkelen en te moderniseren valt.

Voor een Senior Fullstack Developer betekent dat dat je niet alleen aansluit bij een bestaande technische omgeving, maar daadwerkelijk invloed kunt hebben op hoe OrtaX zich technisch verder ontwikkelt. Je krijgt de ruimte om structuur aan te brengen, technische keuzes te helpen maken en verbeteringen in gang te zetten. Tegelijkertijd blijf je zelf dicht bij de techniek en bouw je mee aan de oplossingen die daaruit voortkomen.

Je krijgt daarmee de combinatie van een volwassen product, een stevige technische moderniseringsopgave en de mogelijkheid om samen met het team de technische koers verder vorm te geven.

5. Wat bieden we jou?

Het salaris ligt tussen € 5600,- en € 7200,- per maand (daarnaast ontvang je een variabele beloning, vaste 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld), afhankelijk van je rol, competentieprofiel en ervaring.  

Verder bieden we je uitstekende voorwaarden, waaronder: 

  • deelname aan een goede pensioenregeling 

  • 27 vakantiedagen (gebaseerd op een fulltime contract) 

  • mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen 

  • Hybride werken vanuit huis en het kantoor in Amsterdam (uiteraard ben je welkom om elke dag op kantoor te werken) 

  • reiskostenvergoeding voor je dagelijkse woon-werkverkeer en evt. zakelijke reizen 

  • mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen met een trainingsprogramma en wekelijkse onderzoeks- en kennisbijeenkomsten 

  • je start met een jaarcontract, daarna is er uitzicht op een vast contract, omdat we streven naar een langdurige samenwerking 

  • een prettige werkomgeving met enthousiaste en leuke collega's! 

6. Over OrtaX

OrtaX ondersteunt gemeenten en samenwerkingsverbanden bij het efficiënt, betrouwbaar en transparant uitvoeren van het WOZ-proces. De ambitie is om taxateurs te ondersteunen met slimme automatisering en tegelijkertijd te investeren in nieuwe technologie, procesautomatisering en integratie.

Daarbij werken we niet alleen aan wat OrtaX vandaag nodig heeft, maar ook aan hoe het product er technisch morgen uit moet zien.

Wil jij als Senior Fullstack Developer niet alleen aan OrtaX bouwen, maar ook helpen bepalen hóé we verder bouwen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

title: Senior Global Operations Associate
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Please submit your CV in English!

The opportunity:

The role of the Operations Associate is a critical part of making Flexport’s mission to make global trade easy for everyone a reality. Flexport today connects almost 10,000 clients and suppliers across 109 countries. In this role, your direct customers are the partners within your region: our account management and customs teams, subcontractors, carriers, terminals and trucking providers. Your work directly supports Flexport’s end customers in achieving their logistics goals. Most importantly, you will play a pivotal role in building the next operational model at Flexport: allowing us to effectively scale to achieve our mission of making global trade easier for everyone.

This role is designed to facilitate the movement of shipments while discovering and driving efficiencies that build and improve operations as part of our Global team. You will be responsible for ensuring that all customer shipments are executed according to plan, on time and within budget. As the person who manages movement in your region with laser focus, you have the unique opportunity to help your regional account team spot opportunities to improve and grow our customers’ business. You will drive impact through surfacing new ideas to eliminate waste, improve customer experience or introducing innovative ways of managing a supply chain.

Responsibilities:

  • Be the “front line” in ensuring the highest standard of Flexport quality: shipments move on-time and exceptions are handled appropriately
  • Be responsible for ensuring your work satisfies internal KPIs and SLAs that demonstrate quality delivery
  • Follow standard operating procedures (SOP)
  • Solve client issues quickly and ensure smooth operations at origin and destination and escalate issues as needed
  • Acting in the best interest of the company by avoiding leakages and ensuring cost conscious behavior 
  • Seamlessly coordinate day-to-day logistics operations with internal and external partners such as steamship lines, air carriers, intermodal and drayage vendors, customs, trade lane management, warehousing, transloading, trucking, and the air operations team
  • Execute the end-to-end movement of freight shipments within a regional network (both imports and exports), including intermodal movements
  • Assist the shipments managed by partners as we drive partner autonomy (if applicable in a given region)

Prerequisites:

  • BA/BS Degree or completed professional training as forwarding agent
  • 3+ years of experience in freight forwarding, and direct Air export experience
  • Fluent in French and English (other European languages are a plus)
  • Able to adapt to new technology and can thrive in a fast paced environment
  • Effective time management, be able to properly prioritize and manage a large volume of tasks
  • Attention to detail
  • Ability to effectively seek and receive feedback
  • Effective communication both verbally and in writing
  • Teamwork and relationship building
  • Orientation towards working smarter and adopting best practices and standardization
  • Problem-solving capabilities
  • A “compliance first” attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry

What else: 

  • You will work in a beautiful office in the city center of Paris with modern office equipment and a first class connection to the public transport system of Paris.
  • You will work in a fast growing and changing environment with a high motivated team, which is always open to hear your ideas
  • We invest in your personal and professional development by offering you internal and external trainings
  • During regular team events you can have a lot of fun with your teammates and connect with them aside from your working day

What we offer: 

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment 
  • 25 working days working days of paid annual leave per complete year of service
  • The employee shall be affiliated to the French social security system (Sécurité sociale) and the mandatory supplementary pension schemes (retraite complémentaire AGIRC-ARRCO) in accordance with applicable law. Employer and employee contributions shall be calculated and deducted in accordance with statutory rates.
  • 50% reimbursement of the cost of the public transportation subscription(s) used for travel between your place of residence and the workplace. 
  • Employer's collective supplementary health insurance scheme (mutuelle d'entreprise) as required by law. Flexport shall contribute at least 50% of the premium for the base coverage.
  • Lunches compensation: EUR 12 for every day worked in the office
  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child. 
  • Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.

Disguise is the industry-leading platform sitting at the heart of a new era of visual experiences. One powerful integrated system of software, hardware and services to help create the next dimension of real-time spectacle.

title: Senior IT Project Manager - Operations (all genders)
descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Java Engineer - Core/Infra - Elasticsearch
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is the Role

We are on the lookout for a Senior Java Engineer to join our Elasticsearch team and focus on ensuring that the shared platform functionalities of Elasticsearch are easy to use, performant, maintainable and secure.

The team’s mission is to create foundational infrastructure and shared functionality that enables engineers to develop, extend, and support Elasticsearch. The team owns common functionality such as services, settings and scripting, and makes Elasticsearch extensible through plugins or the Painless scripting language. The team also makes Elasticsearch observable by providing logging and telemetry information. We also own the orchestration of Elasticsearch in serverless, the CI/CD workflows and enable Elasticsearch developers to deliver Elasticsearch to customers - serverless, cloud and on-premise alike.

You will be a strong individual contributor on the team but you will also contribute to and lead cross team projects. We need someone who has great design skills, who can work at a low level of abstraction but can equally drive and communicate technical concepts across a variety of collaborators.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Contributing to large, impactful projects that evolve the core infrastructure that underpins Elasticsearch.
  • Making Elasticsearch developers more productive by identifying and developing opportunities for automation, and integrating agentic apps into development workflows.
  • Designing and implementing new horizontally-scalable features and APIs in Elasticsearch.
  • Solving difficult issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
  • Improving operation and observability of Elasticsearch cloud systems.
  • Collaborating in the open with the ES team, Elastic users, and other supporting open source projects.
  • Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
  • Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.

What You Bring 

  • Experience crafting APIs and the ability to reason through tradeoffs.
  • Proficiency in algorithms and data structures.
  • Strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
  • Experience with low-level Java such as concurrency, parallelism, classloaders, etc.
  • Knowledge of JDK internals: modules, the Java memory model, garbage collection, database load, caching techniques, etc.
  • Experience leading large scale projects across engineering teams.
  • Willingness to dive into new issues and ask for help when you need it.
  • You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working in a platform team or developer productivity team
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD systems and practices (Buildkite, Argo CD, GitOps etc).
  • Knowledge of Java build tools (Gradle, Maven, etc), with a strong preference for Gradle experience.
  • Experience with observability and telemetry solutions, particularly OpenTelemetry
  • Knowledge of Go
  • Knowledge of containers and Kubernetes

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. title: Senior Linux Application Engineer (all genders) – Python & IoT Edge
descriptionHtml:
Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock.

As Senior Linux Application Engineer (all genders) in our IoT team, you build the software foundation for all our Linux-based devices, on ARM and x86. At its core is a platform layer that unifies shared components such as health monitoring and logging. Every device type then works the same way, and product features build on one solid base.

The role combines architecture and hands-on engineering: clean, object-oriented software, plus ownership of how it is built, deployed, updated and monitored across the fleet. Your code sits close to the hardware but runs on top of Linux.

Kernel development and microcontroller firmware are not part of the job. If well-designed software for Linux devices is your thing, you’ll feel at home here.

As we are looking for a hands-on developer, a live coding session is an integral part of our interview process.

What to expect

  • Unified platform layer: Design and build a platform layer that covers all our device types, both ARM and x86. It provides shared components such as health monitoring, logging, configuration, OTA updates and hardware abstraction.

  • Software architecture: Define clear interfaces between the platform and the applications on top of it. Consolidate the codebase so that new device types and components plug in easily.

  • Application development: Build Python services on top of the platform, inside our dockerized main application.

  • Device integration: Connect peripherals such as modems, watchdogs, cameras and AI accelerators through existing drivers, SDKs and Linux interfaces, behind a clean hardware abstraction.

  • Reliability and observability: Make our fleet secure, resilient and transparent through OTA updates, networking, inter-process communication and fleet-wide monitoring of device health.

  • Debugging: Analyze and solve complex issues at application and system level, such as memory leaks, network instability or service failures.

  • Ownership and mentoring: Take end-to-end responsibility, guide other engineers technically, and raise our engineering standards.

Inspire us by

  • Senior software engineering experience: 5+ years of professional software development, with a strong part of it on Linux-based devices or edge systems.

  • Strong OOP skills: Deep experience with object-oriented design in (preferably) Python. Experience in another OOP language such as C++, Java or Rust is a plus.

  • Architecture know-how: You have designed and evolved software architectures, applied design patterns, and made trade-off decisions you can explain clearly. Ideally you have built a platform, framework or shared library that other teams or services build on.

  • IoT background: Hands-on experience building software for connected devices, ideally operated as a fleet in the field.

  • Linux user-space expertise: Solid knowledge of Linux, systemd, networking, IPC, Bash and Docker, ideally across different hardware architectures (ARM and x86).

  • Debugging skills: Experience troubleshooting system-level issues with tools such as GDB, tcpdump, Valgrind or profilers.

  • Engineering mindset: Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Language skills: Fluent English (C1).

Strong plus

  • Soft Skills: Entrepreneurial drive, solution-oriented mindset, high agency and the ability to take direct responsibility in a fast-paced startup environment.

Benefits

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. Degree: In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program

Native-level or near-native German language skills (written and spoken), with the ability to confidently engage German-speaking customers, facilitate workshops, and present to executive stakeholders.

title: Senior Manager, AI & Trading Transformation
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

What you will be doing

As a Senior Manager in our Commodities & Energy Trading practice, you will help clients navigate changing commodity markets by combining trading expertise with the practical application of data, analytics and AI.

You will play a key role in shaping and delivering our commodity and energy trading proposition: leading client engagements, developing new opportunities and showing clients where AI and advanced analytics can create genuine commercial value.

You are likely to bring deep expertise in either commodities and energy trading or data, analytics and AI, together with some understanding or practical exposure to the other. You will work alongside specialists from both disciplines, building on your core expertise while continuing to deepen your capabilities across the intersection of trading and AI. The aim is to turn emerging AI capabilities into practical, measurable improvements in how trading businesses operate.

AI & Trading Transformation

  • Shape propositions at the intersection of commodity trading, AI and digital transformation, and bring market insight on how AI is changing trading organisations, business models and competitive dynamics
  • Translate real trading problems into practical GenAI and agentic use cases that deliver value to clients
  • Advise clients on where AI should augment human decision-making, where workflows can be automated, and where human judgement remains critical
  • Design trading journeys from opportunity identification and experimentation through to scaled adoption, with the metrics and value cases that show impact on performance, productivity, risk and profitability
  • Work with traders, portfolio managers, data scientists and technology teams to turn concepts into solutions that operate in live trading environments
  • Drive adoption of GenAI copilots, agents and intelligent workflows that improve trader productivity and decision quality
  • Establish governance, model risk, human oversight and responsible-use approaches without losing sight of commercial outcomes

Commodities & Energy Trading

  • Advise on front-to-back trading processes, from market intelligence and trade origination through execution, scheduling, settlement and risk management across commodities including Power, Oil & Refined Products, Natural Gas, LNG, Metals, Renewables and Environmental Products
  • Support clients in evolving their trading strategies, operating models and capabilities in response to changing markets and new technologies
  • Bring an understanding of market structure, pricing, forecasting, physical flows and the commercial decisions that drive trading performance

Your skills and experience 
 

We are looking for an experienced professional with 8-12+ years of relevant experience and a strong background in either commodities and energy trading or data, analytics and AI. The strongest candidates will combine meaningful experience across both areas. However, we also welcome applicants who bring deep expertise in one discipline alongside a working understanding of, or some practical exposure to, the other.

You might be a commodities and trading specialist who has applied data, analytics or AI to trading decisions, processes or transformation, or a data and AI practitioner who has worked in, or gained exposure to, commodities, energy or another trading environment.

You do not need equal depth in both disciplines, but you should be able to demonstrate a genuine foundation in each and a clear motivation to deepen your experience at their intersection.

What we look for in everyone

  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to engage credibly with senior trading and executive stakeholders
  • The ability to distinguish genuinely valuable AI opportunities from technology-led experimentation
  • Experience contributing to or leading complex transformation, strategy or operating-model engagements
  • Strong leadership, communication and team-development skills
  • Deep expertise in either commodities and energy trading or data, analytics and AI, together with a working understanding of, or some practical exposure to, the other discipline and the commitment to continue building depth across both

If your primary background is in commodities and trading, you will ideally bring

  • Deep expertise in at least one commodity, such as Power, Gas, LNG, Oil, Metals or Environmental Products
  • A strong understanding of trading, portfolio management, risk, physical flows, scheduling, optimisation and/or commercial operations
  • Familiarity with ETRM/CTRM platforms and the wider trading technology and data ecosystems
  • Some experience of using, sponsoring or shaping data, analytics, automation or AI initiatives within a trading or commercial environment, together with an understanding of how these capabilities can improve trading decisions, processes and outcomes

If your primary background is in data, analytics and AI, you will ideally bring

  • Practical experience identifying, shaping or delivering AI, GenAI, machine learning or intelligent automation use cases
  • An understanding of the opportunities and limitations of GenAI, LLMs, AI agents and decision-support tools, and how they apply in a trading environment
  • Some experience of commodities, energy, financial markets or trading environments, with an understanding of how trading organisations make decisions, manage risk and generate value, together with a strong interest in deepening your knowledge of commodity markets and front-to-back trading processes 

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

Baringa Privacy Notices

For UK & EU

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our UK Recruitment Privacy Notice / EU Recruitment Privacy Notice, to evaluate your application and meet our legal and reporting obligations. In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, rectification, or erasure (subject to legal limitations) of your personal data. title: Senior Manager, Customer Support, Deliveroo Operations
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders to bring the neighbourhood to their door. We're redefining convenience by giving customers the ability to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

Deliveroo is a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the world's most dynamic industries. We are a relatively small team making a very large impact, moving fast, valuing ownership, and tackling some of the most interesting challenges in global commerce. We're driven by innovation, autonomy, and the ambition to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers, partners, and riders alike.

What You'll Be Doing

You will own frontline operational performance across two closely linked parts of Deliveroo's customer support network: an in-house Global Escalations team of around 50 agents based across the UK and Georgia, and the outsourced network delivering support on our behalf through three BPO partners and three Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents across multiple locations, including the team leads and ops managers embedded within those outsourced functions.

Global Escalations sits at the heart of Deliveroo's most critical customer moments. The team manages our most sensitive, high-risk, and high-impact contacts, including complaints escalated to the Executive team. As the leader directly accountable for this recovery-focused centre of excellence, you will ensure the team operates with exceptional skill, judgement, and empathy, protecting Deliveroo's reputation, driving improvement through root cause analysis, and embedding a culture of integrity and customer-first recovery across the organisation.

For the outsourced network, you own how performance is delivered day to day, working closely with the team leads and ops managers embedded in each BPO and Shared Service Centre, not just the vendor relationship at arm's length. You own the operational rigour needed to make the network the best in class, from an experience and consistency perspective, across every market it supports.

Your key objective is to drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, measured through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like average handling time (AHT) and refund costs, rather than trading one off against the other. You will be the voice of Support to Deliveroo's market General Managers, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets, and you will partner closely with cross-functional Support & Operations teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that positively impact all three sides of the marketplace: customers, riders, and merchants.

You Will…

  • Own frontline operational performance delivered through the in-house Global Escalations team (UK and Georgia) and the outsourced network (3 BPOs, 3 Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents), including the team leads and ops managers within those outsourced functions
  • Lead and develop the Global Escalations team directly, managing our most sensitive and reputation-critical contacts with judgement, empathy, and rigorous root cause analysis
  • Drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, tracked through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like AHT and refund costs
  • Act as the voice of Support to Deliveroo market GMs, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets and representing their priorities back into the function
  • Partner with Support & Operations cross-functional teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that improve the experience for customers, riders, and merchants
  • Design and run performance frameworks that hold BPO and SSC team leads and ops managers accountable for quality, SLA adherence, and CSAT, fostering a culture of partnership rather than pure oversight
  • Standardise processes and playbooks across outsourced partners and sites where it drives consistency, while respecting genuine market and site-specific differences
  • Diagnose and help bring down attrition and quality issues across the outsourced network, working with BPO and SSC leadership on the retention, engagement, and workforce planning changes needed
  • Partner with Product and Technology to shape the roadmap for customer support systems and channel strategy, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency and automation across both in-house and outsourced teams
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across HR, Legal, and Policy to ensure service delivery evolves in line with business priorities
  • Drive data-informed improvement through analysis of contact drivers, escalation themes, and customer sentiment, translating insight into action for both Global Escalations and the outsourced network
  • Represent the function at relevant Weekly Business Reviews and senior forums, providing visibility on performance, risk, and recovery across both the in-house team and the outsourced network
  • Participate in the 24/7 Leadership Team on-call rota
  • Shape functional strategy and set OKRs for contact centre Support across Deliveroo markets, growing the remit from directing your own team to leading leaders, in line with DoorDash's Team Management career framework
  • Grow and develop the managers and leaders within your network, including Team Leads inside Global Escalations and the team leads and ops managers at each BPO and Shared Service Centre, building the next generation of people leaders

Our humble expectations

  • Extensive contact centre, BPO, or shared service centre leadership experience in a fast-paced, consumer-facing environment
  • Proven experience managing outsourced or vendor relationships at scale, including the team lead and ops manager layer embedded within partner organisations, not just the commercial relationship
  • Experience leading escalations or complaint handling in a reputation-sensitive environment, with strong judgement and the ability to drive recovery from the most sensitive customer moments
  • A track record of bringing consistency and governance across multiple outsourced partners while respecting genuine local and market differences
  • Experience diagnosing and reducing attrition while improving quality, in a large-scale, multi-site support operation
  • A data-driven approach to balancing customer experience (CSAT) against cost metrics such as AHT and refund rate, without trading one off blindly against the other
  • Experience representing a support or operations function to senior commercial stakeholders, such as General Managers or market leadership, taking full accountability for their experience of the function
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy to drive improvements across a multi-sided marketplace
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work cross-functionally with Product, Legal, Policy, and People teams
  • Strong analytical ability, comfortable turning contact driver, escalation, and sentiment data into action
  • Strong people leadership skills, with experience building and developing a dispersed in-house team and driving performance indirectly through partner leadership
  • A self-starter mindset, a can-do attitude, and willingness to be hands-on in a fast-moving, multi-geography environment
  • Proven strategic mindset with a track record of shaping and executing operational strategies across multiple markets and vendors
  • Deep operational understanding, including customer service design, vendor management, and process optimisation
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver results in high-volume, complex environments with multiple priorities
  • Experience partnering with Product and Tech to drive tooling, system, and automation improvements
  • A mindset focused on continuous improvement, customer advocacy, and operational excellence
  • Demonstrated ability to operate at a 'leads leaders' level per DoorDash's Levels and Expectations framework (Team Management track): shaping strategy and OKRs beyond your own team, and developing managers who in turn develop their own teams
  • Meets the senior people-leadership bar DoorDash expects at this level: effectively leads a high-performing team, fosters a culture of belonging and engagement, and takes full accountability for the people outcomes of a large, dispersed organisation

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .
