title: Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition
descriptionHtml:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

CesiumAstro is expanding its global footprint with the establishment of a new office in Munich, Germany. We are looking to add a Senior Manager of Talent Acquisition to the team who will play a critical leadership role in building and supporting this next phase of CesiumAstro’s growth in Europe.

In this position, you will lead talent acquisition efforts for CesiumAstro’s Munich office, developing and executing the recruiting strategy required to build the organization from the ground up. The Senior Manager will partner closely with leadership, human resources, and functional leaders to translate business and workforce plans into an effective hiring strategy for Germany and the broader European talent market.


JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Partner with U.S. based Talent Acquisition and Human Resources leadership to align European hiring activities, processes, and operating standards with CesiumAstro’s broader talent strategy.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing recruiting team to support rapid growth in Munich and broader European hiring needs.
  • Lead full-cycle recruiting for critical positions, including specialized engineering, technical, operations, and business roles.
  • Develop targeted sourcing strategies and talent pipelines across Europe for highly specialized professionals in aerospace, satellite communications, RF systems, electronics, embedded systems, hardware, software, and related disciplines.
  • Partner with executives, hiring managers, and technical leaders to define position requirements, develop candidate profiles, establish interview strategies, and drive hiring decisions.
  • Establish and scale the recruiting infrastructure, resources, and capabilities necessary as hiring demand grows.
  • Build CesiumAstro’s employer presence within the German and European aerospace and advanced technology markets through relationships with universities, technical institutions, professional organizations, industry networks, and talent communities.
  • Deliver a high-quality candidate experience that reflects CesiumAstro’s culture, mission, technical ambition, and growth trajectory.

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Communications, Psychology, or a related field with a minimum of 9 years of related experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruiting, Human Resources, workforce planning, or a related discipline.
  • 2–5 years of leadership or management experience leading Talent Acquisition professionals, recruiting teams, or significant recruiting initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing recruiting strategies in a high-growth or rapidly scaling organization.
  • Significant experience recruiting specialized engineering and technical talent.
  • Strong understanding of the German talent market and demonstrated ability to recruit across Germany and, where appropriate, the broader European market.
  • Knowledge of applicable German and European recruiting, employment, candidate data privacy, and recordkeeping requirements.
  • Expertise in full-cycle recruiting, sourcing strategy, talent pipeline development, candidate assessment, workforce planning, and talent acquisition program management.
  • Advanced analytical judgment in interpreting recruiting metrics, pipeline health, source effectiveness, hiring forecasts, and workforce trends.
  • Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to translate organizational objectives and workforce requirements into actionable recruiting strategies.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a startup environment where strategy development and hands-on execution are equally important.
  • Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) such as Greenhouse, Lever, Workday Recruiting, iCIMS, or similar platforms.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to partner effectively with executives, technical leaders, hiring managers, candidates, and colleagues across multiple locations and time zones.
  • Professional proficiency in English required; German language proficiency is strongly preferred.

    • PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
  • Experience within space, aerospace, defense, satellite, RF, electronics, telecommunications, or another advanced technology environment.
  • Experience building a new office, business unit, geographic market, or technical organization.
    • CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.
    Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including new starter’s nationality, any previous or dual nationalities held, place of birth and country of residence may limit those roles that you can perform for the organization.
    Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

Tasks

Requirements

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit SolidWorks, insbesondere in der Arbeit mit dem PDM Vault und der Erstellung automatisierter Workflows.

  • Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Stücklistenstrukturen, Eigenschaften in SolidWorks und Teilenummernsysteme.

  • Erfahrung in der Teamführung (z. B. Urlaubsplanung, Zeiterfassung, Ressourcenmanagement, Konfliktlösung).

  • Fähigkeit zum Aufbau starker Beziehungen zu Stakeholdern, einschließlich Kundenkontakt bei Bedarf.

  • Verständnis für Änderungsprozesse und die Verwaltung von Abweichungen.
  • Exzellentes Zeitmanagement und Priorisierung.

  • Bewertung von Komponenten und Prozessen hinsichtlich Kosteneffizienz und Zuverlässigkeit.
  • Kenntnisse in PED & ATEX.
  • Erfahrung mit Stahl- und Kunststoffrohrleitungen sowie mechanisches Verständnis.
  • Erfahrung mit PFDs und P&IDs, Komponenten und deren Verrohrung.
  • Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Druck, Temperatur, Durchfluss und Füllstand sowie zugehörige Messtechnik.
  • Erfahrung mit diversen Softwarelösungen: PDS, PDMS, SP3D, E3D, AutoCAD, SolidWorks.Kenntnisse über die Leistung von Druckbehältern, Pumpen und Wärmetauschern.

Besonders vorteilhaft

Benefits

title: Senior Mechanical Systems Test Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As a Senior Mechanical Systems Test Engineer (all genders), you will be responsible for the development, implementation, and operation of the Flight Control System (FCS) test environment (“Iron Bird”) at VÆRIDION.

You will lead a major engineering project with significant cost and program impact, ensuring the successful development of a fully integrated test rig that enables system integration, validation, and certification of the aircraft’s primary and secondary flight control system.

You will work at the interface of mechanical systems, actuation, control, and system integration, contributing directly to the development and certification of electric aircraft.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Test Strategy & System Responsibility

    • Take ownership of the test concept and strategy for the Flight Control System (FCS).

    • Define test requirements, architectures, and validation approaches for system-level testing.

    • Ensure alignment of all test activities with development, safety of flight, and certification objectives.

  • Iron Bird Development (Test Rig Project Leadership)

    • Lead the development, implementation, and commissioning of the FCS Iron Bird test rig.

    • Define system architecture, interfaces, and functional requirements of the test environment.

    • Manage the development of mechanical, electrical, and control system integration within the test rig.

    • Drive supplier selection, coordination, and technical oversight for test rig development (CAPEX project).

    • Ensure delivery of the test rig within program timelines, budget, and technical requirements.

  • Test Execution & System Validation

    • Plan and execute system-level test campaigns on the Iron Bird.

    • Ensure reliable, high-quality test data generation and reporting.

    • Analyse system behaviour and support validation of flight control performance and safety.

    • Support verification and certification activities.

  • Test Asset Ownership

    • Own the Iron Bird test asset, ensuring configuration control, readiness, and safe operation.

    • Establish processes for operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the test rig.

    • Ensure traceability and reproducibility of test configurations and results.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Work closely with flight controls, systems engineering, structures, and test teams.

    • Interface with design engineers to ensure testability and integration readiness.

    • Support integration of hardware, actuators, sensors, and control systems.

  • Health, Safety & Compliance

    • Promote and uphold a strong safety culture in all test activities.

    • Ensure compliance with relevant safety standards, especially for complex mechanical systems.

    • Establish risk assessments, safe operating procedures, and training for test operations.

 

Your Profile:

  • Degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related field.

  • Extensive experience in testing and validation of complex mechanical or aerospace systems.

  • Proven experience in developing test rigs or large-scale test environments.

  • Experience in leading technical projects with high complexity and impact.

  • Strong understanding of mechanical systems, actuation, and mechanical flight control architectures.

  • Experience in system integration testing, ideally in aerospace applications.

  • Experience with development of test rigs, Iron Birds, or similar system-level test environments.

  • Knowledge of instrumentation, measurement systems, and data acquisition.

  • Understanding of certification-driven testing and validation processes.

  • Experience managing suppliers and external partners for engineering projects.

  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to drive complex projects to completion.

  • Excellent problem-solving and system-level thinking skills.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

  • Fluent in English, German is a plus.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

As a Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter, you’ll manage and grow a large portfolio of fleet business, using data and AI to assess risk and tailor cover to each client. You’ll help us move into new segments, including emerging mobility, as we build one of the UK’s largest fleet MGAs. You’ll report to our Head of Motor Underwriting.

You’ll work closely with brokers, mentor junior underwriters and help shape our products, wording and processes. AI is part of the underwriting process itself: you’ll use it to pull risk data out of submissions and triage cases faster, leaving your time for the judgement calls that need an experienced underwriter.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Manage and develop a large portfolio of motor fleet business and contribute strongly to team targets.

  • Build strong, supportive relationships with brokers.

  • Help unlock growth in new market segments, including emerging mobility.

  • Collate and analyse portfolio data so our Head of Motor Underwriting can track performance.

  • Improve how we gather risk information from clients, so quoting and onboarding run smoothly for clients and brokers.

  • Spot where our policy wording and cover can improve, and raise it with our Head of Motor Underwriting.

  • Train and develop people in the Underwriting and Operations teams, and spread underwriting knowledge across Flock.

  • Use AI to extract and check risk information and speed up quoting, keeping your own judgement on every decision.

 

What you’ll need

  • Extensive experience underwriting motor fleet insurance.

  • A track record of building strong broker relationships.

  • Confidence working with data to monitor and analyse a portfolio.

  • Up-to-date knowledge of the motor fleet market and the curiosity to keep up as it changes.

  • Experience training or mentoring others.

  • Comfortable using AI in your underwriting work, and curious about where else it can help.

Nice to have: experience with large corporate customers, ACII (qualified or working towards it), or working with product teams to get process and customer journey improvements onto the roadmap.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. This role is expected to be field based rather than office based, so visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

title: Senior National Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.

We’re looking for a Senior National Account Manager to join our UKI team. In this role, you’ll manage the daily relationship with a portfolio of our largest restaurant partners, using data-driven insights to grow their sales and help them achieve operational excellence.

Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the National Accounts team. Working with partners of this scale means you will often tackle challenges that Deliveroo is facing for the first time, directly shaping the future of how we collaborate with the world's largest food brands.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Strategic Relationship Management: Act as the primary consultant for a portfolio of major restaurant partners, managing weekly operational meetings and high-level performance reviews.

  • Data-Driven Insight: Monitor and analyse partner-specific goals, creating compelling narratives from complex data to show partners where and how they can improve.

  • Consultative Growth: Increase revenue and health metrics by advising partners on best practices for selection, pricing, and service levels.

  • Operational Training: Deliver in-person training sessions for key partners covering operational best practices, Deliveroo insights, and on-site troubleshooting.

  • Regional Collaboration: Partner with regional Commercial Managers to identify and prioritise growth opportunities across specific UK zones.

  • Marketing Integration: Work with restaurant marketing counterparts to design and deliver campaigns that create long-term value for both the partner and Deliveroo.

  • Cross-Functional Advocacy: Identify opportunities to deepen relationships by involving and working with Deliveroo’s Marketing, Operations, and Product teams.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Partnership Expertise: Proven experience in account management or a strategic partnerships role, ideally within a high-growth technology or marketplace environment.

  • Analytical Rigour: The ability to manage large datasets and translate them into clear, applicable insights that drive business decisions.

  • Communication & Influence: Effective relationship-building skills with the ability to communicate and present confidently to senior stakeholders.

  • Operational Agility: A proactive approach to problem-solving and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced setting.

  • Collaborative Mindset: A team player who can work across functions to deliver complex, multi-layered projects.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

title: (Senior) Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Mit Sustaind schaffen wir die erste global harmonisierte Gesetzesdatenbank. Unsere B2B-Kunden nutzen diese Daten, um Compliance-Risiken zu minimieren und Rechtspflichten weltweit zu managen. Dafür verarbeiten wir sensible Kundendaten und Dokumente und müssen jederzeit belegen können, worauf unsere Ergebnisse beruhen. Du trägst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse, nicht nur für Tickets.   • Feature-Stränge von der Idee über das Release hinaus bis in den Live-Betrieb verantworten, dort warten und weiterentwickeln, und gemeinsam mit Kunden und Team priorisieren

  • Asynchrone Verarbeitung und Hintergrundjobs mit BullMQ und Redis entwerfen, die auch bei hoher Last stabil laufen

  • Die Oberfläche unserer SaaS-App mit Gespür für gute B2B-UI/UX gestalten

  • Qualität sichern mit Tests, Code Reviews und Monitoring, damit unsere wöchentlichen Releases auf Production verlässlich bleiben

  • Unsere Agent Runtime (Eve) und KI-gestützte Funktionen so gestalten, dass Ergebnisse überprüfbar sind und unter die Leistungsgarantie fallen können

Was Du mitbringst

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung (+ 3 Jahre) als Fullstack- oder Product Engineer mit React und TypeScript

  • Erfahrung mit Backend-Entwicklung in NestJS und Postgres

  • Erfahrung mit Queues und asynchroner Verarbeitung, idealerweise BullMQ und Redis

  • Die Fähigkeit, Features als Vertical Slice zu denken und eigenständig vom Problem bis zur Produktion zu liefern

  • Produktdenken: Du fragst nach dem Warum und entscheidest pragmatisch + iterativ, was wirklich gebaut werden muss

  • Gespür für gute B2B-UI/UX in einer SaaS-App: Du baust Oberflächen, die auch bei komplexen Inhalten klar und effizient bedienbar sind

  • Erfahrung mit Agentic Coding und die Bereitschaft, solche Tools im Arbeitsalltag gezielt einzusetzen

  • DevOps- und Plattform-Erfahrung mit AWS, Terraform und Kubernetes sowie ISO-27001-Kenntnisse sind ein Plus aber kein Muss

  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was Dich erwartet

Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, schlagkräftigen Teams, in dem jeder Verantwortung übernimmt und Ergebnisse erzielt:

title: Senior Product Manager (Consumer App)
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

Changing your car should feel like one seamless journey, not a series of disconnected tasks. Right now it's the opposite: people value their car in one place, search for the next one in another, and manage the handover somewhere else, much of it on the web and most of it forgotten between car changes. The Carwow app is our most direct relationship with those customers, and today it is nowhere near what it could be.

We are reimagining it. If we can give people a reason to open Carwow between car changes, understand what they drive and what they want next, and make the moment of changing effortless, the app becomes the place UK drivers start. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with design and engineering to build it.

This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. The best consumer apps of the next few years won't be lists with filters; they will understand you and act on your behalf. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise.

If you want to shape a new consumer product from the ground up, work at the cutting edge of applied AI, and build things that millions of UK drivers could use, this is it.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Product Strategy & Execution:

    • Set the product direction for the Carwow consumer app, defining what we build, in what order, and why

    • Lead discovery work with consumers: interviews, usage data, behavioural analysis, to build a precise understanding of where the app can add the most value

    • Identify, prototype and ship opportunities to bring AI into the app: smarter discovery, personalisation and recommendations that actually change behaviour

    • Collaborate with the Engineering Manager, Designer and Engineers as a product trio to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

    • Manage the backlog with commercial awareness, prioritising work that drives engagement, retention and revenue, not just activity

  • Design & Engineering Partnership:

    • Work shoulder to shoulder with design to shape journeys and screens from the ground up, and test them with users before engineering starts

    • Work with engineers on the right trade-offs for a native app: release cadence, quality and what to build versus reuse

    • Use AI tools every day in your own work, prototyping, synthesising research and analysing data, so the squad learns faster and ships more

  • Cross-functional Leadership:

    • Work across product, engineering, data, CRM and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

    • Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

    • Own the app's success measures and bring clean evidence, including holdouts and controlled tests, to decisions on what to scale, change or stop

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including time owning a consumer mobile app, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics

  • Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox

  • AI-native: you use AI tools daily, you have shipped or prototyped AI-powered features, and you have a clear point of view on where it adds real value for consumers

  • Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve as evidence comes in

  • A proven partnership with design and engineering: you have worked as a product trio and can hold a credible conversation about journeys, architecture and app quality

  • Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in automotive, marketplace or two-sided consumer products

  • Familiarity with habit loops and engagement design in a consumer app: push, onboarding, personalisation

  • Background in scale-up or high-growth environments

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

Pelico is hiring a Senior Product Manager — Core Platform to own one or more of the shared components that every Pelico product is built on.

Pelico is moving from features built per use case to a platform of configurable components: the data model and the engines that compute on it, the configuration layer, UI building blocks, workflows and actions, and the platform services around them. Solution teams, forward deployed engineers and AI agents combine these components to deliver a use case for a customer. The quality of that base decides how fast Pelico delivers, how well it scales and whether customers trust what they see.

You will own part of that base and run it as a product. Its users are internal teams and agents as much as planners and buyers at customer sites. The exact scope depends on your profile and the team's needs. The role is technical: you need to discuss data structures, APIs, performance and configuration models as easily as user workflows.

What You'll Do

  • Own one or more platform components end to end. Depending on the team's needs, this can be the data model and how customer data maps into it, the computation engines, the configuration layer, configurable UI building blocks (tables, detail views, dashboards), the action library and write-back to customer systems, or platform services such as access control and notifications.

  • Treat internal teams as your customers. Understand what solution PMs, forward deployed engineers and the agent team need, and turn repeated requests into reusable components instead of one-off builds.

  • Make components configurable, not custom. Decide what is configured, at which level (common, solution, customer), and where custom code is still acceptable. Cut the time it takes to deliver a new use case.

  • Design for agents as well as people. Give components clear interfaces so workflows and AI agents can call them as tools, with audit, limits and approvals.

  • Hold the bar on scale, reliability and trust. Enterprise data volumes, near real-time updates, on-prem and sovereign deployments, security reviews. Performance, correctness and explainability are product requirements.

  • Stay close to customers. Spend time with users and deployment teams at strategic accounts to see where the platform helps them and where it gets in the way.

  • Keep the platform coherent. Work with the other platform PMs and with design on shared vocabulary, data contracts and dependencies, so components fit together.

  • Run the roadmap. Write specs, set priorities with the tech lead, ship on the release train, and measure how other teams adopt your components and what it changes for customers.

About You

  • Product management: 5+ years as a PM in B2B software, including time owning a platform, infrastructure or developer-facing product used by other teams.

  • Technical fluency: comfortable with data models, APIs, configuration systems and performance trade-offs. You can read a technical design, challenge it and write acceptance criteria engineers can test.

  • Platform judgment: you know when to generalize and when not to, and you can turn down a one-off request while keeping the requester on your side.

  • Data rigor: you can query data, trace an odd output back to its source and size the impact of a change across customers.

  • Enterprise B2B experience: you know what large customers require on security, deployment and change management.

  • Domain curiosity: interest in manufacturing, supply chain or industrial operations, and the will to learn how a plant runs.

  • Cross-functional leadership: you lead engineers, designers and other PMs through decisions without formal authority.

  • Clear writing: specs, decision memos and release notes that engineers, customers and executives understand.

  • Education: a degree in engineering, computer science or a related field.

  • Experience with AI agents, LLM tool use or human-in-the-loop workflows

Nice to have

  • Experience on a platform whose components other teams combine: low-code or configuration platforms, data platforms, workflow engines, developer tools

  • Experience in supply chain, manufacturing, ERP or planning software

  • Background in data modeling, ontologies or large-scale data processing

  • Experience with on-prem or sovereign deployments at enterprise customers

  • Aerospace, defense or industrial customers

Why Pelico

We're building something genuinely hard and genuinely important. Here's what that comes with:

  • Meaningful equity — you're building this with us, so you'll own a piece of it

  • Competitive salary benchmarked to your market

  • Flexible, hybrid work model — we care about output, not face time

  • Alan health coverage — up to 70% covered by Pelico

  • Learning & development budget — we invest in people who invest in themselves

  • Opportunity to work with some of the world's most complex and fascinating manufacturing operations

  • A team that takes the work seriously without taking themselves too seriously

  • Meal allowance: €10/day worked, 50% covered via Swile

  • Transport: 50% public transit coverage or equivalent sustainable mobility package

  • ClassPass partnership — fitness, wellness, and wellbeing at a discount

Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

title: Senior Quality & Knowledge Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Reporting to the COO, you will work on two complementary topics. First, you will help design and deploy the processes and methodology needed to achieve our target certifications. Second, you will structure, organize and bring to life the company's knowledge, so that information is reliable, easy to find, and securely shared. You will work with all teams: R&D, engineering, manufacturing, software, operations, business functions...

Your Key Responsibilities

Quality management & certification

  • Contribute to building and deploying the quality management framework required for certification (ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 27001 or equivalent frameworks)
  • Map, formalize and document key processes with the teams, and help make them practical and adopted
  • Drive the certification project with your manager: gap analysis, action plan follow-up, internal audits, and preparation of external audits
  • Monitor quality KPIs, non-conformities and corrective actions, and contribute to continuous improvement

Knowledge management

  • Help define and implement the knowledge management approach: information architecture, taxonomy, naming conventions and documentation standard
  • Structure and organize data and documentation across teams so that knowledge is reliable, up to date and easy to find
  • Animate the knowledge community: train and support teams, share good practices and encourage knowledge sharing

Tools & access governance

  • Administer the knowledge and documentation tools (e.g. Confluence, Notion, SharePoint), and benchmark new solutions when relevant
  • Implement and maintain access rights governance: roles, permissions and regular reviews, in line with security and confidentiality requirements
  • Work with IT and Security teams to ensure tools and practices meet certification and customer requirements

Requirements

  • Master's degree in engineering, quality management, information management or equivalent
  • 5 + years of experience in quality management, process improvement or knowledge management
  • Hands-on involvement in at least one certification project (ISO 9001, ISO 27001 or similar)
  • Good knowledge of ISO standards and quality management systems
  • Process mapping and documentation skills
  • Hands-on experience with collaborative or knowledge management tools (Confluence, Sharepoint...)
  • Structured and rigorous, with a pragmatic approach: processes must help teams, not slow them down
  • Strong pedagogy and ability to work with scientific and technical profiles
  • Autonomous and proactive, eager to take on ownership in a fast-growing scale-up

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)

  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely)

title: Senior Research Scientist, AI Foundations Recipes
descriptionHtml:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The mission of the Waymo AI Foundations team is to develop machine learning solutions addressing open problems in autonomous driving, towards the goal of safely operating Waymo vehicles in dozens of cities and under all driving conditions. As part of our work, we also initiate and foster collaborations with other research teams in Alphabet. AI Foundations areas that we are currently focusing on include reinforcement learning, learning from demonstration, generative modeling, Bayesian inference, hierarchical learning, and robust evaluation.

In this hybrid role, you will report to a Senior Staff Software Engineer.

You will:

  • Partner with foundation model training teams to determine optimal data mixtures, training curricula, objectives, and other design choices that shape model capabilities.
  • Design global-scale pipelines for dynamically updating and reusing data mixtures as our understanding of model behavior evolves and real-world datasets are continually ingested.
  • Develop and deploy principled data-selection algorithms (e.g. influence estimation, proxy models, gradient similarity search) to find targeted subsets of data for fine tuning and RL.
  • Run large-scale empirical studies linking pre-training data composition to downstream post-training performance, translating those scaling laws into optimized production training runs.
  • Collaborate closely with behavior, perception, and evaluation teams to test these foundation models and measure their impact on the performance of the Waymo Driver.

You have:

  • PhD in ML or related in AI/CS, or MSc with a strong academic publication record
  • Strong statistical / ML knowledge
  • Proficiency in Python
  • 3+ years of experience with modern deep learning frameworks: JAX, TensorFlow/PyTorch

We prefer:

  • Proven track record of deploying ML models to production environments
  • Deep learning experience, especially with generative models, e.g., LLMs/VLMs, and/or reinforcement learning or imitation learning, transformer models, autoencoders and embeddings
  • Autonomous driving experience
  • C++ experience

descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'd be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers. Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.

This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success.

This role is fully remote in Germany. This role requires travel up to 25% of the time.

In this role, you will:

  • Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.
  • Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry.
  • Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc.
  • Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use.
  • Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers.
  • Act as a liaison between Samsara's product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.
  • Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles.
  • Work in multiple levels of the technology stack.
  • Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails.
  • Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.
  • Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT/CoM and/or Value Selling sales concepts.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.
  • Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.
  • Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.
  • Fluent in German and English.
  • Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language.
  • Work experience building solutions leveraging open APIs.
  • Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications.
  • Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.).

  • Experience working with product teams internally and feature request processes.

title: Senior Security Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mission Brief 

You are the guardian and the challenger of our security posture. At Isar Aerospace, the systems that build our rockets and the ground systems that launch them are mission critical, and protecting them takes more than good design. It takes someone who will attack their own work to be sure it holds. 

We are looking for a deeply hands-on Senior Security Engineer. You live in the consoles, the rule sets and the code. You own our secure access and network security controls, our endpoint and identity security stack, and our detection content, and you operate them yourself rather than directing from the sidelines. You wear two hats: the Builder who implements and runs the controls that keep us safe, and the Adversary who keeps testing whether those controls and detections actually fire. 

This is a senior engineering role with the spirit of an architect. You are expected to design what you operate, not just configure it: pick the pattern, write it down, and make it hold at fleet scale. A versatile engineer with real depth, comfortable switching from a firewall rule set to a detection query to a directory hardening sprint in the same week, and a technical anchor others lean on. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission 

SASE and Network Security 

  • Own and operate our SASE platform, including revamping Internet Security policies and redefining Private Access policies. 
  • Drive firewall security with the network team: own network security engineering and segmentation strategy, analyze rule sets, identify gaps, and see remediation through together with network engineering, who own the devices. 
  • Coordinate firewall-adjacent controls: IPS, AV, sandboxing and DDoS protection. 
  • Manage our DNS security and WAF solutions, including our edge and CDN-based protection services. 

Security Posture and Hardening 

  • Apply CIS Benchmarks to raise posture across firewalls, endpoints, our cloud identity platform and our cloud productivity suite. 
  • Lead the clean-up and hardening of our on-premises and cloud identity directories together with the infrastructure team, then keep both hardened on an ongoing basis. 
  • Drive our phishing-resistant MFA and privileged access programme, including just-in-time elevation and the remediation of the attack paths we find. 
  • Own certificate lifecycle and PKI operations: key ceremonies, automated renewal, and input to our post-quantum migration plan. 

Detection and Visibility 

  • Manage and tune our IPS/IDS platforms; write and maintain custom IDS signatures, and operate network sensors for NTA appliances. 
  • Build and maintain detections in our SIEM and apply MITRE ATT&CK to detection engineering and use-case design in support of the SOC. 
  • Extend visibility into OT with purpose-built OT monitoring tooling. 
  • Act as an L3 incident responder for escalated security events, and turn every finding into a fix, a new detection or a hardened configuration. 

Security Stack and Automation 

  • Own our endpoint detection and response, data protection and CASB platforms as their technical owner. 
  • Script and build internal tooling in PowerShell and Python, so controls and checks run themselves. 

Design and Engineering Partnership 

  • Design what you operate: run threat modeling and attack-path analysis on the systems you own, choose the pattern, and document standards others can execute against. 
  • Evaluate tooling and support vendor selection and renewal decisions in your domain, with a clear view of what each control costs us and what it buys. 
  • Embed security with engineering: partner with IT, infrastructure, manufacturing and mission teams to implement and validate controls in their environments across both IT and OT, respecting launch-window and change-freeze constraints and producing the evidence our audits depend on. 

Qualification Checklist 

  • Experience: 10+ years in security engineering, with real ownership of production security tooling, not policy or advisory work. 
  • Architect Spirit: you can step back from the console, design the target state, write the pattern down, and then go build it yourself. 
  • SASE: hands-on experience administering an enterprise SASE platform end to end, not just consuming it. 
  • Hardening: experience applying CIS Benchmarks to firewalls, endpoints, cloud identity and cloud productivity platforms in production, plus experience rolling out phishing-resistant MFA or privileged access management. 
  • Networking and Firewalls: solid fundamentals, enough to own segmentation strategy and to drive rule set analysis and gap remediation with a network team that owns the devices. Experience with CDN-based WAF and edge protection services. 
  • Security Stack Depth: strong background across endpoint detection and response, data protection, SIEM and detection query languages, cloud identity and on-premises directory hardening, certificate lifecycle and PKI operations, ideally including a large-scale directory clean-up or remediation effort. 
  • Detection Engineering: practical MITRE ATT&CK-driven detection work, and experience writing custom IDS/IPS signatures. 
  • Operational Depth: strong capability in detection, incident response and vulnerability management, with time spent on escalated incidents. 
  • Automation: scripting ability in PowerShell and Python, plus infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code experience. 
  • IT and OT: comfortable working across both. Working knowledge of OT protocols such as EtherNet/IP, OPC UA and Modbus, and familiarity with OT network monitoring, is a strong plus. 
  • Autonomy: operates with very high autonomy as an internal expert, taking full ownership of their work and guiding others. 
  • Mentoring: mentors engineers and analysts on the team, and acts as technical lead in cross-functional projects. 
  • Communication: clear communication and collaboration skills, able to translate technical risk for a range of audiences and to work controls through other teams. 
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or the equivalent through relevant certifications and hands-on experience. 

Bonus Skills 

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, energy, manufacturing or other OT-heavy, safety-critical environments. 
  • Prior SOC or incident response team experience. 
  • Cloud security depth in a major public cloud and its native security services. 
  • Familiarity with industry standards such as ISO 27001 and NIST. 
  • Relevant certifications, defensive or engineering (e.g., Security+, GCIA) and offensive (e.g., OSCP or equivalent), are both valued. 

What We Offer 

  • Real Ownership: the security tooling that protects a premier European space company is yours to run, rebuild and prove. 
  • Impact: the opportunity to directly protect the future of spaceflight as we approach our first orbital launch. 
  • Collaboration: work hand-in-hand with brilliant engineers and IT professionals on genuinely hard problems. 

Benefits 

  • Employee Participation Program: Share in our success through our virtual company share program
  • 6 weeks of vacation: Enjoy the days off to relax and recharge
  • Subsidised lunch: Stay energised with delicious, subsidised lunches every day
  • Relocation support: Benefit from our relocation bonus with deductible expenses up to an agreed amount
  • Wellness allowance: Stay healthy and fit with our yearly allowance for wellness activities (e.g., Gym, Massages)
  • Individual learning allowance: Grow your skills with an individual learning budget granted after the probation period
  • Physical and mental well-being: Access via OpenUp the online support from certified psychologists and lifestyle experts at no cost to you and your family
  • And Much More! Discover additional perks and benefits when you join our team.  

Who we are

We are Isar Aerospace and we are at the forefront of New Space building a modern space business to enable faster, better and cheaper access to space.

Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations.

We are a fast-growing company aiming to provide sustainable and environmentally friendly launch solutions for small and medium-sized satellites and constellations into Low Earth Orbit. The company is privately funded by world-leading technology investors with strong commitment and support and our team is made of driven and talented people with a real passion for space innovation.

We're making rockets in a way that hasn't been done before disrupting a traditional industry. If you are up for the challenge, want to work on cutting-edge projects and be part of a team changing the world for better, come, join us and launch your career!

Want to find out more about us?

Visit www.isaraerospace.com

Data Protection

We process your personal data for the purpose of managing the recruitment process and assessing your application. For detailed information on how your data is processed, including your rights, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

Isar Aerospace SE is an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. title: Senior Software Engineer - Exchange
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

About Fanatics Markets:

Fanatics Markets is the real-money prediction and trading app where you can invest in moments you care about. Built on a secure platform, we let users predict real-world outcomes and trade on events they actually follow - from sports and entertainment to political elections and beyond. Our mission is to redefine how fans engage with the moments and markets that matter most. We're looking for the right people to help us build the future of prediction markets.

Overview:

Fanatics recently acquired a CFTC-registered Designated Contract Market and Derivatives Clearing Organisation, giving Fanatics Markets its own fully regulated exchange and clearinghouse infrastructure. We are now building the engineering team that will run it.

This Senior Software Engineer (Backend) role sits at the heart of that build. You will have significant ownership over the core exchange platform, working on the systems that power order processing, market data distribution, trade lifecycle management and regulatory reporting for a CFTC-regulated exchange. The engineering challenges are those of any serious regulated trading environment, high-availability, low-latency, mission-critical infrastructure, but built for a consumer audience with the reach and distribution of Fanatics behind it.

You will be joining a team modernising an existing Java codebase and building new services in Java, working alongside engineers with deep backgrounds in regulated financial infrastructure. You will be joining a team with a clear ambition: to bring this platform to the bleeding edge of financial infrastructure. This is not a clean slate but the technical ambition is real, and engineers who join now will have a level of architectural influence and ownership that is hard to find anywhere else.

We are pioneering the use of AI as a code collaborator. We need engineers who have gone beyond experimentation and who actively use Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools to ship production code faster while maintaining exceptional quality standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, development, testing, and deployment of high-performance, fault-tolerant distributed backend services supporting the FMX exchange platform.
  • Own services and features end-to-end: spec writing, implementation, instrumentation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration based on metrics.
  • Work within and help modernise the existing Java codebase while contributing to new service development in Java and potentially Kotlin.
  • Contribute to the architecture for order processing, market data distribution, and trade lifecycle management on a CFTC-regulated exchange.
  • Build and maintain reliable daily reporting pipelines, ensuring data integrity and full audit trails across all trading activity.
  • Participate in 24/7 on-call rotations, contribute to SLO definition, alerting strategy, and incident response for mission-critical trading infrastructure.
  • Model and manage data for contracts, orders, positions, and settlements with an emphasis on correctness, integrity, and regulatory auditability.
  • Collaborate with the DevOps/Platform team to ensure services are observable, scalable, and compliant with MNPI and insider trading restrictions.
  • Conduct thorough code reviews, raising the bar on code quality, readability, security, and maintainability.
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate development velocity while maintaining high standards for security, correctness, and regulatory compliance.
  • Establish and document team standards for AI usage, prompt patterns, code review checklists, and validation strategies.
  • Contribute to a fast-paced environment, unblocking others and taking initiative where processes are still being defined.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience building highly scalable, high-performance backend applications or distributed systems.
  • Background in regulated exchange or financial infrastructure strongly preferred, brokerage, futures or derivatives exchanges (e.g. CBOE, CME, ICE), market makers, or hedge funds with relevant trading infrastructure experience, or similar CFTC/SEC-regulated environments.
  • Strong production experience with Java; Kotlin experience a plus.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka, Kinesis, PubSub, or similar) in a financial or high-throughput context.
  • Strong understanding of data integrity and transaction management in PostgreSQL or equivalent RDBMS, including financial-grade data modelling.
  • Solid grasp of software design principles (SOLID, DRY) and testing methodologies (unit, integration, end-to-end).
  • Familiarity with CFTC compliance requirements, MNPI handling, and audit trail obligations in a regulated trading environment.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and safe deployment practices for backend services.
  • Production reliability experience: monitoring, logging, alerting, on-call, and SLO definition.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) to ship production code; able to articulate specific workflow improvements.
  • Communicates complex technical concepts clearly to engineering, compliance, and business stakeholders.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities evolve and decisions are made quickly.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience at a US-regulated financial exchange or licensed trading platform (e.g. CBOE, CME, or similar).
  • Familiarity with low-latency trading systems, order book design, or market data infrastructure.
  • Experience with low-latency in-memory systems and the performance engineering techniques required to operate them at scale.
  • Experience with Aeron or similar high-performance messaging frameworks used in financial trading environments.
  • Experience modernising legacy Java codebases in a financial services context.
  • Previous experience in a high-growth or scale-up environment.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or the technical community.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Modelling & Simulation - Advanced Capabilities
department: Maritime & Maneuver Dominance : Maneuver Dominance Engineering : MD - Advanced Capabilities
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Advanced Capabilities is the internal warfighter research arm for Anduril's Maneuver Dominance division. We invent new products, inform vehicle specifications, define autonomous tactics, and work out how humans and teams of autonomous systems will operate together in future contested environments.
We're standing up a next generation simulation center in the UAE to run large-scale wargames and experiments with autonomous systems. The on-site team is small and mostly made up of warfighters and analysts. They'll be backed by our engineering teams in the UK and US.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll be the software engineer on the ground. Your main job is to build the models that make our scenarios credible. You'll also own the simulation environment that keeps the center running.
Most of your modelling will be in Python, but you'll also work in our core C++ simulation code when a model needs to go deeper or something breaks. You'll work closely with warfighters to turn their operational questions into working models.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and refine models in Python for sensors, communications, platform movement, weapon effects, electronic warfare, and tactical behaviours, at the level of fidelity the question actually requires
  • Extend and debug the core C++ simulation framework alongside engineers in the UK and US
  • Work side by side with warfighters and analysts to translate tactics, threats, and operational problems into scenarios and models they can use
  • Support the team's scripting efforts by reviewing code, building reusable tooling, and keeping things maintainable
  • Install, configure, and maintain the simulation software stack and the compute, networking, and storage it runs on
  • Validate new releases before they're used in an exercise, and build automated checks so regressions surface early
  • Root-cause failures, fix them, and document what you learn so the knowledge doesn't live in one person's head

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong proficiency in Python for modelling, tooling, and automation
  • Working proficiency in C++, enough to read, debug, and extend a performance-critical simulation codebase
  • Experience building models or simulations of complex systems (agent-based, discrete-event, time-stepped, or similar)
  • Comfort with mathematical and physical modelling: dynamics, probability, and stochastic processes
  • Military experience, or a genuine interest in the problems warfighters face and how to model them
  • Hands-on experience setting up and troubleshooting distributed systems and networks
  • Ability to work independently in a small, remote team and communicate clearly with both engineers and operators
  • Willingness to relocate to Abu Dhabi
  • Eligibility to pass the security and background checks required for sensitive information systems

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Defence, aerospace, or robotics experience, especially mission-level or multi-agent simulation
  • Experience with military M&S tools (e.g. AFSIM, VBS, Command PE) or distributed simulation standards (DIS, HLA)
  • Experience with large-scale Monte Carlo or design-of-experiments analysis
  • CI/CD, test automation, Docker, or infrastructure-as-code experience
  • Active security clearance

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support. 

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will be focused on Firefox on Windows, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments and especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

What you’ll do: 

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Contribute to new features and improvements.

  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring:

  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.

title: Senior Sofware Engineer, Operational Excellence
descriptionHtml:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

Incidents interrupt operations, drain team productivity, and erode user trust. As a member of the Operational Excellence team, you will help GetYourGuide notice problems sooner, fix them faster, and stop the same ones from coming back, so our travelers and suppliers see fewer disruptions and trust us more.

As we push boldly into AI-powered experiences, we don’t ignore the risks that increased output velocity creates. Faster change means more places for silent failures to hide. You will help our engineering organisation move fast with confidence, with the safeguards (tests, safe rollouts, monitoring, clear ownership) that catch problems before customers do.

Observability and cost efficiency are part of the same job: teams can’t fix or own what they can’t see.   • Reduce the cost and risk of deployments through better tooling, feature flagging, and progressive rollout practices

  • Make infrastructure cost visible to teams and help them find and act on efficiency opportunities

  • Leverage AI tooling to accelerate incident response, improve developer workflows, and scale operational practices

Your toolkit

  • 5+ years of relevant industry experience

  • Deep understanding of observability tooling — we use Datadog (metrics, APM, logs, dashboards) — and of what makes alerts and production debugging effective

  • Track record of improving the reliability of production systems at scale

  • Strong coding skills in Java; comfortable reading and contributing in Go across infrastructure contexts; enough frontend context to collaborate with React / Vue teams

  • Working experience with Kubernetes and AWS, and familiarity with service mesh technologies (Istio/Envoy)

  • Hands-on, everyday use of AI in your engineering work

  • You work well across teams and raise standards through partnership

  • Communicates in clear, concise English: you listen to understand, adapt to your audience, and make sure people know what to do next

What sets you apart

  • You have led improvements that reached many teams at once, not just your own, with results you can point to

  • You have helped teams ship with more confidence and fewer production surprises
