title: Staff Backend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
📍London / UK Remote | 💰 Staff Backend Engineer (L60) £130,000 - £170,000 + Equity + Benefits | Technology - Engineering  

About our Engineering Teams:

We have around 650 engineers out of roughly 5,500 people in total - and we have big ambitions. There are many interesting challenges ahead, and we're happy for people to move between teams or to specialise, whatever you prefer. As an engineer here you'd be able to work directly with anyone across the company, and we run regular knowledge-sharing sessions so you’ll learn heaps about everything from how banks work to effective communication.

We contribute to open source software as much as possible. Our blogis a good place to learn even more about what we do!

What you’ll be working on: 

We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies:

  • Go to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial here)
  • Cassandra for most persistent data storage
  • Kafka for our asynchronous message queue
  • Envoy Proxy for RPC
  • Kubernetes and Docker to schedule and run our services 
  • AWS for most of our infrastructure
  • React for internal web dashboards
  • We also have two physical datacenter sites with actual cables to connect to various third parties

Your day-to-day   

This role is all about collaborating across disciplines to test hypotheses and make a difference to customers. As a product backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more! 

Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). They are: Core Banking, Business Banking, Wealth, Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Platform, Fincrime, Security & Expansion. All of our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront- from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.

Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.

How we work 💻

Locations & Flexible Working: 

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. 

We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. 

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

You should apply if:

  • you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product
  • you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day
  • you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions
  • you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity
  • you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software
  • you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).
  • you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing

We're on the look out for L60 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our Engineering Progression Framework we are also hiring on L40 & L50, our interview process will determine your levelling. 

The Interview Process:

Our interview process involves three main stages: 

  1. Initial Call 
  2. Take home task or pair coding exercise 
  3. Final interview including a system design and a behavioural interview 

Our average process takes around 2-3 weeks but we will always work around your availability. 

One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see here.

What’s in it for you:

💰 £130,000 - £170,000 + Equity

✈️We can help you relocate to the UK 

✅ We can sponsor visas.

📍This role can be based in our London office or remotely across the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here 

We're usually always hiring for Backend Engineers, so there's no closing date for this job.

title: Staff Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.

You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.

We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.

We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.

We hope that's you.

About the Role

As a Staff Data Engineer, you will take responsibility for our most complex data platform work, owning the ingestion pipelines, streaming infrastructure and platform capabilities that Analytics Engineering, Data Science and business teams rely on every day. Based in our London HQ, you will support the Hims US business as part of the wider Hims & Hers data community, working closely with data teams on both sides of the Atlantic.

Working across data engineering, platform engineering and analytics, you will act as the directly responsible owner for multi-sprint initiatives, including CDC connector buildouts, our BigQuery warehouse workstreams and event-streaming infrastructure. You will also mentor Senior Data Engineers, helping them grow from squad-level to cross-squad impact, and help raise the engineering standards of the whole team as we scale our preventative care ecosystem globally.

What You’ll Do

  • Guide Platform Initiatives: Take ownership of high-complexity, multi-sprint initiatives, including CDC connector buildouts, BigQuery warehouse workstreams, event-streaming infrastructure, lower environments and adoption of shared standards.
  • Build Dependable Ingestion: Design and maintain ingestion pipelines and platform infrastructure, from source connectivity through the raw and cleansed warehouse layers, that Analytics Engineering, Data Science and business teams rely on daily. Take responsibility for production deployments of containerised services on Kubernetes (EKS) across our AWS and GCP environments.
  • Run Streaming Pipelines: Design and look after event-driven and streaming pipelines using Kafka (AWS MSK) and Flink on EKS, delivering CDC and user event tracking (UET) streams into BigQuery, with scaling approaches, cost guardrails, consumer lag alerting and runbooks in place before production rollout.
  • Own CDC Ingestion: Take responsibility for change-data-capture pipelines from source systems into BigQuery end to end, from Terraform provisioning through schema change governance and production monitoring.
  • Own Data Contracts: Take responsibility for raw-to-cleansed data contracts, schema governance and SLAs, agreeing expectations with the teams who depend on them.
  • Champion Data Quality: Ship pipelines with built-in quality checks, including dbt tests, anomaly detection, schema validation and data-drift alerting, so our data stays trustworthy.
  • Strengthen System Reliability: Agree KPIs and SLOs, build monitoring and alerting as code with Datadog (or equivalent), join the on-call rotation, and look after Tier 1 tickets and runbooks across your area, working through the root causes rather than the symptoms.
  • Empower Data Teams: Build platform capabilities that unblock Analytics Engineering, Data Science and ML roadmaps. Partner with legal, security and DevOps on compliance controls, including HIPAA/PHI handling, UK GDPR and cross-border access to patient data, and on IaC hardening.
  • Mentor & Share Standards: Mentor Senior Data Engineers through design reviews, code reviews and pairing, helping them grow their impact to cross-squad scope. Help the team adopt good practice in testing, CI/CD, observability as code, Airflow, dbt and Schema Registry governance, and join ARC reviews for changes with cross-team or financial impact.

About You

  • Platform Engineering Depth: You are a highly experienced data engineer (typically 8+ years) who has designed, built and run production ingestion and streaming platforms at scale. You are confident in Python and SQL, comfortable with Kafka, Flink, dbt, Airflow and BigQuery, and ideally have built Kafka-ecosystem services in Kotlin, Go or similar.
  • Initiative Ownership: You have taken ownership of complex, multi-sprint technical initiatives as the directly responsible owner, from scoping and design docs through to production rollout, and can keep several teams aligned along the way.
  • Reliability Mindset: You treat reliability as part of the design. You have set SLOs, built monitoring and alerting as code, worked on-call rotations and written the runbooks that make operations repeatable.
  • Data Quality & Governance: You build quality checks into pipelines from the start, and you have experience with data contracts, schema governance and tooling such as a Schema Registry.
  • Infrastructure as Code: You are comfortable with Terraform and CI/CD patterns across AWS and GCP, and enjoy working alongside DevOps and security colleagues to harden them.
  • Mentoring & Influence: You help other engineers grow through design reviews, code reviews and pairing. You work across squads, take part in architecture reviews and share standards that other teams choose to adopt.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: You work well with Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, legal and security, and can explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical colleagues.

Nice to have

  • Experience in regulated sectors (such as healthtech, fintech or gaming), finding creative paths forward inside compliance constraints rather than being stopped by them. Familiarity with reverse-ETL / data activation tools such as Hightouch or Segment is also a plus.

Why join Eucalyptus

  • What's next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer, launching into new conditions, demographics and geographies.
  • Build something world-changing - We're on the path to becoming the world's largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced and deeply rewarding.
  • Make real impact - Your work directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.
  • Accelerate your growth - High ownership, continuous feedback and dedicated development support.
  • Join a motivated team - Talented peers solving complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What's ahead in the UK

  • Be an owner - Your own stake in the business with our employee options programme
  • Invest in your growth - Annual development budget plus 3 days of professional development leave
  • Work flexibly - Hybrid setup with 3 days a week in our Old Street office, designed for focus and collaboration
  • Support your well-being - Private health insurance through Vitality, or a monthly wellness allowance to spend on what matters most to you
  • Take time off - 25 days of holiday, enhanced parental leave and work from anywhere 3 weeks a year
  • Join a connected team - A vibrant office culture with regular socials, clubs, after-school sport and seasonal events

At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

title: Staff Pricing Analyst, B2B
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Most delivery companies sell on price and volume, and find out later whether a client made them money. Sales teams are measured on what they sign, not on what a signing is worth. Relay wants every client, and every new shop in the network, to be one we'd choose again.

That is harder for us than for most, because what a client is worth depends on how their parcels flow through a network that's still growing. Engineering and analytics engineering build what you design.

Sales Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what a client or shop is worth and which signings sales should chase. The sales lead acts on your calls.

  • What is a new client or a new shop worth, when its value depends on where it sits in a network that changes every month? What would you build so sales knows before it signs?

  • Which signings become partners who do well with us, and what does that tell sales to look for?

  • The quarter's target is set. What has to close by when for it to hold, and what would tell you early that it won't?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide how sales values what it wins, and the result shows in what we sign next.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Staff Pricing Analyst, B2B at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Sales problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Sales decides: which signals count, what a client or shop is worth, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the sales lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the numbers and the street disagree: a new shop, a client's parcels at the sort centre.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, sales chooses what to go after on measures you built, and can see whether the quarter will land before it ends.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned B2B pricing or commercial decisions and their number, rather than maintaining sales dashboards.

  • Have built, hands on, the first version of how a company values a customer or a deal: unit economics, lifetime value, or what it costs to win one.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or sales went after different deals because of it.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Can say early whether a quarter will land, and what would tell you it won't.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

Company Description

Since its creation in 2007 in the financial city of Frankfurt am Main, Solactive AG has grown to one of the key players in the indexing space. The German multi-asset index provider focusses on tailor-made indices, offering to its clients a faster service, with greater flexibility and at a reasonable cost. Solactive AG and its subsidiaries have become one of the fastest growing index providers over the past few years and support the leading investment banks and asset managers across the globe. We have gained global recognition for our role in the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) industry, where we rank among the top providers worldwide for underlying indices. We also excel in diverse areas such as Structured Products and investment mandates, showcasing the wide range of our capabilities. The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape.

Job Overview

Our Structure team builds the software foundation for consistent, scalable index development at Solactive. We provide APIs, libraries, configuration patterns, testing frameworks, and reusable components for index construction workflows, supporting a great UX for ideation, production, and maintenance of new indices with clients. In this senior role, you will shape the technical architecture of a business-critical service that accelerates index development and improves quality across the index lifecycle. If you thrive on leading complex initiatives and shaping engineering excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Tasks

  • Lead the technical direction and architectural evolution of the domain, delivering scalable and maintainable solutions for internal and external users of the index development service.
  • Lead complex initiatives end-to-end: clarify ambiguous requirements, shape solution approaches, and drive implementation across backend, frontend, data, and infrastructure.
  • Raise engineering standards through hands-on leadership, including code and design reviews, coaching, and a strong focus on simplicity, quality, and maintainability.
  • Partner with product, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to identify core problems, challenge assumptions, and deliver solutions aligned with the platform vision.
  • Drive system design across distributed services, APIs, integrations, data models, and cloud infrastructure, ensuring scalability, reliability, and operational readiness.
  • Improve engineering effectiveness by refining processes, reducing friction, strengthening ownership, and enabling better trade-offs between speed, quality, and risk.
  • Mentor engineers and support their growth in technical depth, ownership, and end-to-end delivery.

Your Profile

  • Strong hands-on software engineering background (10+ years) with deep expertise in common programming languages. We use Java, Python, and Typescript.
  • Strong system design skills, including service decomposition, API design, integration patterns, data modeling, scalability, reliability, and operational concerns in cloud-native environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including deploying, operating, and troubleshooting cloud-native applications in containerized environments.
  • Ability to lead ambiguous, business-heavy problem spaces: identify real requirements and root problems, structure chaos, and translate needs into quality technical solutions.
  • Proven track record of simplifying complex systems and delivering maintainable end-to-end solutions with high business impact.
  • Strong experience with modern engineering practices: code reviews, design reviews, CI/CD, testing strategy, observability, incident response, and production ownership.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders without formal authority.
  • Product mindset and delivery orientation: balances technical quality with business value and drives initiatives to completion.
  • Experience with React and TypeScript frontend development is a plus.

Our Offer

  • Global Team: Join our motivated international team at Solactive.
  • FinTech Excellence: Experience the cutting-edge world of FinTech at Solactive.
  • Modern Culture: Thrive in our modern, flat hierarchy and startup-like culture.
  • Responsibility & Connections: Take responsibility from day one and build valuable relationships both inside and outside the company.
  • Vacation: Enjoy 30 days of annual vacation, plus additional time off for Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve.
  • Competitive Compensation: Receive a competitive compensation package.
  • Community & Networking: Participate in our various networking events, tech talks, and business talks.
  • Professional Development: Grow both personally and professionally through our diverse training offerings.
  • Flexibility: Embrace a flexible work culture with the freedom to choose your work hours, including a hybrid work model, all within a diverse and dynamic environment.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Inference
descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You'll Do:

CoreWeave’s Inference team builds and operates the core cloud platform powering massive-scale GPU workloads for AI/ML, VFX, rendering, and real-time inference. Our stack is engineered for speed, scale, and cost efficiency—providing a powerful alternative to traditional hyperscalers where infrastructure is our core product operated at massive scale.

About the role: 

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Inference team, you will operate as a technical leader across multiple teams and services, driving architecture, performance, and reliability for CoreWeave’s Kubernetes-native inference platform. You will define and lead complex, cross-cutting design initiatives spanning request routing, adaptive scheduling, GPU resource management, and cost-per-token optimisation under strict P99 SLAs. In this high-impact role, you will implement advanced inference optimisations—such as speculative decoding and KV-cache reuse—while establishing performance benchmarking frameworks, guiding cross-functional alignment across infrastructure boundaries, and raising the bar for engineering rigour and observability practices across the organisation.

Who You Are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 8+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems or cloud platforms, with a proven track record of leading cross-team or organisation-level technical initiatives at scale.
  • Strong coding proficiency in Go, Python, or C++.
  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes at production scale, including orchestration, scheduling, and service design.
  • Strong understanding of networked systems, performance optimisation, and distributed system design.
  • Hands-on engineering experience with inference systems, including batching/micro-batching strategies, caching, memory optimisation, mixed precision (BF16/FP8), and streaming token delivery.
  • Demonstrated ability to systematically improve tail latency (P95/P99) and platform reliability through metrics-driven engineering.
  • Proven experience owning system-wide SLIs/SLOs, capacity planning, autoscaling strategies, and mentoring senior and mid-level engineers.

Preferred:

  • Direct open-source or production contributions to modern inference frameworks (e.g., vLLM, Triton, TensorRT-LLM, Ray Serve, or TorchServe).
  • Deep experience with GPU systems engineering and hardware performance optimisation (e.g., CUDA, NCCL, RDMA, NUMA, or GPU interconnects).
  • Direct exposure to large-scale AI/ML infrastructure or hyperscale cloud environments.

Wondering if you're a good fit?

We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams—even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match.

  • You love to: Scale highly complex distributed architectures and mentor engineering cohorts to elevate technical standards across an organisation.
  • You're curious about: Pioneering low-latency inference optimisations and finding innovative shortcuts to optimise cost-per-token performance.
  • You're an expert in: Metrics-driven engineering, troubleshooting micro-bottlenecks, and delivering stable cloud platforms under strict multi-tenant constraints.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for take-off, the organisation's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:

  • Family-level Medical Insurance
  • Family-level Dental Insurance 
  • Generous Pension Contribution 
  • Life Assurance at 4x Salary 
  • Critical Illness Cover 
  • Employee Assistance Programme 
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Work culture focused on innovative disruption

Benefits may vary by location. 

Equal Opportunity 

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

Recruitment Agencies

CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.

Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to technology and/or source code subject to U.S. export control laws. Any such access will be provided only in compliance with applicable U.S. export control requirements. As part of the recruitment process, CoreWeave may request limited information reasonably necessary to assess applicable export-control requirements. 

Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications

Phosphor (6th Floor), 133 Park Street, London, SE1 9EA

and can be contacted by emailing ----- Controller’s data protection officer can be contacted at ----- Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. title: Stage – Assistant·e chargé·e de communication orienté.e contenus digitaux (F/H)
descriptionHtml:
Durée : 6 mois – Temps plein
Période : à partir de février 2027
Localisation : Paris 9e
Encadré par : la responsable communication de l’événement

À propos d’Artefact Open Innovation

Chez Artefact Open Innovation, nous sommes des entrepreneurs convaincus que la compétitivité, l’efficacité et la transformation des grandes organisations se gagnent en développant de nouvelles formes de collaborations et une compréhension des enjeux liés à l’adoption des nouvelles technologies – notamment DATA et IA.

Pour cela, nous partageons et propageons l’esprit entrepreneur avec des modes de collaboration plus agiles à l’échelle :

  • Des individus, à travers des programmes de formation et l’accélération de projets d’innovation

  • Des équipes, grâce à des expériences d’innovation participative et l’adoption de nouveaux modes de collaboration

  • Des écosystèmes et des organisations, en créant et animant de larges communautés ouvertes (open innovation), mobilisées autour d’objectifs communs

Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un·e stagiaire communication orienté·e contenus digitaux, pour accompagner la chargée de communication au sein du pôle événementiel & communication sur la production et la diffusion des contenus avant, pendant et après l’événement France Quantum.

Missions

En soutien direct à la chargée de communication, vous interviendrez sur un large spectre de missions :

Création de contenus

  • Création de visuels sur Canva
  • Montage de courtes vidéos dynamiques pour les réseaux sociaux (reels, stories, teasers, formats événementiels)
  • Rédaction de posts pour valoriser les speakers, partenaires et écosystèmes (recherche, industrie, tech, innovation…)
  • Déclinaison des contenus selon les temps forts du projet (annonces, teasing, live event, post-event)

Community management

  • Programmation et modération des publications sur LinkedIn
  • Veille et participation à l’animation des communautés
  • Suivi des performances des contenus et remontée d’insights

Partenariats & diffusion

  • Suivi des échanges liés aux contreparties partenaires (visibilité, posts, formats dédiés)
  • Création et envoi de mailings marketing

Post-événement

  • Tri et sélection des photos
  • Rédaction des posts de remerciement et de valorisation
  • Vérification et mise en ligne des replays
  • Aide à l’organisation des retours d’expérience (REX)

Contribution à la réflexion stratégique

  • Participation aux réflexions autour de la stratégie de contenus et de la ligne éditoriale
  • Brainstorming sur de nouveaux formats de contenus et de nouveaux canaux de communication

Contribution à la réflexion sur

  • la mise en place d’un rétroplanning éditorial
  • la structuration de packages de communication pour les partenaires

Le ou la stagiaire sera force de proposition et impliqué·e dans la réflexion, les décisions finales relevant de la responsable communication.

Profil recherché

  • Étudiant·e en Master communication, marketing ou équivalent, avec quelques expériences en stage en communication
  • Créatif·ve, curieux·se, avec un fort attrait pour l’IA et l’événementiel
  • Bonne maîtrise de la création de visuels et goût prononcé pour l’image (photo & vidéo)
  • Excellente orthographe en français et bilingue anglais (pour suivre et participer à l’écrit & à l’oral dans les deux langues)
  • Organisé·e, rigoureux·se, capable de gérer plusieurs projets en simultané
  • Autonome, dynamique, force de proposition, avec un excellent relationnel
  • À l’affût des tendances en communication digitale et social media

Compétences techniques

  • Canva indispensable, Photoshop est un plus
  • Outils de montage vidéo : CapCut, Premiere Rush ou équivalent
  • Connaissance d’outils de mailing (Pardot ou autre)

Conditions

  • Gratification : selon profil et convention
  • Lieu : Paris 9e, avec possibilité de télétravail partiel

title: Stage community- en interactieredacteur magazines - Libelle
descriptionHtml:
Amsterdam - Bij Libelle geloven we dat mooie en inspirerende verhalen mensen verbinden. Via onze website, app en social media brengen we onze lezers met elkaar én met de redactie in contact. Met quizzen, enquêtes en winacties stimuleren we die interactie iedere dag. Wil jij ervaring opdoen en meewerken aan een inspirerende omgeving? Lees dan snel verder!

Wat ga je doen?
Als stagiair Community- en Interactieredacteur speel je een actieve rol in het versterken van de verbinding tussen onze lezers en de redactie. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze online community betrokken blijft en levert waardevolle inzichten die bijdragen aan nieuwe verhalen en content. Dit doe je onder andere door:

  • Onderwerpen, stellingen, quizzen en enquêtes te bedenken die lezers uitnodigen om actief mee te praten.

  • Winacties te ontwikkelen en uit te voeren in samenwerking met de redactie en marketeers.

  • Reacties op onze website en socialmediakanalen te modereren en online gesprekken op een prettige manier te begeleiden volgens onze huisregels.

  • Te signaleren welke onderwerpen leven onder onze lezers en deze inzichten te delen met de redactie.

  • Actief mee te denken over nieuwe ideeën en verbeteringen op het gebied van communitymanagement en online engagement.

Je maakt onderdeel uit van een betrokken en ervaren redactie, waar je veel ruimte krijgt om ideeën aan te dragen en praktijkervaring op te doen.

Wie zijn wij?
Wij zijn Libelle, een van de grootste en meest vertrouwde magazinemerken van Nederland. Met inspirerende verhalen, praktische tips en herkenbare onderwerpen bereiken we dagelijks een grote en betrokken doelgroep via ons magazine, onze website, app en socialmediakanalen. We bouwen continu aan een sterke community waarin lezers elkaar én onze redactie weten te vinden.

Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat?
Voor deze stage zoeken wij een nieuwsgierige en betrokken student met interesse in online communities en digitale content. Daarnaast:

  • Je volgt een relevante hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Communicatie, Media, Journalistiek of Commerciële Economie.

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig naar wat er leeft onder onze lezers.

  • Je vindt het leuk om online gesprekken op gang te brengen en mensen met elkaar te verbinden.

  • Je kunt zorgvuldig, objectief en zelfstandig afwegingen maken.

  • Je denkt graag mee over nieuwe ideeën en verbeteringen.

  • Je bent op zoek naar een stageplek vanaf februari 2027 voor een periode van minimaal 5 maanden.

Bij DPG Media staan we open voor alle talent in de maatschappij. Ongeacht je achtergrond, nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren op deze functie. Juist door de verschillen tussen collega’s ontstaan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen. En dat past dan weer heel erg goed bij ons als organisatie. We zijn benieuwd wie jij bent en welke kwaliteiten en ervaring jij meebrengt.

Wat krijg je van ons?
Bij ons krijg je een inspirerende werkomgeving die continu in beweging is. Collega’s die denken in mogelijkheden, het glas halfvol zien en we geven jou de kans je dagelijks te ontwikkelen. Dit doen we onder andere door onze DPG Academy. Dit geeft jou alle mogelijkheid het beste uit jezelf te halen en een echte mediamaker te zijn!

  • 💰 Een passende stagevergoeding van 400 euro p/m.

  • 🎓 Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en trainingen.

  • 💻 Een laptop om op te werken.

  • 🤝 Begeleiding van ervaren journalisten en marketeers.

  • 🏢 Een geweldige werkplek in Amsterdam (Mediavaert). Van (spontane) borrels tot teamuitjes en ons legendarische personeelsfeest, hier voel je je meteen thuis!

    Stagelopen bij DPG Media
    Stagelopen bij DPG Media betekent niet alleen dat je de door jou geleerde theorie in de praktijk brengt door een bijdrage te leveren aan onze ambitieuze teams, ook ga je bij ons écht wat leren. Een aanvulling ben je zeker, want jouw creatieve en frisse blik wordt erg gewaardeerd. Na je stage kan je zeggen dat je ook nog eens écht toffe dingen hebt bereikt én hebt gewerkt bij het grootste mediabedrijf van Nederland. Zet dat maar op je cv!

    Over DPG Media
    DPG Media heeft met haar sterke merken een stevige marktpositie in alle onderdelen van de mediabranche. Elke dag werken we met ontzettend veel plezier aan ons portfolio dat bestaat uit uiteenlopende A-merken, waaronder AD, AutoWeek, DonaldDuck, Libelle, Margriet, Linda, NU.nl, Qmusic, vtwonen en RTL. Lead senior R&D and commercial conversations and translate demand into scalable solution paths

◆ Lead high-stakes discussions with senior stakeholders across pharma R&D (e.g. Discovery, Translational Science, Clinical Development) and commercial functions (e.g. Portfolio Strategy, New Product Planning, Medical Affairs, Market Access).

◆ Ground discovery in customers’ end-to-end workflows and decision points (e.g. target identification and validation, Target Product Profile development, candidate selection, indication expansion, lifecycle management) to define target state, success criteria, and constraints.

◆ Translate ambiguous asks into a solution concept and delivery path, including where Causaly creates value in the workflow, scope boundaries, sequencing, timelines, risks, dependencies, and mutual commitments.

◆ Shape expectations and commercial framing to ensure scalable commitments (what is standard, what is configurable, what requires investment, and what is out of scope).

Design and steer technical solutions

◆ Work with customer architecture, data, IT, and AI teams in working-level depth on Causaly’s platform capabilities, APIs, data model, and integration patterns (e.g. with internal data lakes, knowledge management systems, and enterprise AI tooling), going beyond high-level positioning to a solution design both sides can build against.

◆ Drive the solution design for new plays, including integration approach, data flows, security, and deployment model, and work alongside Causaly’s Engineering and Data teams through build, testing, and deployment, without being the engineer writing production code.

◆ Pressure-test technical feasibility early: review architectures, spot integration and data risks, and make informed calls on what can be configured, what needs to be built, and what effort it will take.

◆ Shape and evaluate technology partnerships (e.g. data providers, cloud and AI platforms, systems integrators), including strategic rationale, technical fit, integration approach, and joint solution design.

◆ Represent Causaly’s platform and roadmap credibly in executive and technical forums, clearly positioning what the platform does today, what is configurable, and where it is heading.

Build repeatable solution playbooks (incl. Private Data & integrations)

◆ Turn recurring demand into solution playbooks anchored in specific R&D and commercial workflows, including:

◇ Offering definition, use cases, and packaging

◇ Qualification and fit criteria

◇ Scoping templates and success plans

◇ Delivery blueprints, reference architectures, and enablement assets

◆ Standardise complex offerings (e.g. Private Data, enterprise integrations, and AI workflows on customer data) into productised motions with clear patterns, governance, and pilot-to-rollout pathways.

◆ Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data to define feasibility options and reference architectures, and surface clear product and investment recommendations.

Validate plays through lighthouse execution

◆ Co-sponsor a small number of lighthouse opportunities with Sales to validate new solution plays.

◆ Orchestrate early cross-functional work (pilot design, governance, decisioning) with the explicit goal of making the play transferable and repeatable, not owning delivery long-term.

Institutionalise and hand off into BAU

◆ Drive clean handoff of validated plays into BAU (Sales, CS, Delivery, Product), including training, assets, decision trees, and ownership clarity.

◆ Maintain a structured feedback loop into Product on product candidates, investment needs, and learned constraints from enterprise demand.

What We’re Looking For

◆ 7+ years’ experience at the intersection of pharma or life sciences strategy, AI and data, and enterprise customers, with a track record of leading discussions with senior R&D and commercial stakeholders and shaping ambiguous asks into scalable solutions.

◆ Strong fit from one of the following backgrounds:

◇ Life science strategy or AI consulting at Engagement Manager / Associate Partner level, with substantial R&D or commercial work and ownership of AI or data programmes from strategy through to scale-up

◇ Enterprise Solutions / Solutions Strategy roles in B2B SaaS serving pharma and biotech, particularly in AI-, data-, or platform-heavy products

◆ Deep understanding of end-to-end pharma R&D and commercial workflows and the decisions within them (e.g. target identification, Target Product Profile, candidate selection, indication expansion, launch and lifecycle planning), and of how data and AI can change them.

◆ Hands-on experience building, deploying, and/or integrating technology solutions in enterprise settings (e.g. data platforms, AI and LLM applications, API and system integrations). You have been close enough to the build to understand how a solution works, not just what it does, and have seen solutions through to production.

◆ Ability to read and challenge solution architectures, reason through data pipelines, APIs, and integration patterns, and understand how AI and LLM systems are built and evaluated (e.g. retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, knowledge graphs).

◆ Experience turning complex, bespoke-seeming enterprise demand into repeatable playbooks (qualification criteria, scoping frameworks, pilot design, and BAU handoff).

◆ Strong judgement in making and defending pursue / park / decline recommendations based on product direction, feasibility, scalability, and business impact.

◆ Comfort driving executive decisioning (internally and on the customer side) across Product, Engineering, and GTM, and translating technical trade-offs into clear business choices.

Nice to Have

◆ Scientific or quantitative background (e.g. advanced degree in life sciences, engineering, or a related field).

◆ Experience on AI or GenAI programmes in pharma, from use-case definition through to scaled deployment.

◆ Prior experience in a technical capacity (e.g. forward deployed engineer, data scientist, software engineer, technical product manager).

◆ Familiarity with enterprise data governance in regulated environments (e.g. GxP, data privacy, information security reviews).

◆ Exposure to market expansion, new segment GTM, technology partnerships, or solution incubation.

title: SW Engineering Lead
descriptionHtml:
This role is located in Munich, Germany. TULIP is a hybrid work environment and we are in the office 3+ days/per week.

About TULIP

TULIP is the frontline operations platform that helps manufacturers digitize, connect and continuously improve how they run production, with AI at the core of the product. TULIP was founded out of the MIT Media Lab. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries.

In January 2026, TULIP closed its $120M Series D, at a valuation of $1.3B. Leading global manufacturers run on TULIP, including VEKA, DMG Mori, Roche, AstraZeneca, Richemont, Saint-Gobain Aerospace and Mitsubishi Electric. We partner with NVIDIA, PwC, McKinsey, BCG and more than 160 technology partners worldwide. TULIP is part of the World Economic Forum's Global Innovator community, and our CEO, Dr. Natan Linder, co-chairs the Forum's Advanced Manufacturing Industry Governors Community.

The opportunity in DACH for TULIP

DACH is the heart of global manufacturing. Germany is Europe's largest industrial economy and the birthplace of Industrie 4.0. Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world's "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. Today, these companies face similar pressures: fewer skilled workers, rising quality and compliance demands, and the need to modernize existing plants without stopping production. TULIP gives their frontline teams an AI-native production system to meet those pressures and accelerate time-to-value.

TULIP GmbH is a full operating entity and Munich is TULIP's headquarters in Europe. The team covers sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, customer success, and R&D. Local customers trust our product in regulated, high-precision environments.

About You

You're an engineering leader who cares about getting security-critical systems right and who wants to reach customers fast, not sit buried in a backlog. You think in specs and failure modes, you stay close to the code, and you're already using AI tooling to change how your team builds, not just how quickly they move. You'll take over a small, strong team and own how the world's most demanding manufacturers authenticate, provision, and govern access for their people and, increasingly, the AI agents acting on their behalf.

What skills do I need?

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with direct involvement building and operating security-critical or identity/access systems in production
  • 3+ years of people management experience leading a software team, where you've hired, given constructive feedback, and grown engineers
  • Hands-on depth with OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, OIDC, and SCIM in enterprise environments — you understand the specs and their failure modes, not just the libraries
  • Experience building multi-tenant systems where tenant isolation is a hard requirement
  • Working knowledge of IAM, secrets management, and access policy across AWS and Azure, including the tradeoffs when customers span both
  • A track record of shipping clean, tested code and holding a team to the same standard
  • Active use of AI tooling in your own practice, with a point of view on how it changes the way teams build
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent working experience

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture and roadmap for identity & access — SSO/SAML/OIDC federation, SCIM provisioning, multi-tenant account structures, and the authorization layer across Tulip's multi-cloud infrastructure.
  • Represent Identity & Access in cross-functional architecture reviews and roadmap decisions.
  • Lead and grow a small, high-caliber team — run regular 1:1s, set quality standards, give direct feedback, and develop engineers on security-critical systems.
  • Protect operations where failures carry tangible stakes—from halted production lines to scrapped material and compliance risks. What you ship here has a direct impact on customers.
  • Drive adoption of AI tooling in how the team builds — code review, test generation, spec drafting, and agent loops — and share what works across engineering.
  • Create and own difficult tradeoffs on IAM and access policy where tenant isolation and enterprise compliance are non-negotiable.
  • Ship work that reaches customers quickly and reliably, with operational excellence as the default.

Key Collaborators

  • Security & Infrastructure
  • Platform Engineering
  • Product Management
  • Customer Success

Working At Tulip

We know even great candidates experience imposter syndrome. Even if you don't match every requirement, applying gives you the opportunity to be considered.

We're building a strong, diverse team that values hard work, families, and personal well-being. Benefits of working with us include:

    • Direct impact on product and culture
    • Company equity
    • Competitive benefits package including commuter benefits, learning and development stipend, team events, catered lunches 3 days a week
    • Flexible work schedule and unlimited vacation policy
    • An inclusive, dog-friendly office with diverse and inspiring colleagues
    • Virtual and in-office global company events and happy hours

title: Talent Acquisition Partner (Recruitment) · Permanent · Remote-First
descriptionHtml:
About Kyra

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

Talent Acquisition Partner

Permanent, Full-Time | Remote-First

Internal Recruitment | Kyra | Remote-First

Start date: As soon as possible. Please let us know your notice period.

Contract: Permanent, full-time employment.

Location: Remote-first, based in Europe. If you're near London, we'd be happy to meet in person during onboarding, but it's not a requirement.

Salary: We're open to different levels of experience. Please share your salary expectations and currency in the application form.

👋 The Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced in-house recruiter to help us build the team behind Kyra.

We're hiring across different markets, disciplines and specialist skill sets, including priority roles supporting some of our biggest client accounts.

The challenge isn't always finding candidates. It's knowing exactly who to look for.

A hiring brief rarely tells the whole story. We need someone who can get under the bonnet of a team's challenges, question assumptions and identify the skills that will make the biggest difference.

Someone who can find those people, help us test for those skills and make better hiring decisions.

But we also want to think beyond the immediate vacancy. Every search should strengthen our knowledge of the market, our relationships and our ability to hire next time.

The goal? Better hiring decisions, faster searches and a talent network that becomes a competitive advantage.

You'll have ownership of your work, the opportunity to shape how we recruit and the freedom to test new ideas.

🏃 Can You Keep PACE?

Four qualities I look for in a recruiter.

P: People Person

Networking comes naturally. You can strike up a conversation with almost anyone and enjoy meeting people from different backgrounds and professions.

You listen carefully, remember the details and know how to build relationships that last. You're equally comfortable engaging a senior leader or someone taking their first steps into a career.

A: Adaptable

Different personalities, markets, hiring managers and priorities. You read situations well, welcome feedback and know when to change your approach.

You're comfortable working through ambiguity without losing sight of what needs to get done.

C: Curious & Up for a Challenge

You're fascinated by what makes people good at what they do.

You ask questions others miss, challenge assumptions and enjoy getting to grips with unfamiliar subjects.

You understand that the most important skills aren't always obvious from a CV or job title.

E: Effective at Pace

You have at least three years' recruitment experience in a startup, scaleup or similarly fast-paced, high-volume hiring environment.

You're a confident headhunter who can manage multiple searches, prioritise competing demands and move quickly without compromising standards.

Bonus points for experience recruiting across Europe and the US, particularly in creative, marketing, technology or growing businesses.

We also value excellent writing, commercial awareness, confidence with recruitment data and ATS tools, and an appetite for experimenting with AI.

🔎 What You'll Own

You'll take responsibility for priority hiring across the business while helping us build a recruitment approach that improves with every search.

  • Understand the problem: Work closely with hiring managers to understand their commercial challenges and identify the specific skills their teams need.

  • Find the people: Headhunt, research talent markets and build relationships with people we might otherwise miss.

  • Test for skills: Help hiring managers look beyond CVs and assess what candidates can actually do.

  • Follow through: Manage candidate communication, interviews and feedback. Build relationships that continue beyond a single vacancy.

  • Build the network: Turn every search into better market knowledge, stronger relationships and a head start on future hiring.

  • Keep improving: Use recruitment data, maintain accurate ATS records, follow hiring requirements and experiment with AI to make our processes more effective.

🎯 Your First Three Months

Understand the bar. Find the talent. Build momentum.

You'll take ownership of priority searches, develop relationships with hiring managers and learn what makes someone successful at Kyra.

We already have some brilliant creative and innovative people. Your challenge is to help us find more.

Three things matter:

  • Quality of hire: Understand what separates good from great for each role, challenge assumptions and identify people who meet that standard.

  • Speed of hire: Deliver against agreed timelines without compromising quality.

  • Talent network: Build relationships and pipelines that give us a head start on future searches.

Beyond the First Three Months

The ambition is to make recruitment less reactive and more predictable.

You'll help us develop a stronger understanding of the skills we'll need, build relationships before vacancies arise and create a talent network that compounds in value over time.

We want every hiring decision to leave us better equipped for the next one.

👀 Something I'm Curious About...

Where's the most unexpected place you've spotted talent?

Perhaps you've coached a sports team, taught a class, mentored someone or recognised an ability in someone that others hadn't noticed.

I'm interested in what shaped your ability to recognise potential in people. I'd enjoy exploring this at interview.

👩‍🚀 You Bring the PACE. I'll Give You the SPACE.

Hi, I'm Steph!

I've spent almost five years at Kyra. I know the business well, but I don't assume I have all the answers.

Here's what you can expect from working together.

S: Support

You'll have the context, introductions and support to understand our business and make your own judgement calls.

P: Priorities

You'll know what matters most and why. We'll agree on goals, focus on what makes the biggest difference and adapt as priorities change.

A: Autonomy

You'll have ownership of your work and the freedom to bring your experience, judgement and ideas. You'll have a voice in how we recruit.

C: Communication

You'll have open conversations, direct feedback and someone to challenge ideas with. Five minutes of discussion can save days of unnecessary work.

E: Experiment & Learn

You'll have room to experiment with AI, build useful things and challenge established ways of working.

I'm curious where you are with AI. What have you tried? What's delivering real value? And what hasn't lived up to the hype?

I hope we'll learn from each other and build something we're proud of.

🚀 Interested?

Help us find the people who'll shape what Kyra becomes next.

If this sounds like you, I'd love to hear from you.

title: Talent Sourcer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland.

About the Role

You'll be the engine behind our hiring growth. Most of our roles don't fill from applications: great people have to be found, approached and convinced. As our Sourcing Specialist, you'll own the top of our hiring funnel for sales and engineering roles, from the first message to a candidate who's ready to meet the hiring manager.

You'll also own the candidate experience around it: fast replies, smooth scheduling and honest feedback. That's what makes the best people say yes to us. This is a specialist role: we're looking for someone who loves the search and wants to get really good at it. Our recruiters run interviews, offers and closing, so you can stay focused on finding great people.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and run outbound pipelines for sales and engineering roles, especially in cities where Tebi isn't yet known (Munich, Hamburg, Cologne/Düsseldorf, Rome, Milan, Madrid, Barcelona, the Nordics)

  • Write messages that get answers, and follow up without being annoying

  • Run short intro calls and hand promising candidates to our recruiters with a clear summary, not just a profile link

  • Work with our recruiters on the profile for each role: who we want, where they are, what would make them move

  • Own your numbers (messages, replies, intro calls, candidates passed on, hires) and share them weekly

  • Look after the candidates you source: answer quickly, and give honest feedback to those who don’t move forward after the intro call

  • Keep Ashby clean and your hiring data trustworthy: every candidate tracked, every rejection reason filled in.

  • Spot what's slowing our process down and fix it, or tell us what to change

What You’ll Need

  • 3-5 years in sourcing or recruiting, agency or in-house, with real outbound experience

  • A track record of finding people who weren't looking, with examples of roles you filled that way

  • Comfort with Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter and Ashby

  • Clear, direct writing and a good phone manner

  • Reliable and organised: you don't let a candidate wait for a reply

  • Curiosity about AI tools and how they can make sourcing faster and better

  • Fluent in English. Dutch or other EU languages are a are a plus

People who succeed at Tebi are independent, curious and passionate about hospitality. If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

  • Start-up equity

  • Competitive salary

  • Lunch in the office

  • Flexible time off

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Teamleider Electromagnetic Warfare (m/v/x)
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij die ambitieuze Teamleider / R&D engineer die graag helpt om civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie en duurzaamheid? Wij zijn op zoek naar een teamleider voor de afdeling.

Wat ga je doen?

In een wereld waarin lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen steeds complexer worden, is het belangrijk om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen om de veiligheid en efficiëntie te garanderen. Binnen NLR werken we aan de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde aerospace systemen. We maken hierbij gebruik van software modelering en simulatie om het gedrag van complexe systemen te begrijpen en te optimaliseren.

Onze expertise in hardware testen en operationele ondersteuning (OPS) zorgt ervoor dat onze oplossingen niet alleen theoretisch solide zijn, maar ook praktisch toepasbaar en robuust.

De belangstelling voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) neemt toe, met de noodzaak om onze lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen te beschermen tegen elektromagnetische bedreigingen. We zoeken hierom een teamleider binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electronic Warfare (ASEW)

Als teamleider EW zal je leiding geven aan een team van professionals met expertise in het ontwerp, de ontwikkeling en het testen van aerospace systemen met focus op Electronic Warfare.

Binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electromagnetic Warfare zoeken wij een ervaren en gedreven Teamleider om ons team te leiden en te inspireren. De afdeling is gericht op het ontwikkelen van innovatieve oplossingen voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) en heeft als doel om de Nederlandse en internationale lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie te ondersteunen.

Als Teamleider binnen onze afdeling ASEW ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW. Je werkt nauw samen met de Afdelingsmanager en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken.

In afstemming met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW zal je één van de twee Electromagnetic Warfare kennisgebied overzien, namelijk Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses.

In de rol van teamleider blijf je actief en inhoudelijk betrokken bij het uitvoeren van projecten en krijg je de coördinatie over een team van technische collega’s en het verder ontwikkelen en uitbouwen van de faciliteiten waarvoor ASEW verantwoordelijk is. Je bent dus zowel een teamleider als een R&D Engineer.

Als teamleider …

Als teamleider bied jij het team alles wat nodig is om de werkzaamheden van jouw team succesvol te laten verlopen. Je bent de directe leidinggevende van betreffende collega’s en draagt ook de HR-verantwoordelijkheid. Je coacht, stuurt, geeft én vraagt feedback en je pakt de leiding wanneer nodig.

Je stelt hen op deze wijze in staat om optimaal aan de projecten te werken en faciliteer jij hen waar nodig. Je zorgt voor het versterken van de kennispositie van het werkgebied en de realisatie van de werkzaamheden/opdrachten voor interne en externe stakeholders.

Je hebt een open en enthousiasmerende stijl van leidinggeven. Je collega’s voelen zich vrij en gesteund en kunnen zichzelf goed ontwikkelen. Er wordt een goede teamspirit ervaren. Je zorgt voor een goede aansluiting van het werkgebied bij de rest van ASEW en voor het zoeken van synergie met andere afdelingen binnen flight test en certificatie. Je versterkt de samenwerkingsrelaties gericht op het verder volwassen laten worden van het team.

Als R&D Engineer…

Als R&D engineer EW werk je mee aan het veiliger, duurzamer en competitiever maken van de militaire en civiele luchtvaart. Je werkt aan vliegtuigen, helikopters en onbemande vliegende systemen.

Je ondersteunt onze binnen- en buitenlandse opdrachtgevers bij het bereiken van hun doelen. Je voert testen uit, genereerd modellen en analyseert resultaten.

In de rol van R&D engineer, trek of draag je inhoudelijk bij aan projectvoorstellen voor bijvoorbeeld betaalde projecten in opdracht van een (externe) stakeholder. Dit kunnen ook onderzoeksvoorstellen zijn voor bijvoorbeeld defensie onderzoeks-calls.

Verantwoordelijkheden

  • Leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW;

  • Samenwerken met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken;

  • Overzien van een kennisgebied (Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses) waarmee je samen met de Afdelingsmanager tot strategische doelen van het team komt;

  • Inspireren en motiveren van teamleden om hun beste werk te leveren;

  • Coördineren van projecten en activiteiten om de doelen van de afdeling te bereiken.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Een afgeronde WO master in een relevante discipline (bijv. lucht- en ruimtevaarttechniek, elektrotechniek, informatica);

  • Tenminste 3 jaar ervaring in een leidinggevende functie, bij voorkeur in de lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie;

  • Aantoonbare kennis en ervaring op het gebied van EW;

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels (tenminste op C1 niveau);

  • Sterke leiderschaps- en coachingsvaardigheden;

  • In staat om een team te inspireren en te motiveren om hun beste werk te leveren.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten.

Naast dit alles bieden wij jou:

  • De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken;

  • Voldoende vakantie- en ATV-dagen (in totaal 45 bij fulltime dienstverband) voor een goede werk-privébalans;

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Electromagnetic Warfare is een nieuwe afdeling binnen Aerospace systems en is voort gekomen uit de afdeling Defence Operations. Je zult de leidinggevende zijn van een team enthousiaste en gedreven professionals. Hierbij zul je nauw samenwerken met andere NLR afdelingen, in het bijzonder de afdeling waaruit ASEW voortgekomen is. De werkzaamheden zijn direct gerelateerd aan Defensie, weerbaarheid en de verdediging van Nederland en de Nederlandse krijgsmacht.

Je werkt vanuit onze locatie in Amsterdam en zult veel contact met collega's en partners binnen en buiten NLR.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

title: Teamleiter Logistik (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Kurz und knapp

Suchst du eine Führungsrolle, in der deine positive Energie und dein Teamgeist den Unterschied machen?

Bei Picnic suchen wir nicht nur jemanden, der Prozesse steuert, sondern eine Führungskraft, die ihr Team inspiriert und jeden Tag zu einem Erfolgserlebnis macht. Als Teamleiter Logistik (m/w/d) bist du das Herzstück des täglichen Betriebs in unserem Fulfillment Center (FC) in Hamm. Du coachst, motivierst und unterstützt dein Team aus Shoppers, stellst sicher, dass sie sich wohlfühlen und gemeinsam Großes leisten. Dein Engagement ist entscheidend, um unsere Lagerabläufe reibungslos zu gestalten. Im engen Austausch mit anderen Teamleitungen und der Schichtleitung sorgst du dafür, dass wir als großes Team unsere täglichen Ziele erreichen.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Teamleitung: Leite, motiviere und inspiriere täglich ein Team aus 20+ Shoppers. Du bist ihre erste Ansprechperson, hast stets ein offenes Ohr und förderst ihre Entwicklung.
  • Teamwork: Gemeinsam mit anderen Teamleitungen und der Schichtleitung steuerst du proaktiv die Prozesse im FC. Du trägst maßgeblich zu einer positiven und unterstützenden Arbeitsatmosphäre bei.
  • Tagesgeschäft: Stelle sicher, dass alle Einkäufe pünktlich, sicher und in bester Qualität das FC verlassen. Dabei bist du der Fels in der Brandung, der auch in stressigen Situationen einen kühlen Kopf bewahrt und Ruhe ausstrahlt.
  • Prozessoptimierung: Bringe deine Ideen ein und verbessere gemeinsam mit dem Leadership stetig unsere Logistikprozesse. Du ermutigst dein Team, mitzudenken und sich aktiv einzubringen.
  • Faires Gehalt mit Perspektive: Ein Jahresgehalt zwischen 34.000 € und 38.000 € brutto, bewertet durch jährliche Performance Reviews, für deine persönliche und finanzielle Weiterentwicklung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Bereich Logistik, Hotellerie, Gastronomie oder Ähnlichem absolviert.
  • Alternativ bringst du min. 1 Jahr Berufserfahrung in der Teamleitung oder einer ähnlichen Führungsposition in der Logistik mit.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse, um dich in unserem internationalen Team zu verständigen.
  • Du bist flexibel für die Arbeit in zwei Schichten (6:00 – 14:30 Uhr & 14:30 – 23:00 Uhr, auch samstags) in einer 37,5-Stunden-Woche.
  • Du liebst es, mit Menschen zusammenzuarbeiten und packst selbst mit an.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – mit Zugang zu modernen und innovativen Tools, die dich im Arbeitsalltag optimal unterstützen, sowie exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Ob bei unseren Weihnachts- oder Sommerpartys und weitere Teamevents – wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam und schaffen Erinnerungen, die verbinden.
  • Lebensmittelretter: Hol dir unsere exklusiven "Too-Good-To-Go"-Tüten und rette leckere Lebensmittel – nur für unsere Mitarbeitenden!
  • Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.
  • Absicherung für morgen: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst.

Schwerpunkt Teamsteuerung & Organisation
**DICH suchen wir**

Du bist ein Organisationstalent und verstehst es, Menschen zu motivieren? Bei der VITASERV AG suchen wir eine Teamleitung, die unser Team im Forderungsmanagement (Insolvenzen) operativ steuert. Dein Fokus liegt nicht darauf, jedes juristische Detail selbst zu lösen – dafür steht dir unser Fachbereichsleiter zur Seite. Aufgaben

Du bist verantwortlich für

  • Operative Teamsteuerung: Du planst und koordinierst die täglichen Aufgaben im Bereich Insolvenzsachbearbeitung und stellst eine gleichmäßige Auslastung & Abarbeitung sicher.

  • Mitarbeiterführung & Entwicklung: Du führst regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche, förderst die Talente in deinem Team und sorgst für ein motivierendes Arbeitsklima.

  • Ressourcenplanung: Du verantwortest die Urlaubs- und Vertretungsplanung, damit der Betrieb auch in Stoßzeiten reibungslos läuft.Prozessoptimierung: Du identifizierst Engpässe im Arbeitsablauf und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Lösungen für effizientere Workflows

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Organisationstalent: Du liebst Struktur, behältst auch bei hohem Arbeitsaufkommen den Überblick und kannst Prioritäten klar setzen.

  • Standfestigkeit: Souveräner Umgang auch bei wechselnden Anforderungen und Zeitdruck.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst Ziele verständlich vermitteln und bist ein empathischer Ansprechpartner für Deine Kollegen.

  • Grundverständnis: Du musst kein Insolvenz-Experte sein, solltest aber ein grundlegendes Verständnis für kaufmännische Prozesse und idealerweise das Forderungsmanagement mitbringen.

  • Proaktives Handeln: Du packst Probleme aktiv an und sorgst für ein lösungsorientiertes Umfeld.

Wir bieten dir

  • Attraktives Gehaltspaket, das deine Führungserfahrung würdigt.

  • Monatsgehalt.

  • 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr sowie am 24.12. und 31.12. frei.

  • Fachspezifische Weiterbildungen.

  • Betriebliche Benefits (z. B. Gesundheitsmanagement, JobRad, monatlicher Sachbezug, Altersvorsorge, Teamevents).

  • Corporate Benefits

  • Mitarbeiter-Werben-Mitarbeiter Prämie

  • Kostenloses Wasser

Dein Arbeitsumfeld

  • Teamspirit: Ein eingespieltes Team im Forderungsmanagement, das auf deine Unterstützung wartet.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten nach erfolgreicher Einarbeitung

  • Rückhalt: Fachliche Unterstützung durch einen erfahrenen Fachexperten, damit du dich voll auf die Steuerung konzentrieren kannst.

  • Modernität: Ein zukunftssicherer Arbeitsplatz bei einem Experten für Krankenkassen-Outsourcing.
